name: I Tattoli Chianti Classico DOP EVOO, 500ml
tagline: Limited Edition! When it's gone, it's gone!
description:
Crafted under the strict regulations of Chianti Classico D.O.P., I Tattoli’s estate-grown extra virgin olive oil comes from olive groves that the Bini Smaghi family has tended since 1428. I Tattoli—the family’s historic estate in the heart of the iconic Chianti Classico region—is where Cristina Bini Smaghi took up and improved a centuries-old tradition, reinvigorating olive oil production with innovation, sustainability, and a fiercely uncompromising commitment to quality.

The 2024 edition of this oil is a medium-intensity blend of Leccio del Corno, Frantoio, Moraiolo, and Pendolino olives. Opening with the vibrant aroma of misticanza (mixed wild chicories and fresh herbs), this well-balanced oil reveals layers of complex flavor on the palate—green almond, crisp green apple, thistle, and pine nut. I Tattoli’s aroma and flavor will enhance any dish with sparkling green notes.

subtype: 올리오 누오보/새 수확 (Olio Nuovo / New Harvest)
name: Poggio la Noce 2025 EVOO, 500ml
tagline: New Harvest 2025! This was an olive a few short weeks ago!
description: It's here... the 2025 Harvest!! We look forward to this oil coming out every fall - it is truly an amazing representation of true Tuscan olive oil. With hints of freshly cut grass, almonds & artichokes, it's not just one of our favorite oils, it happens to be produced by a couple of our favorite people - husband and wife team, Enzo Schiano and Claire Beliard. The olives from their 1,500 tree grove are hand-picked and pressed on the estate the same day. This helps to preserve all the intense flavor and fragrance of the olives and ensures the lowest grade of acidity possible. This oil was in it's olive state just a few short weeks ago, and in a few more short weeks, it will be gone...get it while you can, when it's gone, it's gone!

name: The DeLaurenti Grocery Top 20 - ALL 20!
tagline: 20 Hand-picked grocery favorites by Nate & Matt - DeLaurenti Owners - SHIPS ANYWHERE!
description:
There are 2 guarentees with making a list of our Top 20 grocery products when we have 5000. 1st, the 20 that are on the list will be really, really good. 2nd, there we be thousands of other great products left off the list.

This list was compiled by owners Nate & Matt - 10 each. The criteria: you have to love it and you have to choose in 15 minutes. The list checks all the boxes - savory, salty, sweet, crunchy & spicy. Here's what you get:

Ayoh Giardiniera, Villa Manodori Balsamic, Confectionally Yours Toffee, Lunardi Lemon Cantucci, Spinaker 70% Madagascar Sea Salt, Danieli Traditional Tarallini, Bachan’s Gluten Free Japanese BBQ Sauce, Nunez de Prado EVOO, Scalia Anchovies, Maldon Salt, Bret’s Chips (asst flavors), Uncle Jerry’s Extra Dark Pretzels, Mitika OnionToketti, Suhey Peppers, Stuzzi Hot Sauce, Graham’s Horseradish Sauce, Monte’s Tomato Sauce, Drifter’s Fish Smoked Salmon, Oro Liquido Marcona Almond Butter & Tirrena Spaghetti.

name: Museum DOP Garda Orientale EVOO, 500ml
description:
Discover the exquisite taste of Flavio Turri's DOP Extra Virgin Olive Oil, a true gem from the enchanting region surrounding Lake Garda. As a third-generation producer, Flavio carries on a family legacy that began in the 1900s, crafting olive oil with passion and expertise. His family's journey from a Venetian villa to the picturesque village of Cisano di Bardolino has enriched their offerings, showcasing the unique DOPs of the area. At their tasting facility, both locals and tourists can immerse themselves in the rich culture and traditions of quality extra virgin olive oil, making every visit a delightful experience.

This beautifully balanced Garda DOP olive oil, primarily made from the renowned Casaliva olives, captures the essence of northern Italy's culinary renaissance. Perfect for drizzling over salads, enhancing fish dishes, or elevating vegetables, each drop evokes memories of sun-kissed days by the lake, surrounded by the region's traditional foods and wines. Indulge in this liquid gold and let it transport you to the shores of the Lago di Garda!

name: Decimi "No. 51" Limited Edition Umbria Moraiolo EVOO, 500ml
tagline: Slow Food Presidio
description:
From the region of Umbria in central Italy, this vibrant green extra virgin olive oil is made with 80% Moraiolo & 20% ancient Umbrian varietals. It has elegant aromas of fresh vegetables, and cut grass. Very balanced on the palate it has a lasting finish of almonds and green peppercorn.

If that wasn't enough, it also has the distinction of being a Slow Food Presidio oil. This means that Decimi is a small-scale food producer that protects traditional and artisanal products that are at risk of disappearing. Presidia producers follow the principles of agroecology, respecting the soil, water, animal welfare, and biodiversity. They use time-honored methods and avoid the use of pesticides, antibiotics, preservatives, artificial additives, and dyes. Choosing this oil helps support this producer's commitment to these important, time honored practices!

name: Nativ Piume Campania 100% Ravece EVOO, 500ml
description: Roberta Pirone and Mario Ercolino, a renowned enologist, founded Nativ winery in 2008 with an emphasis on the terroir of the area. Their vineyards and olive groves are located in Paternopoli, in the province of Avellino, central Campania. Their olive oil is made with indigenous olive varieties Olivella di Carife and Ravece, typical to Campania. This 100% Ravece oil is bright yellow green in color with aromas of green tomato, artichoke & thistle.

name: Nativ Piume Campania Blend EVOO, 500ml
description: Roberta Pirone and Mario Ercolino, a renowned enologist, founded Nativ winery in 2008 with an emphasis on the terroir of the area. Their vineyards and olive groves are located in Paternopoli, in the province of Avellino, central Campania. Their olive oil is made with indigenous olive varieties typical to Campania. This oil is a blend of three such varieties: Ogliarola, Peranzana & Ravece. It is deep yellow with a hint of green in color with an intensely fruity aroma, complimented by a delicate balance of bitterness and subtle spice.

name: Accademia Olearia Giuseppe Fois Gran Riserva Sardinian EVOO
description: Like many others on our shelves, this lovely olive oil is brought to us by the folks at Ritrovo Imports, the source of the some of the finest food that DeLaurenti is proud to sell. Boldly aromatic and green, this Sardinian Olive Oil is pressed from 100% Bosana olives immediately after harvest with a top-of-the-line cold extraction system. Jewel green in color, it is clean on the palate with green tomato and apple notes with a spicy, bitter finish. Perfect for your best salad dressing & finishing pasta & grilled meats.

name: DeLaurenti Lazio Riserva EVOO, 500ml
description: This house olive oil is from the Colli Etruschi, a farm cooperative located near the Etruscan town of Blera in the province of Lazio. Made from late-harvest Caninese olives, it is silky and bold with a peppery finish. With aromas of fresh cut grass and lime, it is perfect for cooking, salad dressings or finishing grilled vegetables.

name: DeLaurenti Puglia Riserva EVOO, 500ml
description: From the heel of the boot, our Puglia Riserva is a versatile, rich and superbly blended olive oil made from hand-harvested Coratina, Frantoio, Leccino and Ogliarola olives. Full flavored and fruity with a hint of pepper on the finish, this oil's beautiful ceramic tile label also makes it a memorable gift.

name: Colli Etruschi Roma IGP EVOO, 500ml
description: Colli Etruschi is a farm cooperative located near the Etruscan town of Blera. Under the strict supervision of agronomist Nicola Fazzi, their facility uses state-of-the-equipment to produce the highest quality extra virgin olive oils. This oil is harvested from 50-year-old olive trees with 8 hours of picking to pressing process. A combination of caninese, leccino and frantoio olives, it is a vibrant green color and fruity with aromas of green fruit, leaves, cardoon, and artichoke. On the palate, this oil has hints of aromatic herbs, and a warm spicey finish.

name: Olive Truck Tuscan EVOO, 500ml
description:
Some of the world's best olives for making oil are grown in the most remote regions. If you can't bring the olives to the mill, then bring the mill to the olives! Olive Truck founder Sam & his state-of-the-art mobile mill truck follows the harvest, pressing olives within hours of picking - ensuring the preservation of their delicate aromas, flavors, and healthful compounds. The result: oils with remarkably low acidity, soaring polyphenol content, and most importantly, bold and complex flavor profiles that speak for themselves.

His Tuscan Blend features Frantoio, Leccino & Pendolino olives grown in Petaluma, Sonoma County, California. This award winning oil is medium intensity with notes of green apple, artichoke & eucalyptus.

name: Tenuta Sant' Ilario Pietra EVOO, 50ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This bold and flavorful olive oil from the province of Teramo in Abruzzo. is harvested from olives grown 1,200 meters above sea level. This oil boasts a unique blend of 60% Rustichella dell'Aquila, 30% Leccino, and 10% Gentile dell'Aquila.

name: Tenuta Sant'Ilario Argilla EVOO, 500ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This one, harvested in the hilly zone of Atri, above the sea town of Pineto, is made with 30% Dritto, 30% Leccino del Corno, 30% Frantoio & 10% Tortiglione olives. It has a feint, pleasant bitterness with tons of fruit.

name: Tenuta Sant'ilario Pineto Arte in Cucina, 6 X 20ml Tubes
tagline: Extra Virgin Olive Oil Tasting Set from Italy's Abruzzo Region
description: This Olive Oil tasting set from Tenuta Sant'Ilario in Abruzzo is the perfect gift for the person who loves olive oil. A fun way to taste 6 different Olive Varietals and decide which one is your fav. Argilla, Terra, Sabbia, Tortiglione, Intosso and Dritta, in acrylic style paint tubes!

name: Tenuta Sant'Ilario Sabbia EVOO, 500ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This one, harvested near the seaside in the province of Teramo is made with 40% Leccino, 30% Frantoio, 20% Cucco & 10% olives. This oil has bitter tones, with a slight spiciness.

name: Tenuta Sant'Ilario Terra EVOO, 500ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This award winning oil is made from olives cultivated at the foot of the Abruzzo mountains, 900 meters above sea level. Balanced with light bitter and spicy notes, it is made with 40% Intosso, 30% Dritta, 20% Tortiglione & 10% Cucco olives.

name: Erik Banti Olive Oil, 1L
description: Erik Banti is as good at making olive oil as he is at making wine. This oil comes from the same vineyards in the heart of the Morellino di Scansano DOCG and Maremma Toscana DOC appelations. Made with mostly frantoio and leccino varieties with some moraiolo and caninese, all the olives are picked by hand and cold pressed within hours of separation from the trees. Low in acidity, it has a leaf-like color with an intense aroma and piquant flavor with hints of raw artichokes. Perfect for drizzling on grilled meats, vegetables and foccaccia!

name: Frescobaldi Laudemio EVOO, 500ml
description: In medieval times the term laudemio indicated the part of the harvest reserved for the feudal lord. As the best part of the harvest, these oils were only offered to noblemen. Today Laudemio is the name of the consortium that was created in 1986 to attain the highest quality oil with standards of production that exceed normal regulations. The result of all of this is an amazing olive oil. A Tuscan estate oil, it is made with olives harvested by hand and pressed the same day at the property's own mill. Intense and brilliant green in color, it has aromas of fresh cut grass and artichoke, with a classic peppery finish. Here's what you do: grill a bone-in rib eye steak. Let it rest, slice it and fan over a bed of arugula. Sprinkle with sea salt, a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of Laudemio Frescobaldi. Enjoy with a Tuscan red.

name: Madonna Dell'Olivo Itran's, 500ml
description: The limited edition, mono-varietal EVOO is made with 100% Itran olives in Italy's Campania region. It is golden green in color with an elegant, grassy aroma. More peppery than bitter in flavor, it has a light, citrus finish. With incredibly low acidity and high antioxident levels it is an elegant and versatile oil, best for unripened cheeses, summer vegetables and salads.

name: Madonna Dell'Olivo Raro, 500ml
description: This limited production olive oil from Italy's Campania region is made from Ravece and Rotondella olives. It has a light pea-vine color with full flavor and a big peppery finish. Low in acidity, it's subtle bitterness will bring out the true flavors of your bean dishes, steak, soups and bitter greens.

name: Madonna Dell'Olivo Rotondella EVOO, 250ml
description: This limited production olive oil from Italy's Campania region is made with 100% Rotondella olives. It is robust, intense, and fruity. It has aromas of green almond, raw artichoke, chicory, and a slight hint of wasabi with a nice long finish. It will add character to steaks, soups, grilled veggies, bruschetta, risotto, or pasta.

name: Nicolas Alziari Cuvee Prestige EVOO, 1L
description: An exceptional house born in 1868, Nicolas Alziari produces great vintages of olive oils, oils from Nice PDO and oils grown in organic farming. Their Cuvee Prestige oil has a uniquely fruity flavor profile with a distinctively sweet aroma. Hints of mango, artichokes & hazelnuts make it ideal for raw vegetables, fish and poultry.

name: Nicolas Alziari Cuvee Prestige EVOO, 250ml
description: An exceptional house born in 1868, Nicolas Alziari produces great vintages of olive oils, oils from Nice PDO and oils grown in organic farming. Their Cuvee Prestige oil has a uniquely fruity flavor profile with a distinctively sweet aroma. Hints of mango, artichokes & hazelnuts make it ideal for raw vegetables, fish and poultry.

name: Nicolas Alziari Cuvee Prestige EVOO, 500ml
description: An exceptional house born in 1868, Nicolas Alziari produces great vintages of olive oils, oils from Nice PDO and oils grown in organic farming. Their Cuvee Prestige oil has a uniquely fruity flavor profile with a distinctively sweet aroma. Hints of mango, artichokes & hazelnuts make it ideal for raw vegetables, fish and poultry.

name: Azeite Esplendido, Portuguese, EVOO
description: Among the best olive oils Portugal has to offer, Azeite Esplêndido is well-balanced with a maximum acidity of just 0.2% and polyphenol rich. It is prized for its golden-green hue, vibrant aroma, and complex flavor profile featuring fruity, grassy notes, a bold spiciness, and a smooth, peppery finish. Perfect for vinaigrettes, dipping crusty bread, or drizzling over grilled meats, bean dishes, and crisp-tender vegetables.

name: Iliada EVOO, 3L
description: Made with Koroneiki olives grown in the Kalamata region of the Peloponnese, this is your workhorse Greek olive oil. Fragrant, fruity, but mild - it's versatility makes it perfect for everything from sauteing to dipping. Don't tell us 3L is too much. Just convert your favorite empty wine bottle into your next olive oil dispenser with a quick rinse and a pouring spout. Keep the tin in the cupboard away from light and heat, and have the bottle at the ready on your kitchen counter. Use liberally and refill!

name: Iliada Organic EVOO, 500ml
description: Made with Koroneiki olives grown in the Kalamata region of the Peloponnese, this is your workhorse orgainic Greek olive oil. Fragrant, fruity, but mild - it's versatility makes it perfect for everything from sauteing to dipping! Once size can fit all!

name: Iliada Single Estate EVOO, 750ml
description: Iliada Single Estate is a limited production Extra Virgin Olive Oil originating from a single olive farm. Single Estate olive oil is considered among the very best olive oils due to the unique characteristics influenced by natural factors such as the local soil, altitude, microclimate and olive fruit variety. Deep golden green in color, it has an aroma of freshly cut grass with distinct notes of herbs, artichoke and red apple and a peppery finish.

name: Merlino Tonda Iblea EVOO, 750ml
description: Imported by our friends at Merlino Foods and produced by Frantoi Cultera in Sicily, this oil is made with 100% Tonda Iblea olives. Rich & fruity, it has a fresh aroma with a warm, spicy finish. Great flavor, great oil and a great price for 750ml of estate produced extra virgin olive oil!

name: Regalis Hojiblanca EVOO,
description: Harvested in early November in Andalucia, Spain, this all-purpose DOP certified Hojiblanca olive oil has flavors of mellow green apple and caramelized banana. With zero astringency, low acidity (.16%), and a fantastic mouthfeel, it is great for cooking, sautéing, frying, and finishing.

name: Travignoli EVOO, 1L
description: Known for their exceptional Tuscan wines, it makes sense that the Travignoli estate would also produce exceptional olive oil. If you made that assumption, you'd be correct. This is a classic Tuscan oil - pleasantly bitter with a touch of fruit & a warm spicey finish. Lace your September heirloom tomatoes, make salad dressing & finish your Bistecca alla Fiorentina!

name: Frantoia Barbera EVOO, 1L
description: A DeLaurenti customer favorite for years, this Sicilian unfiltered olive oil is skillfully blended by Manfredi Barbera. The unique olive medley (Biancolilla, Cerasuola & Nocellara del Belice) yields an oil with balanced complexity. Frantoia is fruity and mild on the palate, with a subtle peppery finish. Great for salad dressing, dipping and finishing.

name: Frantoia Barbera EVOO, 500ml
description: A DeLaurenti customer favorite for years, this Sicilian unfiltered olive oil is skillfully blended by Manfredi Barbera. The unique olive medley (Biancolilla, Cerasuola & Nocellara del Belice) yields an oil with balanced complexity. Frantoia is fruity and mild on the palate, with a subtle peppery finish. Great for salad dressing, dipping and finishing.

name: Gambuzza Organic Sesame Oil, 250ml
description:
The Organic Sesame of Ispica is rooted in the landscape of Sicily where it is exposed to the radiant glow of the sun, specifically from the charming village of Ragusa. This exceptional sesame is cultivated with a deep respect for tradition and nature, reflecting a family legacy that dates back to the 1960s. Guided by the expertise of generations, it is produced adhering to organic farming practices and without pesticides. The result is an amazing product that is not only gluten-free but also rich in essential nutrients such as iron, magnesium, and calcium. Recognized as a Slow Food Presidium since 2016, Gambuzza sesame stands out for its distinctive amber color and unique flavor, making it a staple in both vegetarian and vegan cuisines.

Cold-pressed from 100% organic sesame seeds, this oil boasts a high unsaturated fat content, making it a heart-healthy choice. It's the perfect choice for drizzling over salads or enhancing your favorite dishes.

name: Olio Verde EVOO, 500ml
description: Made from 100% Nocellara del Belice olives, it is one of the best olives oils you will ever taste. Year after year, this oil continues to be the first choice for chefs and home cooks alike. With a striking green color, Olio Verde has aromas of tomato leaf and fresh cut grass with a peppery finish. Use it for finishing grilled fish, meats, and vegetables, or for a simple vinaigrette with fresh squeezed lemon!

name: Algae Cooking Club Gochugaru Chili Oil, 7oz
tagline: Better for cooking, better for the planet & better for you!
description: Crafted with Chef Daniel Humm of Eleven Madison Park, this flavored oil infuses culinary algae oil with Korean Gochugaru chili and aromatic spices. It is rich in gut and heart friendly Omega-9, buttery-smooth, and perfectly balanced. It has a mild chili heat with warm spices like cinnamon & star anise. Steeped slowly with whole spices like tea in buttery algae oil, it will elevate your eggs, noodles, soups, stir fry or pizza!

name: Algae Cooking Club Oil, 16oz
tagline: Better for cooking, better for the planet & better for you!
description: Algae Oil? Wait..what? Question: What's wrong with producing high-quality fats, proteins, and nutrients in a matter of days with a fraction of the land, water, and carbon needed, without sacrificing flavor and quality? Answer: nothing. Enter our friend Algae! Turns out it yields a better everyday culinary oil for your gut & heart with tons of flavor! But why stop there? With more Omega-9s than any other oil, algae supports digestion, heart health, and high-heat cooking up to 535°F. It is neutral, buttery, and made to make you feel good. Perfect for frying, baking and achieving the perfect crust on your favorite piece of protein!

name: Algae Cooking Club Shiitake Oil, 7oz
tagline: Better for cooking, better for the planet & better for you!
description: Intentionally crafted with Eleven Madison Park, this umami-packed mushroom oil is the secret to enhancing flavors. Made with only premium spices and 100% high oleic algae oil. It's savory umami. Shiitake, miso, and black garlic bring rich, umami-packed flavor to all your dishes. It is high in Omega-3's, low in saturated fat and no artificial flavors, making it the perfect option for drizzling into ramen, swirling into pasta & finishing roasted vegetables!

tagline: Better for cooking, better for the planet & better for you!

Inspired by summer tomatoes gently charred on the grill, Musashi's Smoked Tomato Oil delivers the flavor of peak tomato season without waiting for the perfect tomato, the perfect weather, or the perfect cookout. Rich, savory, and endlessly drizzleable, it's summer in a bottle.

name: Badia a Coltibuono EVOO, 250ml
description: Badia A Coltibuono is widely considered to be one of the highest quality and most consistent extra virgin olive oils in Italy. This classic Tuscan extra virgin olive oil has been produced since 1058! It is golden in color, with a bold, nutty and fruity flavor. The distinct peppery sensation produced at the back of your throat is the result of the olives that are harvested when they are young and fresh. This oil is perfect for salads, dipping bread, and finishing vegetables, steak, pasta, and soup.

name: Badia a Coltibuono EVOO, 500ml
description: Badia A Coltibuono is widely considered to be one of the highest quality and most consistent extra virgin olive oils in Italy. This classic Tuscan extra virgin olive oil has been produced since 1058! It is golden in color, with a bold, nutty and fruity flavor. The distinct peppery sensation produced at the back of your throat is the result of the olives that are harvested when they are young and fresh. This oil is perfect for salads, dipping bread, and finishing vegetables, steak, pasta, and soup.

name: Castelas EVOO Noir d'Olive, 500ml
description: Domaine Castelas started making olive oil in the heart of the Provence in 1997. Although not the oldest, they have been recognized as one of the finest producers in the area. Their award-winning Noir d'Olive oil begins with fully ripe olives that are picked, stored, and gently fermented before pressing. The result is a unique flavor that is akin to a French oil cured olive. It has a subtly fermented note, with hints of black tapenade, cocoa and vanilla, with truffley finish. It is perfect for garlic-seasoned salads, for making mayonnaise, and for drizzling on confits, mushrooms, and mashed potatoes.

name: Castelas EVOO, 500ml
description: Domaine Castelas started making olive oil in the heart of the Provence in 1997. Although not the oldest, they have been recognized as one of the finest producers in the area. This award-winning extra virgin olive oil is bursting with scents of raw artichokes, almonds and apples. It has a silky texture with subtle peppery finish. Perfect for salads, and finishing grilled vegetables and fish.

name: Partanna EVOO, 1L
description: This is one of our favorite multi-use extra virgin olive oils. Produced by the Asaro family in Partanna, Sicily since 1916, it is harvested every year in mid-October. It is cloudy, green and herbaceous, with a hint of pleasant spice. It's priced right for using in bulk, but has enough character for salads and finishing.

name: Partanna EVOO, 3L
description: This is one of our favorite multi-use extra virgin olive oils. Produced by the Asaro family in Partanna, Sicily since 1916, it is harvested every year in mid-October. It is cloudy, green and herbaceous, with a hint of pleasant spice. It's priced right for using in bulk, but has enough character for salads and finishing.

name: Partanna EVOO, 500ml
description: This is one of our favorite multi-use extra virgin olive oils. Produced by the Asaro family in Partanna, Sicily since 1916, it is harvested every year in mid-October. It is cloudy, green and herbaceous, with a hint of pleasant spice. It's priced right for using in bulk, but has enough character for salads and finishing.

name: Agrumato Lemon Infused EVOO, 200ml
description: From the Abruzzo region of Italy near the Adriatic sea, this unique condiment is made by crushing whole lemons with olives during olive oil production. This process captures the essential oils and juice of the fruit in the resulting extra virgin olive oil. It's perfect for drizzling on fresh cheeses like burrata, ricotta or chevre. Also fantastic with fresh pasta and grilled seafood of all kinds.

name: Agumato Citron Infused EVOO, 200ml
description:
The citron, or cedro in Italian, is an unusual citrus fruit, having a distinctive gnarly skin and pulpy interior. There is little use for the interior of the citron, which produces minimal juice, but the thick skin is intensely fragrant thanks to the essential oils in its outermost layer, and produces bright concentrated flavors. The color of citron can vary from lime green to yellow-orange, depending on the variety.

Agrumato Citron captures the aromatic flavor of Italian citrons through its unique whole-fruit crushing process. Whole citrons are crushed together with olives in a state-of-the-art frantoio, sealing the essential oils of the citron zest in the resulting extra virgin olive oil. Use Agrumato Citron as a seasoning for white fish, scallops, and chicken. It's also wonderful drizzled over steamed or raw vegetables.

name: Atlas Desert Miracle Organic EVOO, 500ml
description:
Desert Miracle Extra Virgin Olive Oil, by Atlas, originates from the rugged and arid ElBorouj region of Morocco. This oil embodies the resilience and character of olives cultivated in a challenging desert environment, produced by a family-run business spanning four generations.

This extraordinary olive oil is made from olives grown on a rocky phosphate plateau in Morocco's ElBorouj region, located about 93 miles from Casablanca, heading toward Marrakech. The oil features a blend of two olive varieties: Dahbia, a native Moroccan olive, and Arbequina, a Spanish variety. This unique combination, paired with its distinct origin, lends the oil its exceptional qualities.

name: Atlas Organic EVOO, 750ml
description: Atlas Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil is painstakingly produced by hand at the estate of El-Borouj in the middle of the rocky dessert 150 kilometers from Casablanca toward Marrakech in Morocco. Four generations of the Aqallal family have tended the land and continued the tradition of producing the highest quality olive oil that Morocco has to offer. A unique blend of Moroccan Picholine, Dahbia & Arbequina olives, it has the aroma of ripe bananas, red apples & tomatoes. Perfect as a finishing oil for grilled meats & vegetables, or to enjoy simply with a crusty baguette.

name: Nunez de Prado Organic EVOO, 1L
description: For seven generations, the Nuñez de Prado family has been producing amazing olive oil in the hills of Baena, Spain. 100% organic olives are handpicked and crushed in the family’s granite stone wheels, similar to those used by the Romans 20 centuries ago. Estate-produced and bottled, it is a blend of 14 different olive varieties. The oil has nuances of green olives, oranges, lemons, fresh cut grass, almonds, and apples - all accentuated by a smooth, sweet finish. An unfiltered oil with an even lower oleic acidity than 'extra virgin', it takes 11 kilos of olives to make 1 liter of this olive oil!

name: Nunez de Prado Organic EVOO, 500ml
description:
Nunez de Prado Flor de Aceite (also known as 'Flower of the Oil') is a 100% organic extra virgin olive oil harvested from a single estate in Spain that has been producing since 1795.

This oil is is gathered after the olives are crushed, but before they are pressed between mats. Only the oil that flows through with gravity is bottled in its unfiltered form. This oil has an extraordinary low oleic acidity of 0.1%, ten times lower than required to be labeled Extra Virgin.The result is a beautifully aromatic, fruity & unfiltered olive oil. It takes 11 kilos of olives to make 1 liter of this olive oil!

name: Neus Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 350ml
description: This premium olive oil is produced by Priorat Natur, a small company in Northern Spain that specializes in agricultural products made with traditional methods and recipes of the Priorat region, a rugged, hilly landscape dotted with ancient olive groves. Their Neus Extra Virgin Olive Oil (named after the founder’s grandmother, Neus de Mas Callot) is made exclusively with Arbequina olives, handpicked while green, cold pressed, and bottled immediately. The result is an award-winning oil, golden in color, rich and buttery up front, with a gentle bite in the elegant finish. Use for dipping with crusty bread or drizzled over poultry and fish dishes.

name: Villa Manodori EVOO w/Black Pepper, 250ml

description:

Answer: nothing. Enter our friend Algae! Turns out it yields a better everyday culinary oil for your gut & heart with tons of flavor! But why stop there? name: Castillo de Canena Harissa EVOO, 250ml

name: iLo Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 1Liter

Perfect for sautéed vegetables, pooled on hummus, drizzled over grilled peaches and figs or to coat cauliflower with turmeric before oven roasting.

La Tourangelle avocado oils are NOT fully refined. This means that their avocado oils are green and loaded with naturally occurring antioxidants!

The olives are hand harvested and transported to the oil mill, defoliated, washed, and pressed the same day. This attention to detail and commitment to the craft, creates an oil that is uncompromising in its quality. In true Ligurian style, use this delicate and versatile oil on raw or cooked fish, on salads and vegetables, and in baking.

The result is an oil low in acidity with flavors of freshly cut grass, fresh herbs and artichoke. Each label is harvest dated and foil-wrapped for freshness.

name: Tutto Calabria Olio Santo Calabrian Chili Oil, 200mL
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. This extra virgin olive oil is infused with the best hot Calabrian chilies, creating a spicy and fruity oil with a hint of smokiness. Great for cooking or seasoning, it pairs well with meat, fish, and vegetables, and can be used to add a hint of heat to soups, sandwiches, pizza, or pasta.

name: Unio Siurana Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 1L
description: This extra virgin olive oil hails from Siurana, in the Catalonia region of Spain. It is made according to exacting traditional standards and DOP certified. Petite, brown Arbequina olives give this oil its delicate, fruity flavor and its lightly peppery finish. This is a fantastic cooking oil, but it’s flavorful enough to enjoy as a dipping or finishing oil as well.

name: Villa Jerada Moroccan Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 500ml
description:
Villa Jerada's Extra Virgin Olive Oil is made from Moroccan Picholine olives grown on a single estate in the foothills of the Atlas Mountains.

They created this oil to mark Villa Jerada's 15th anniversary and to share something they've been searching for throughout their years of working with Moroccan producers: an exceptional olive oil that reflects the place, the people and the agricultural traditions they know and love.

The olives are hand-harvested from a farm certified for organic production and pressed in small batches to preserve their fresh, vibrant character. The farm also follows regenerative agricultural practices.

The result is an intensely fruity, green olive oil with fresh herbaceous notes, depth on the palate and a distinctly peppery finish. Moroccan Picholine is prized for its bright fruitiness and naturally high polyphenol content.

This is an oil for everyday use, not one to save for special occasions. Pour it over tomatoes, grilled vegetables, fish, eggs and salads. Dip warm bread into it. Finish a tagine, soup or grain bowl. Or simply taste it on its own.

From the olive groves of Morocco to your kitchen.

name: Yiayia and Friends Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 16.9oz
description: Only the finest Greek extra virgin olive oil from Crete is good enough for yiayia and her friends. Cold pressed to preserve its unique nutritional features and exceptional flavor. In a convenient 500 ml bottle that you can keep on your kitchen counter or table for everyday use.

name: Tutto Calabria Crushed Hot Chili Peppers, 290g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. These traditional Calabrian Peppers are crushed as is and mixed with olives, oil and vinegar. Spicy and full flavored, they are a great way to add some heat to your marinades, soups, spreads and pasta sauces.

name: Contadini Giardiniera, 330g
description: I Contadini, a brand from southern Puglia, gets its name from the Italian word for farmers. Sustainable farming methods, on-site processing, the fertile soil and plentiful sun of Puglia contribute to the unusually high quality of their produce. I Contadini La Giardiniera Pickled Vegetable Medley features the classic southern Italian preparation of crisp vegetables in a sweet and sour pickling mix. Great as an appetizer or as an addition to cold pasta dishes.

name: Bread Dip Company Feta & Pink Peppercorn 8oz
description: A local product that we are carried for years, the Bread Dip Company Feta & Pink Peppercorn is a wonderful cheese spread that goes great with any cracker or piece of grilled bread!

name: Bread Dip Company Olive & Herb, 8oz
description: A local product that we are carried for years, the Bread Dip Company Olive and Herb Tapenade is a perfect addition to your antipasti platter. Kalamata, Manzanilla, and Ripe Black Olives are blended with herbs and spices to create a great tapenade!

name: Bread Dip Company Sundried Tomato, 8oz
description: A local product that we have carried for years! The Bread Dip Company Sundried Tomato spread combines sun-ripened tomatoes with chunks of garlic, herbs and spices which are soaked in delicious extra virgin olive oil. Great with grilled bread or try a spoonful in your pasta!

name: Cascina Fiume Giardinetto Antipasto, 240g
description: A vibrant mix of peppers, carrots, cauliflower, courgette, onions, and tomatoes, all preserved in premium olive oil. The vegetables maintain their distinct flavors, with the olive oil enhancing their natural sweetness and earthy notes, while providing a smooth, silky texture. Perfect to be enjoyed both warm or cold!

name: Cascina Fiume Leek Spread, 180g
description:
Cascina Fiume has centered themselves in tradition and mission-driven work. Gastronomic Gardener is a term Enrico uses to describe their work. Not farmers and not chefs, but a collective of both, bringing the best from field to table.

Their Crema Dolce di Porri, Carmagnola Leek Spread, has a smooth, velvety texture with a delicate sweetness from the slow-cooked leeks. The aroma is subtly earthy, with rich, caramelized notes of leek that fill the air. On the palate, it delivers a refined balance of sweetness and mild onion-like flavor, creating a creamy, savory depth.

name: Cascina Fiume Ortolana Mixed Vegetables in Agrodolce, 570g
description:
Cascina Fiume has centered themselves in tradition and mission-driven work. Gastronomic Gardener is a term Enrico uses to describe their work. Not farmers and not chefs, but a collective of both, bringing the best from field to table.

Their Ortolana, is mixed vegetables in Agrodolce, a blend of peppers, carrots, cauliflower, zucchini and spring onions preserved in sweet and tangy agrodolce.

What is Agrodolce you ask? It translates to bittersweet, and is the Italian condiment you never knew you needed. Combining vinegar with some form of sugar (in Casina Fiumes case, a sweet wine) then adding fruit, nuts, herbs, and spices. This vibrant mix is ideal as an appetizer, side plate, an accompaniment to antipasti spreads, sandwiches, or charcuterie!

name: Cascina Fiume Sweet Onion Spread, 180g
description: Cascina Fiume has centered themselves in tradition and mission-driven work. Gastronomic Gardener is a term Enrico uses to describe their work. Not farmers and not chefs, but a collective of both, bringing the best from field to table. Their Crema Dolce, sweet onion spread, offers a perfect balance of sweetness and umami, with a delicate richness that lingers.

name: Suhey Hot Peppers, 15.5oz
description: What in the world is a Suhey Pepper, anyway? You mean besides being DeLaurenti Co-Owner Nate Plutko’s favorite peppers to put on burgers, brats & sandwiches? Glad you asked. Webster’s would define them as banana peppers in olive oil with garlic, cider vinegar and spices. Nate would say that he grew up eating them on everything in Pittsburgh and that you need to try them and that you will love them. Both things are true in this case! This is one of those “products” that knows few bounds. The breadth of their application is legendary. Tuna salad, pizza, hummus, tacos, sandwiches, pasta, avocado toast, skillet potatoes, cheese boards, cured meats, sauces…you get the point. I guess when you find something you really like to eat, you find ways to eat it with everything!

name: Partanna Muffuletta Mix, 550g
description: Italian Muffuletta you say? Yes. Invented by Sicilians in New Orleans and elevated by Sicilians in Castelvetrano. This muffuletta combines the best Sicilian olives and vegetables to create a salad that works perfectly with ANY sandwich!

name: Beaufor Gherkins in Vinegar, 350g
description: These gherkins add a nice tartness and texture to any cured meat, pate, and of course Raclette. Slice in half and enjoy on a sandwich with smoked meats and mustard, or chop and add to a remoulade or sauce paired with fish or chicken.

name: Big Picture Foods Organic Banana Peppers, 12oz
tagline: Yes...Nate puts these on his spaghetti. Don't knock it till ya try it!
description: Enhance your favorite recipes and some dramatic presentation! These bright, tangy Organic Banana Pepper Rings are regeneratively grown, sun ripened and conveniently pre-sliced. Always free from additives, stabilizers and preservatives - just sweet, robust flavor and endless possibilities! Just 4 ingredients: banana peppers, organic kosher wine vinegar, mineral water & unrefined sea salt!

name: Calpac Peeled Black Garlic, 2oz
description:
Local craftsman source, ferment and age this culinary gem using ancestral practices handed down through generations learned in Japan. Fermenting quality garlic with proper care and technique brings out its many layers of flavor. Notes of dried fig, raisin and balsamic are present along with aromas of black truffle and grape must.

Cal Pac peeled black garlic is used to add a sweet, savory, and umami-rich depth of flavor to dishes like pasta sauces, dressings, and marinades, often mashed or blended due to its soft texture. It's also great in compounds butters, mashed into potatoes or cauliflower, spread on toast, or used in unique desserts like savory ice cream.

name: Matiz Piparras Peppers
description: Matiz Piparra Peppers are a traditional long green pepper from the Basque Country of Spain. With a mild slightly pickled flavor, they make a wonderful accompaniment to bonita tuna and smoked fish, or try them drizzled with olive oil and salt. Feeling creative? Try them on a pizza, a burger, or use them at the perfect martini stirrer!

name: Seattle Pickle Co. Fresh Dill, 24oz
description: Seattle Pickle Co. makes awesome pickles. Hand packed right here in Seattle, this pickle will remind you of those days when you can smell the sweet salty-brinyness of the Pacific Ocean in the Puget Sound. They combine & brine only premium ingredients to give you a truly unique Pacific Northwest flavor and experience.

name: Seattle Pickle Co. Spicy Dill, 24oz
description: Seattle Pickle Co. makes awesome pickles. Hand packed right here in Seattle, this pickle will remind you of those days when you can smell the sweet salty-brinyness of the Pacific Ocean in the Puget Sound. They combine & brine only premium ingredients to give you a truly unique Pacific Northwest flavor and experience. Crunchy & delicious with a warm spice!

name: Tutto Calabria Crushed Hot Chili Peppers, 1 kg
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. These traditional Calabrian Peppers are crushed as is and mixed with olives, oil and vinegar. Spicy and full flavored, they are a great way to add some heat to your marinades, soups, spreads and pasta sauces. Super-sized for those people who burn through the peppers! 1 kilo of pure crushed pepper power!

name: Tutto Calabria Hot Spread Sauce, 290g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world! This traditional Calabrian Hot Spread Sauce is a combination of long peppers, eggplant, tomatoes, garlic and vinegar. Warmly spiced, this sauce is perfect for anything from sandwiches, to pastas to condiments - it also makes a great topping for bruschetta.

name: Mama Lil's Kick Butt Peppers in Oil, 12oz
description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. These pickled goathorn peppers are grown and made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Packed in oil and a touch of garlic, these peppers are crunchy and bright with a spicy kick. Serve with antipasti, or use as a topping for pizzas and sandwiches. Added bonus - use the oil to spice up soups, sauces & pasta dishes!

name: Mama Lil's Mildly Spicy Peppers in Oil, 12oz
description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. These pickled goathorn peppers are grown and made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Packed in oil and a touch of garlic, these peppers are crunchy, bright and mildly spicy. Serve with antipasti, or use as a topping for pizzas and sandwiches. Added bonus - use the oil to spice up soups, sauces & pasta dishes!

name: Mama Lil's Sweet Hot Peppers, 12oz
description: Mama Lil’s is a Pacific Northwest Company that originated in Seattle in 1992 when Howard Lev made his first commercial batch of pickled Hungarian Goathorn Peppers from his mother’s (Lil Lev) recipe. He sold the pickled peppers at farmers markets before attracting the attention of local chefs. Since then, Mama Lil’s has grown exponentially and expanded their line of products, but has never stopped using fresh, locally-grown ingredients. Their Sweet Hot Peppas were what got Mama Lil’s started! They have a sweet spicy kick that won’t overwhelm your palate. Great on almost everything.

name: DeLaurenti Artichoke Spread
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Enjoying a no frills artichoke spread and appreciating the finer things are not mutually exclusive. Correct, this is not the fanciest thing you will find at our store, but it is still one of the best. If you bring it to a friend's house for an appetizer, be prepared to have them ask you to bring it again and again. It is best enjoyed with grilled bread that has some crunch, or with Macrina's Apricot Nut Crostini. Want to know what's in it? Buy our cookbook! Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: DeLaurenti Hummus
description: Our housemade Hummus - better than any mass produced grocery store brand, and a lot easier than making it yourself! We use Rancho Gordo garbanzo beans, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil. Serve with raw or grilled vegetables, crostini, or with grilled chicken, tzatziki sauce, pita, cucumbers and tomatoes. Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: DeLaurenti Salmon Spread
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Our housemade salmon spread! Made with smoked coho salmon collars, crème fraiche, cream cheese, and chives. Great on a breakfast bagel or served with crackers for an appetizer. Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: La Medina Semi-Dried Tomatoes, 540g
description: These semi-sundried tomatoes are versatile, convenient and packed with flavor! They are hand-picked and hand-cut tomatoes marinated in sunflower oil, vinegar, herbs, spices and seasonings. Much more tender than sundried tomatoes, they are perfect for salads, pastas and pizza. No need to discard the oil, either - you can reuse it to marinate something else, use it for dressings, or incorporate it into mayonaisse.

name: Donostia Guindilla Peppers, 4.23oz
description: Donostia brings the culinary culture of Donostia-San Sebastián to kitchens across the United States with their line of select ingredients for authentic pintxos and tapas. Their Guindilla Peppers are pickled & moderately spicey with a subtle, fresh crunch. Perfect alongside a nice piece of manchego, piquillo peppers and serrano ham!

name: Maison Marc Aigre-Doux Cornichons, 310g
description: Call them what you want...pickles, cornichons, gherkins...these are quite possibly the best version of whatever name you use to describe them. Family-owned Maison Marc has been cultivating, picking and packing best pickles anywhere by hand on its farm in Chemilly-sur-Yvonne in Burgundy for three generations. No herbicides, no insecticides, no preservatives...just pickles & a lot of expertise.Their Aigre-Doux cornichons are sweet & sour with a touch of warm pimenton. Perfect right from the jar, with pate, on sandwiches or with your next charcuterie board.

name: Maison Marc Balsamique Cornichons, 210g
description:
Call them what you want...pickles, cornichons, gherkins...these are quite possibly the best version of whatever name you use to describe them. No herbicides, no insecticides, no preservatives...just pickles & a lot of expertise.

Their Fine Gherkins with balsamic vinegar has chardonnay white wine vinegar, uncooked concentrated grape juice, water, mustard seeds, peppercorns, and tarragon.

description: Call them what you want...pickles, cornichons, gherkins...these are quite possibly the best version of whatever name you use to describe them. description: Call them what you want...pickles, cornichons, gherkins...these are quite possibly the best version of whatever name you use to describe them. Steeped in mustard seed, vinegar & tarragon, they are perfect right from the jar, with pate, on sandwiches or with your next charcuterie board.

name: Maison Marc Malossol Cornichons, 440g
description: Call them what you want...pickles, cornichons, gherkins...these are quite possibly the best version of whatever name you use to describe them. name: DeLaurenti Dolmas
tagline: The DeLaurenti Antipasti Case Classic
description: The DeLaurenti antipasti case classic! Perhaps the best deal in the Market for a quick snack or as an addition to your antipasti spread. What are they? Good question: Tender grape leaves stuffed with rice, sauteed onions & herbs. Bite size and made for walking & eating!

name: DeLaurenti Gigandes
tagline: Creamy, marinated white beans
description: These beans have been a deli favorite for years. Meaty, but creamy in texture, they are marinated in oil & vinegar and combined with ribbons of sweet peppers. Great as an addition to your antipasti platter, on a salad or right out of the container!

name: DeLaurenti Peperonata
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: If you have these in your fridge, you have options. Made in our kitchen upstairs, these are handcut strips of whole sweet red & yellow peppers are marinated in oil/vinegar, garlic, herbs & spices. Not spicy, just delicious. They are great alongside cured meats, on a sausage or tuna sandwich or on pizza. Why do it yourself when we've already done it for you?

name: DeLaurenti Pepper Delights
description: These pepper shooters have been a DeLaurenti favorite for many years, attracting people from far and wide to come to our store to get their fix. They are crunchy, not too spicy green cherry peppers stuffed with prosciutto and provolone. Quarter or half them and add them to your antipasto tray, or eat them whole right from the container! There are approximately 10 to 12 peppers per pound.

name: Casina Rossa Homemade Antipaso, 280g
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Casina Rossa is one of their original lines. This sweet and savory blend of Mediterranean vegetables, Italian pine nuts, and raisins dresses up pasta dishes and salads, makes a delightful side dish, or use as part of an appetizer tray.

name: Cuoco Caponata, 7oz
description: Cuoco Brand hails from Sicily. Their Caponata di Melenzane Eggplant Appetizer is a flexible sauce, excellent either hot or cold, as an appetizer with bread or crackers, or as a sauce for meats and vegetables or pasta. Made with eggplant, tomatoes, celery, onions, olives, and capers.

name: Bread Dip Company Artichoke & Caper, 8oz
description: A local product that we are carried for years, the Bread Dip Company Artichoke & Caper spread is a great savory blend of artichoke hearts and capers with lemon and herbs. Great on a grilled piece of bread or use a spoonfull in a vinaigrette!

name: Cascina Fiume Bagnet Verd Salsa Piemontese, 200g
description:
Bagnet Verd Salsa Piemontese al Prezzemolo offers a fresh, herbaceous experience with a smooth yet slightly textured consistency. The bright aroma of parsley combines with subtle garlic and olive oil notes. On the palate, it delivers a harmonious balance of herbal freshness and rich olive oil, with a gentle garlic heat. This versatile sauce adds a burst of freshness, showcasing the

high-quality ingredients of the Piedmont region.

name: Divina Roasted Red Peppers, 16.2oz
description: Divina whole roasted and handpicked red peppers are savory, full-bodied, and ready to go right out of the jar. Everything you love about a roasted pepper, perfect for salads, pizza, or antipasti.

name: Divina Roasted Yellow Peppers, 13oz
description: Divina whole roasted and handpicked yellow peppers are savory, full-bodied, and ready to go right out of the jar. Everything you love about a roasted pepper, perfect for salads, pizza, or antipasti.

name: Fratelli Polli Italian Antipasto, 7.4oz
description: Fratelli Polli is an Italian food company from Milan formed in 1872. They produce a range of preserved vegetables and sauces sold in glass jars. Their Italian Antipasto is a mix of vegetables and tuna in a tomato sauce. It’s excellent served as an appetizer, as a flavorful spread for sandwiches, or add it to a basic marinara sauce and use it as a pasta sauce.

name: Italbrand Roasted Red Peppers, 12oz
description: Not wanting to roast your own peppers is not a defeat. Let yourself off the hook and enjoy these sweet & tender peppers on everything from a sausage sandwich, to pizza to antipasti. They are great as is, or marinated (after cutting them into strips) with olive oil, garlic, herbs and a pinch of red pepper flakes!

name: La Pastora Drop Peppers, 145g
description: lágrima or teardrop peppers are petite, tear-shaped gourmet peppers pickled in a light sweet-and-sour brine. They feature a vibrant red color, a crisp and firm texture, and a unique flavor profile balancing sugary fruitiness with a mild, tangy finish.

name: Mahjoub Preserved Lemons, 200g
description: With over 100 years of experience in agriculture, the family owned Les Moulins Mahjoub focuses on producing the highest quality products by using careful harvesting methods and small scale production. An essential ingredient in North African cuisine, preserved lemons offer a sour and zesty balance against sweet, floral and spicy notes. Packed whole with a mild red pepper, these lemons are perfect with roasted chicken, grilled fish or dropped into stews & tangines. This is just the beginning, the list of uses goes on - pasta, lamb, tapenade, grains, roasted potatoes - any time you can use a lemon, you can use a preserved lemon.

name: Mama Lil's Pickled Asparagus, 28oz
description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. This asparagus is made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Sweet and spicy, they are perfect served on a veggie platter or used as a garnish in your Bloody Mary.

name: Mama Lil's Pickled Green Beans, 28oz
description: Son of the real Mama Lil, founder Howard Lev grew up eating his mother's peppers at every meal. These green beans are made in Washington's Yakima Valley. Spicy, zingy, and crisp, serve on a veggie platter or use as garnish in your Bloody Mary.

name: Matiz Piquillo Peppers, 7.6oz
description: Pure Piquillo peppers carry the exclusive seal of authenticity granted only to those peppers that are hand-picked in the Ribera del Ebro region of Northern Spain. The Piquillo pepper, meaning "little beak" for its distinctive pointed shape, is perfect in addition to you Chorizo and Manchego charcuterie board as well as on top of your Paella!

name: Ronnie's Giardiniera, 8.5oz
description: Ronnie's Giardiniera (jar-din-air-uh), is a small-batch, handcrafted, Chicago style condiment, however made in Seattle, with a bold kick that transforms any dish into a culinary adventure. It’s made of fresh cut, never frozen, non-GMO hot peppers, sweet peppers, vegetables and spices in extra virgin olive oil. Whether layered on sandwiches, spooned over eggs and burgers, mixed into hummus, or topped on pizza, Ronnie's Giardiniera brings the heat and the flavor. Bonus? The leftover oil is liquid gold -- perfect for sautéing or bread dipping. It’s The Missing Condiment - use it on anything!

name: Sable & Rosenfeld Olive Bruschetta, 454g
description: This is a flavorful blend of green olives, carrots, cauliflower, red bell pepper, celery and capers in olive oil. Perfect on sandwiches, grilled bread, pizza, salads, pasta, chicken or potato salad.

name: Sable & Rosenfeld Spicy Olive Bruschetta, 454g
description: This is a flavorful blend of black and green olives, jalapeno and habanero peppers, carrots and capers in olive oil. Perfect on sandwiches, pizzas, salads, pastas, chicken or grilled fish.

name: That Pickle Guy Hot Giardiniera, 16oz
description: A Chicago native moved to New Orleans and was desperate for some familiar food. Armed with some family recipes and a passion to create a winning giardiniera and muffaletta mix - That Pickle Guy was born. After leaving the corporate life, Greg Frederick put his small business ideas into motion. Beginning at farmer's markets in the Chicago area, The Pickle Guy is now found in dozens of stores across the country! So, what is giardiniera? Chicago-style, minced fresh pickled vegetables. Toss this into sauces, pasta, soups, chili, stir fry, roasts, sandwiches, pizza, hot Dogs, fajitas, salads or eggs...the options are endless!

name: That Pickle Guy Mild Giardiniera, 16oz
description: A Chicago native moved to New Orleans and was desperate for some familiar food. Armed with some family recipes and a passion to create a winning giardiniera and muffaletta mix - That Pickle Guy was born. After leaving the corporate life, Greg Frederick put his small business ideas into motion. Beginning at farmer's markets in the Chicago area, The Pickle Guy is now found in dozens of stores across the country! So, what is giardiniera? Chicago-style, minced fresh pickled vegetables. Toss this into sauces, pasta, soups, chili, stir fry, roasts, sandwiches, pizza, hot Dogs, fajitas, salads or eggs...the options are endless!

name: Tutto Calabria Hot Cherry Peppers, 10oz
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Tutto Calabria’s founding family, the Cellis, know peppers. They’ve been harvesting them from the hillsides of Calabria since 1910. These pickled chilies are tangy, bright, and spicy. They’re an excellent way to add some spice to your next sandwich or pasta sauce.

name: Tutto Calabria Hot Long Chili Peppers, 290g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. These traditional Calabrian long peppers are marinated in oil and vinegar. Spicy, but not overwhelming, use them whole, chopped, or pureed to add some warm spice to your sauces, marinades, salad dressings and condiments.

name: Tutto Calabria PepperO' Hot/Sweet Cherry Peppers, 300g
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. These pickled peppers are the perfect balance of spicy and sweet. Soft, with just a hint of crunch, a few on your sandwich can transform your ho-hum lunch into a southern Italian classic.

name: Tutto Calabria Stuffed Cherry Peppers with Fresh Italian Cheese, 290g
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Each plump Calabrian pepper is stuffed with PDO Quartirolo Lombardo cheese, for a North-meets-South punch of flavor and texture. Mild peppers allow the subtle tartness of the cheese to shine. These peppers are a crunchy-creamy delight. Great for snacking, on top of pizza, in pasta dishes or sandwiches. Not sure how they get the cheese in there and then get them into the jar. This isn’t our concern…our job is to eat them.

name: Bonomi Lady Fingers, 200g
description: The Bonomi family has been baking delicious breads and confections since 1850. Often used as an accompaniment to ice-cream, custards and coffee, lady fingers are long, thin cookies designed to turn spongy when soaked in liquor or covered with ice cream. Most notably, they are the critical ingredient in tiramisu - the famous italian dessert consisting of ladyfingers soaked in espresso, mascarpone, liquor and cocoa powder.

name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Sicilian Marzipan, 8.8oz
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Sicilian Marzipan is a rich, organic puree of almonds and cane sugar. Marzipan, an ancient confection, was likely brought to Sicily from the Middle East by crusaders. Sicilian chefs use it to create decorations for cakes. It’s also an essential ingredient in the best almond cakes and tarts.

name: Antico Molino Caputo "00" Chef's Flour, 1kg
description: Antico Molino has been producing the best flour possible in Naples, Italy since 1924. When making pizza, pasta or bread, the quality of the flour determines the quality of the finished product. Their "OO" flour is their signature product. Named "OO" for the finest setting on the mill, it is high in protein and gluten, resulting in an optimal crust with just enough moisture, crunch, and chew.

name: Antico Molino Caputo "00" Pasta Fresca Flour, 1kg
description: Antico Molino has been producing the best flour possible in Naples, Italy since 1924. When making pizza, pasta or bread, the quality of the flour determines the quality of the finished product. Their Pasta Fresca & Gnocchi flour is designed especially for these two things. It's elasticity & high protien content will produce a superior end result!

name: Antico Molino Caputo Bread Flour, 1kg
description: Neapolitan flour producer Caputo has been supplying the world’s great pizzerias with flour since 1924. If a light and airy crust is your thing, the Caputo Nuvola (translation: cloud) flour is what you want. Caputo designed the Nuvola flour for higher levels of hydration, which leads to greater dough flexibility. The result: an easy-to-stretch dough with a remarkable rise that bakes into a puffy, crisp exterior crust with good chew and a tender interior. Great for long fermentations.

name: Antico Molino Caputo Semolina Flour, 1kg
description: Antico Molino has been producing the best flour possible in Naples, Italy since 1924. Finely ground with semolina’s signature yellowish tint, this flour is ideal for traditional pastas and breads. The perfect flour to use when the distinctive color, rustic texture and flavor characteristics of semolina are desired.

name: Caputo Fioreglut Gluten Free Flour, 1000g
description:
The Antimo Caputo line of flours is one of Italy’s premium brands for authentic

Neapolitan pizza, bread, and desserts. Their Fioreglut Gluten Free Flour is a great all-

natural alternative for those allergic to or avoiding gluten. You’ll be pleasantly surprised

at how pizza crust and bread made with this flour achieve a texture and taste that

resembles traditional loaves and crusts.

name: Nielsen Massey Gourmet Vanilla Beans, 2pc
description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. Cultivated and cured on the Bourbon Island of Madagascar, each of these vanilla beans is hand-selected for its freshness and rich fragrance. The full, sweet, creamy and mellow flavor with velvety after-tones is long-lasting and found in both the bean and the seeds. Use these beans whole, or split and scrape the seeds out and add to your favorite dishes, desserts and custards. A bonus - as long as the bean is still aromatic and moist, it can be rinsed and dried for reuse!

name: Nielsen Massey Madagascar Vanilla Extract, 4oz
description: Using premium, hand-selected beans cultivated on the Bourbon Island of Madagascar, Nielsen Massey uses their proprietary cold extraction process to gently draw out and preserve the over 300 flavor compounds found in their vanilla beans. The result is a sweet, creamy, mellow flavor with velvety after-tones, perfect for cooking and baking both sweet and savory dishes. An exceptional all-purpose vanilla. One tablespoon of vanilla extract is equivalent to one vanilla bean.

name: Nielsen Massey Mexican Vanilla Extract, 4oz
description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. This Mexican vanilla extract has the spicy characteristics of nutmeg and clove, while maintaining a woody sweetness. Use this extract with chocolate, citrus fruits, and warm spices like cinnamon. Mexican vanilla also complements savory dishes involving tomato sauce, barbeque sauce, or salsa. For dessert, try adding to your cookie or cake recipes.

name: Nielsen Massey Pure Vanilla Bean Paste, 4oz
description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. Their pure Vanilla Bean Paste is crafted using their Pure Vanilla Extract and a proprietary blend of select vanilla beans. The flavor profile is a classic, rich vanilla taste, with the addition of real bean specks from the vanilla pod, providing an enticing visual for recipes like crème brûlée and ice cream. With a consistency similar to that of molasses, you can also use this to add flavor to batters or sauces without thinning them out. Recipe substitutions: 1 tablespoon vanilla extract = 1 tablespoon vanilla bean paste = 1 whole vanilla bean.

name: Nielsen Massey Pure Vanilla Powder, 2.5oz
description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. This vanilla is ideal for dry mixes, beverages and color-sensitive recipes, like icing. You can also use this to add a finishing touch to cakes, cookies, and fruit. To use as a replacement for vanilla extract in a recipe, simply measure and substitute the same amount of vanilla powder.

name: Nielsen Massey Tahitian Pure Vanilla Extract, 4oz
description: Family-owned Nielsen Massey has been crafting fantastic vanillas since 1907. This delicate vanilla is cold-extracted to preserve its more than 300 different flavor compounds. It's flavor profile is often described as floral and fruity with hints of anise and cherry. Since it is very susceptible to heat, it's recommended this only be used in cold applications. Add to refrigerated and frozen desserts, pastry creams, smoothies, shakes, puddings and custards.

name: DeLaurenti Bittersweet 60% Chocolate Chips, 8oz
description: These are the chocolate chips we use in our cookies. They are perfect for that application and any other, including standing up in the kitchen and popping them into your mouth in between tasks. They are bittersweet, yes, but have enough natural sweetness to be enjoyable to eat on their own. Oh, and they are next level good in any cookie you decide to make.

name: Faugier Chestnut Puree, 15oz

name: Dick Taylor 65% Chocolate Coated Almonds, 171g
description:
Adam Dick and Dustin Taylor come from a background of woodworking and boat building. Applying the craft of working with their hands to their chocolate making was a natural progression. They source only the finest fairly traded cacao and perform all the steps of chocolate making in house in Eureka, California. The whole process takes up to three weeks and results in some of the best chocolate that you will ever enjoy.

This delicious treat is made by delicately roasting organic California almonds. Using traditional coating pans, they slowly build layer upon layer of their 65% Tanzania dark chocolate and finish with a dusting of cocoa powder. A modern take on this traditional confection.

name: Koeze Cream-Nut Crunchy Peanut Butter, 16.5oz
description:
The Koeze Company story began 116 years ago when Sibbele Koeze emigrated to America from the Netherlands in the 1880's. He built upon his Old World commitment to handcrafted, artisanal food while establishing in 1910 a thriving produce business in Grand Rapids, Michigan. 3 generations later, the peanut butter is still just as good and we are excited to have it in the store. Thanks to Elyse who can't live without it.

The Crunchy is exactly what you would expect. The same great peanut butter taste, but with extra large, flavorful, Virginia peanut chunks added, to lend an amazing crunchy texture.

description:

This artisanal method keeps the figs soft, tender and full of natural sweetness that makes dried Kymi figs world-renowned. The sommelier explained it was a sweet wine from France, with notes of stone fruits, citrus and honey. Perplexed at the concept, Johnty drank. He then smiled in amazement. With a definitive taste of apricot and honey, a new interest had been discovered, and in retrospect, this bar was born.

SOMA's original idea was to infuse cacao with oak. After an inspired talk with their friends at Stratus Vineyards in Niagara-on-the-Lake, winemaker J-L Groux sent over an oak barrel partially filled with the residual yeast and grape skins from the winemaking process known as "lees." They roasted up a batch of cacao beans and added the roasted nibs to the barrel, rolling it around to make sure things were well mixed.

3 months later, they had a chocolate bar with notes of grapes, miso, wild honey, sour dough, lychee, walnuts & honeysuckle.

name: Ara Chocolat Amandes and Roses, 70% El Salvador
description: Ara Chocolat, founded by a Venezuelan couple, Andrés and Sabrina, is a micro batch Parisian chocolate shop and one of the few bean-to-bar chocolate makers in France. They make chocolates from the beans that their Chef Chocolatier, Andrés, carefully chooses and buys directly from small cocoa growers and cooperatives in Latin America. Porcelana, a strain of the renowned Criollo cocoa variety is the gold standard for chocolate. The beans are a white to violet color reminiscent of pure porcelain, hence the name. This bar strikes the perfect balance between fruity acidity and pleasant bitterness. Earthy & nutty, it is laced with brambly fruit, amazing acidity, subtle sweetness and a melt in your mouth texture. In short, this chocolate is an occasion.
