Earthy & nutty, it is laced with brambly fruit, amazing acidity, subtle sweetness and a melt in your mouth texture. In short, this chocolate is an occasion.

name: Amedei Toscana Latte Milk Chocolate, 50g
description: Amedei is an award winning company founded by Cecilia Tessieri in Tuscany, Italy. They are producers of some of the finest bean to bar chocolate in the world. Toscano Latte, the founding member of Amedei’s milk chocolate family, is a delicate blend, obtained by combining fine cocoa beans (Madagascar, Ghana and Venezuela) with whole mik from Brittany in Western France. A chocolate with a creamy and naturally sweet taste resulting in an unexpected flavour. An ode to childhood memories.

name: Amedei Toscano Black 70% Dark Chocolate, 50g
description: Amedei is an award winning company founded by Cecilia Tessieri in Tuscany, Italy. They are producers of some of the finest bean to bar chocolate in the world. Strong and creamy, the 70% Black Bar has a subtle sweetness and a lasting, clean finish.

name: Fossa Bak Kut Teh Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

An iconic dish of Singapore, Bak Kut Teh or “meat bone tea” is a hearty stew made with pork ribs and a mix of aromatic spices. The Teochew style popular in Singapore is garlicky and peppery.

Our version is made with a base of fudgy Bolivian cacao from Alto Beni region blended with a powerful spice mix of Sarawak white pepper, Indonesian black pepper, anise, cinnamon and a healthy dose of garlic. It is a heartwarming blend of spice and soul.

name: Fossa Black Truffle 64% Dark Milk Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar has black truffle infused into floral Ecuadorian Costa Esmeraldas dark milk chocolate and mixed with crispy feuilletine - flakes of crushed crêpes dentelle. The result is a rich earthy aroma of truffle with a satisfying crunch!

name: Fossa Cheng Tng Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Cheng Tng (roughly translated to clear soup) is a beloved traditional dessert in hot and humid Singapore. Sweet and refreshing, it is usually made with ingredients with cooling properties such as dried longan, persimmon and candied winter melon.

In this bar, we used a smoky cacao from Pinalum Village located in Malekula Island, Vanuatu. The beans were naturally “smoked” by storing beside wood fire-dried copra, lending a flavour that reminds one of smoked longan. Mixed with a variety of seeds and fruits, the chocolate is nostalgic, and wonderfully soothing — just like the dessert that inspired it.

name: Fossa Chrysanthemum Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Chrysanthemum is a symbol of longevity and rejuvenation. Brewed as a tea, it is believed to have cooling and cleansing properties. Prized chrysanthemum buds sourced from Zhejiang, China, are blended with fruity cacao from Rehoboth Estate, bringing forth elegant floral aroma and notes of honey with a long sweet lingering finish.

name: Fossa Da Hong Pao Wuyi Cliff Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Da Hong Pao, the most famous of all Wuyi cliff teas, is a careful blend of specially selected cultivars to create the deep aroma, smooth sweetness and rock-grown character. Rou Gui provides a strong structured body while Jin Mudan and Rui Xiang lift the aroma with fruity-floral fragrance. Two rounds of medium level roasting brought out the depth and complexity of these teas from the Zhengyan core area of Wuyi Mountains.

Paired with creamy and nutty cacao from Triang, Malaysia, the flavour is balanced, layered and richly aromatic.

name: Fossa Dancong Duck Sh$t Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

A collaboration with rare tea curator Pekoe & Imp, this chocolate bar is made with a dancong tea from the Guangdong Province of China, known as Ya Shi Xiang. The name literally translates to “duck sh%t.” Legend has it that the farmer who cultivated the tea intentionally gave it a revolting name in order to hide the secret to his delicious tea. Fortunately, the flavor is nothing like the name suggests. Pleasantly floral on the nose with notes of fruit and malt, don’t make the mistake of judging this chocolate by its cover.

name: Fossa Full Bloom 54% Dark Milk Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Full Bloom is a geranium scented creamy dark milk chocolate made with fruity Filipino cacao and adorned with a bed of assorted edible flowers. Treat yourself to this visual and soulful delight!

This is a special collaboration with Lim Joo Huat, a Singaporean third-generation fresh produce wholesale distributor with a legacy dating back to the 1960s. Working directly with farmers, Lim Joo Huat is renown for their top-quality fresh produce.

name: Fossa Gardenia Flower Green Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar features green teas of the Fuding Da Bai cultivar infused with Gardenia Flowers from Qianwei country in Sichuan using a traditional floral infusion method. Fresh flowers are layered over tea leaves ina laborious process that is repeated seven times to achieve complex yet delicate floral candy sweetness. Paired with mild Peruvian chocolate, the flavor is refreshing with lingering umami and a creamy texture.

name: Fossa Honey Orchid Dancong Hongcha Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar is a collaboration chocolate with rare tea curator - Pekoe & Imp. Winner of the International Chocolate Awards 2019 Gold Award winner, it has lingering lychee sweetness with a biscuity undertone.

name: Fossa Jasmine Green Tea Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. This bar is a collaboration with rare tea curator Pekoe & Imp. It is a combination of Bi Tan Piao Xue (traditional Sichuan tea), a top-grade spring harvest green tea, and beautifully fragrant summer jasmine flowers. Made with Peruvian cacao, the result is a delicate & floral chocolate with notes of umami.

name: Fossa Lapsang Souchong Wuyi Cliff Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Traditional smoked Lapsang Souchong from Guadun Village, one of the twelve natural hamlets of Tongmuguan in Wuyi Mountains at 1200m is one of the world’s first black tea.

Crafted from 120-year-old Wuyi Cai Cha bushes grown among misty cliffs and ancient forests, their deep roots and slow growth produce leaves rich in minerals. Processed in a traditional pine-wood smoke house, it delivers both strength and elegance. Paired with cacao from Semuliki Forest, Uganda, the flavour is bold and aromatic with deep fruity sweetness beneath the smoke.

name: Fossa Matcha & Yuzu Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar is made with "Wakatake" grade matcha -the highest grade of culinary matcha- from Japan’s highly regarded matcha producer, Marukyu Koyamaen. The matcha has a good balance of richness and umami while its bright green colour is a feast for the eyes. Made into a creamy white chocolate and paired with citrusy candied yuzu peels, this makes for the perfect tea time snack.

name: Fossa Mu Zha Tie Guan Yin Tea Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Mu Zha Tie Guan Yin is a Taiwanese roasted oolong tea crafted using a traditional method involving repeated rolling and masterful roasting. The tedious process produces tightly curled leaves that infuse toasty caramel aroma and fruity notes that evolves into a floral sweetness. This bar blends the tea with herbaceous and earthy Ecuadorian cacao from Costa Esmeraldas estate, creating a 62% dark chocolate that is comforting on a chilly day.

name: Fossa Pineapple Tart Caramelized Chocolate Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

This bar of creamy caramelised blond chocolate contains pineapple chunks, buttery crusts and has a biscuity texture. Inspired by a favourite local festive snack, its addictive flavour is sure to leave you wanting more! Bite into the abundance of prosperity and blessings!

name: Fossa Pistachio Rose Cranberry 64% Dark Milk Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Pistachio and rose are made for each other. In a rose-infused 64% dark milk chocolate made with fruity cacao from the Philippines, Italian pistachios are folded in for a satisfying crunchy texture. Generous toppings of dehydrated cranberries and French rose petals makes this bar a wonderful harmony of flavours and textures.

name: Fossa Planteray Xaymaca Rum 72% Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

A collaboration between Planteray Rum and homegrown artisan chocolate maker Fossa Chocolate.

Tanzanian cacao from Kokoa Kamili fermentary is infused with Planteray Xaymaca Special Dry Rum, a Jamaican style rum fermented with natural wild yeast, and distilled in double retort pot stills.

Made into a 72% dark chocolate, the result is chocolate with rich aroma of overripe banana and tropical fruits with lingering finish of heavy and textured rum.

name: Fossa Rou Gui Wuyi Cliff Tea bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Rougui, named for its distinct cinnamon aroma, is a classic tea cultivar from the Wuyi Mountains. This batch is made from tea leaves harvested from Da Shui Keng which sits in the Ban Yan zone of Wuyi Mountains at over 800m. Here, the slopes flatten slightly, allowing the tea bushes to absorb sunlight throughout the entire day. Grown without chemical fertilisers nor pesticides, nurtured by the natural rhythm of the mountains, its flavour reflects the terroir.

Paired with cacao from Semuliki Forest, Uganda, the flavour is clean, vibrant and richly aromatic.

name: Fossa Sake Kasu 73% Dark Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

name: Fossa Salted Egg Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Caramelized white chocolate provides the base for this unique bar. Inspired by the beloved salted egg yolk dishes that are ubiquitous in Singaporean casual dining, it’s an addictive combination of sweet and savory. A truly delicious and creative white chocolate!

name: Fossa Satay Sauce Milk Chocolate Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

The travelling satay hawker who prepared skewered meat with a portable charcoal grill was a familiar sight in olden days Singapore. These barbecued skewers are the perfect comfort food and are never served without a dipping sauce made from ground peanuts and aromatic spices. Enjoy this traditional snack in a milk chocolate bar made with cacao sourced from Kokoa Kamili, Tanzania, and ingredients sourced regionally.

name: Fossa Soy Milk & Youtiao Bar, 50g
tagline: Creamy, aromatic soy with crunchy bits of tiao in white chocolate!
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Youtiaos are perfectly deep-fried golden brown strips of wheat flour dough. Crispy and chewy, they make great snacks on their own but the real enjoyment is dipping them into a warm bowl of nutritious soy milk. In this bar, dehydrated youtiaos are paired with 38% soy white chocolate to create this classic dish in bar form!

name: Fossa Terada Honke Kaikoshu Sake Chocolate, 50g
tagline: Oxidative, nutty & umami, reminiscent of elegant aged sake
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Sake and chocolate are perfect together. In this bar, an 18 years old junmai sake brewed in Terada Honke, a Chiba-based brewwery that makes natural, old-school sake using traditional manual methods, is infused into Tanzanian cacao from Kokoa Kamili fermentary. Made into a 72% dark chocolate, the flavor is complex with notes of preserved plums and warm spices.

name: Fossa Thai Lychee Nib Bar, 50g
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Flower children, this one’s for you! This bar features rose tea-infused Tanzanian chocolate, sprinkled with dehydrated Thai lychee and cacao nibs. Its crunchy texture, fruity flavor & floral aroma will transport you straight to the garden with your first bite.

name: Fossa Xing Ren Hu Bar, 50g
description:
Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region.

Xing Ren Hu, also known as Chinese almond cream, is a delicate and silky traditional dessert first brought to Singapore by Teochew immigrants. Made with apricot kernel, rice, sugar and water, this smooth, ivory-hued paste offers a subtly nutty aroma with a lightly floral undertone.

In this bar, they toasted apricot kernel and grounded aromatic Jasmine rice for a smooth texture with a marzipan aroma. Bits of roughly chopped apricot kernel adds a playful crunch.

name: Fossa Yuzu Sea Salt Bar 54% Dark Milk, 50g
tagline: Creamy, biscuity chocolate with refreshing citrusy yuzu!
description: Fossa is Singapore’s first, and award winning bean to bar chocolate maker. Their unique bars feature ethically sourced ingredients, and subtle, nuanced flavors that draw on the rich agricultural and culinary traditions of the region. Yuzu is an incredibly aromatic citrus fruit that has the ablility to brighten any dish and is commonly used in Japanese cuisine. This bar has chewy yuzu peel with sea salt flakes on a bed of creamy, biscuity Tanzania 54% dark milk chocolate. Perfect for your afternoon tea!

name: Goodnow Farms Asochivite Maple Suger 70% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

This bar is crafted with freshly pressed Asochivite cocoa butter for intense single origin flavor and exceptional smoothness. Goodnow Farms is one of the only chocolate makers in the country to press their own cocoa butter, and it makes a world of difference in flavor.

name: Goodnow Farms Caramelized Onion 77%, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

This sweet and savory bar combines our El Carmen chocolate with caramelized onions sourced from single origin spice masters Ethan Frisch and Ori Zohar of Burlap & Barrel. The carefully dried, caramelized onions are refined along with their chocolate in their stone grinders for maximum flavor development. The intense, melt-in-your mouth onion flavor is umami at its best. It's truly a unique and supremely satisfying flavor experience!

name: Goodnow Farms Chocolate Banana Split 59% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

Limited Release, Chocolate Banana Split by Goodnow Farms is a playful yet sophisticated take on the classic dessert. This small-batch chocolate combines rich single-origin cacao with the natural sweetness of ripe bananas, complemented by hints of vanilla and caramelized sugar.The result is a creamy, indulgent bar with a smooth texture and a nostalgic yet refined flavor profile. Perfect for those who love the comforting taste of a banana split with the depth of fine chocolate.

name: Goodnow Farms Coco Loco 60% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

This bar was inspired by their favorite Colombian beach cocktail, the Coco Loco, a drink they discovered in Cartagena during one of their cacao sourcing trips. There are many variations on the recipe but Goodnow love the combination of coconut, rum and citrus. To make this bar they had to find just the right balance of flavors to accentuate the chocolate, so they did a LOT of test batches. This final recipe involves soaking their fruity Esmeraldas cacao nibs in Boston Harbor Distillery’s Lawley’s Rum and adding just the right amount of organic coconut sugar, organic coconut milk powder, and naranjilla fruit to their grinders.

name: Goodnow Farms Guatemala Asochivite 77% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow craft their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolates on their New England farmstead, using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans. The payoff is some truly delicious chocolate!

The cacao for this dark chocolate comes from San Juan Chivite, a Guatemalan village so remote that a narrow footbridge is the only way in or out – yes, even for the cacao! The farm is run by indigenous Maya families, who were recently able to improve their fermentation facilities due to an investment from Goodnow. These talented farmers grow and ferment some excellent beans, and they are beautifully showcased in this bar. Bright and fruity, with light acidity and a dark fruit finish, this single origin chocolate is a pure delight.

name: Goodnow Farms Mexico Almendra 77% Bar, 55g
description: Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans. Almendra Blanca, or white almond, refers to the color of the cacao bean. There is nothing added to this bar - no almonds, just chocolate. Sourced from Hacienda Jesus Maria, a farm located in Tabasco, these unique beans lend a paler hue to this high-cacao bar. A short, gentle roast allows Goodnow to highlight the naturally bright, fruity flavor of the Almendra Blanca bean.

name: Herbaceous Green Sichuan Pepper 70% Bar, 55g
description:
Goodnow crafts their award-winning bean-to-bar chocolate on their New England farmstead using carefully-sourced cacao from trusted producers. Rather than purchasing commodity cacao, Goodnow establishes close relationships with their farmers, which helps ensure ethical, safe, sustainable growing practices, as well as high-quality beans.

Their Herbaceous Green Sichuan Dark Chocolate sourced from spice company 50 Hertz is truly unique. They always pair the natural flavor notes of our single origin chocolate with different complementary flavors, and this match up is spectacular. The herbal notes of their Peruvian Ucayali chocolate seamlessly meld with and carry the pine, floral and citrus notes of the Green Sichuan Pepper. And, the Ucayali chocolate already had a slightly cooling hit, but the Sichuan really amps it up for a cool breeze in the mouth after the lemon rush! Also, not spicy!

name: K+M Extravirgin 75% Ecuador Dark Chocolate, 70g
description: Michelin-starred Chef Thomas Keller of The French Laundry in Napa Valley and Armando Manni, producer of legendary Italian olive oils, collaborated to develop some of the world’s finest chocolate with their proprietary method of custom processing each batch of cacao. Their 75% Dark Chocolate, Ecuador has a velvety texture and notes of ripe mango, spice, and sweet nectar.

name: K+M Milk Chocolate Truffle Fries 55% Bar, 55g
description:
Michelin-starred Chef Thomas Keller of The French Laundry in Napa Valley and Armando Manni, producer of legendary Italian olive oils, collaborated to develop some of the world’s finest chocolate with their proprietary method of custom processing each batch of cacao.

Inspired by the namesake side at Chef Thomas Keller's Bouchon Bistro, Truffle Fries combines lightly salted, crunchy French Fries and bean-to-bar milk chocolate with a hint of truffle. Crafted with Arriba Nacional cacao from Ecuador's Hacienda Victoria Estate and Rio Caribe beans from Venezuela's Paria Peninsula. Roasted, ground and molded by hand in Napa Valley, California.

name: Mission 70% Guava Bar, 60g
tagline: International Chocolate Awards Americas - Silver 2019
description:
Mission has been working with chocolate since 2002, first as chocolate educators with Le Cordon Bleu in Los Angeles, then as chocolatiers with their own store in Berkeley, California, and now as chocolate makers in São Paulo, Brazil. Their chocolates are the most awarded in Brazil, with 50 national and international prizes in the last 5 years. They believe the best chocolate rewards everyone in the supply chain. Their farmers receive almost 4 times more than the market price, orFair Trade pricing - they buy directly from the producer, no middle person involved.

This bar is made with only cacao, sugar and mini candied guava chunks dotted on top. The tropical fruit & rich dark chocolate are in perfect balance, giving you a little hint of the tropics in every bite without being overpowering.

name: Mission Chocolate 100% Bar, 60g
description: Mission has been working with chocolate since 2002, first as chocolate educators with Le Cordon Bleu in Los Angeles, then as chocolatiers with their own store in Berkeley, California, and now as chocolate makers in São Paulo, Brazil. Their chocolates are the most awarded in Brazil, with 50 national and international prizes in the last 5 years. They believe the best chocolate rewards everyone in the supply chain. Their farmers receive almost 4 times more than the market price, orFair Trade pricing - they buy directly from the producer, no middle person involved.

name: Mission Chocolate 58% Dark Milk Bar , 60g
tagline: with cocoa nibs & pink himalayan sea salt
description: Mission has been working with chocolate since 2002, first as chocolate educators with Le Cordon Bleu in Los Angeles, then as chocolatiers with their own store in Berkeley, California, and now as chocolate makers in São Paulo, Brazil. Their chocolates are the most awarded in Brazil, with 50 national and international prizes in the last 5 years. They believe the best chocolate rewards everyone in the supply chain. Their farmers receive almost 4 times more than the market price, orFair Trade pricing - they buy directly from the producer, no middle person involved.

name: Caffe Umbria Arco Etrusco, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Blended and tasted for drip coffee, it consists of beans from Brazil, Colombia and Mexico. Full bodied with low acidity, it has a long finish of sweet stout. We are proud to serve Arco Etrusco in our cafe for drip coffee.

name: Caffe Umbria Bizzarri, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. This signature blend was named after owner and master roaster Emanuele Bizzarri. A medium-dark roast, it consists of beans from Peru, El Salvador and Uganda. An incredibly versatile blend, the deep fruity acidity helps balance flavor when enjoyed with sweet milk or cream. Great for drip, French press, and pour over.

name: Caffe Umbria Gusto Crema, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Gusto Crema is their flagship blend. A medium roast that has been blended and tasted for espresso, it features beans from Brazil, Guatemala and Colombia. Creamy in body with a sweetness that lasts through the finish, it is the only coffee we use in our cafe for espresso. It is also fantastic in a French press ground fine and made strong.

name: Caffe Umbria Mezzanotte Decaf, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Mezzanotte (mid-night) is a dark roast decaf made with a blend of beans from Colombia and Costa Rica. It is creamy in body with notes of milk chocolate and hazelnut. Great for espresso, French press and pour over.

name: Caffe Umbria Terra Sana, 12oz
description: Founded in Seattle in 2001, Caffe Umbria selects only the best varietals from coffee growing countries to produce each of their proprietary blends. Tere Sana (Healthy Ground) is a medium roast that is certified organic and fair-trade. Blended with beans from small cooperatives in Mexico, Peru and East Timor, it is artfully blended to balance crisp acidity with deep notes of cocoa. Perfect for drip coffee.

name: Outer Dark Form and Void Flagship Espresso Blend, 12oz
description:
Outer Dark is a small roaster out of Tacoma, Washington that believes coffee is for everyone and embraces the utilitarian nature of coffee. while they put a lot of thought and energy into creating their unique version of the best possible cup, they mostly think coffee makes existing on this planet a lot more enjoyable. We agree!

Form and Void is their flagship espresso blend, bold and expressive, yet bright enough to shine through in any assortment of milk.

name: Outer Dark The Feels,12oz
description:
Outer Dark is a small roaster out of Tacoma, Washington that believes coffee is for everyone and embraces the utilitarian nature of coffee. while they put a lot of thought and energy into creating their unique version of the best possible cup, they mostly think coffee makes existing on this planet a lot more enjoyable. We agree!

The Feels roast runs dark, walking a fine line between being both bold and sweet while still highlighting the origin character.

name: Spella Caffe Espresso, 12oz
tagline: Small batch roasted by hand in Portland, OR
description:
Raised above his grandmother's European bakery in Chicago, Andrea Spella first knew espresso as the thick stuff brewed on a stovetop and drunk with pastry after school. This childhood ritual, steeped as it was in old-world tradition, isn't far from the espresso experience Andrea has cultivated over the past ten years in his caffè. Andrea works closely with family-owned coffee farms and co-operatives in India, Latin America, and Africa to ensure the highest quality of beans find their way to our roastery. Strong relationships with coffee growers are the foundation of Spella Caffè.

Beans are roasted in small batches?eleven pounds at a time?at their roasting spot in Southeast Portland. This method of roasting brings out the unique, inherent qualities of each variety, and allows them to find the sweet spot of each batch.

Rossalina Espresso has a thick, lush body, full of crema. It has nutty, caramel tones with a healthy amount of licorice and anisette.

Rossalina is the bean you'll find pulled on the espresso machines at our wholesale accounts - she's a beauty to work with!

name: Jaipur Avenue Masala Chai Tea Mix, 11.6oz
description: Great while at home, on the go, or in our cafe, Seattle based Jaipur Avenue's Chai Mixes are conveniently packaged in single serving pouches. To best enjoy this spicy and calming Chai, add hot water for a soothing chai, or cold milk and ice for a refreshing warm weather drink.

name: Olympia Coffee Big Truck Blend, 12oz
description: The roasters at Olympia Coffee devote constant attention to their Big Truck blend year round. Although the green coffee varietals change depending on the season & harvest period, the flavor profile remains the same - notes of sweet chocolate & ripe berries, with a dense, heavy body. Great for espresso or French press!

name: Olympia Coffee Little Buddy Blend, 12oz
description: Used at their espresso blend at Olympia Coffee's retail locations, this blend was named after a teenagers first car. Roasted and blended for an intense flavor and sweetness, it has notes of stone fruit & sweet chocolate. Perfect for your home espresso machine, or for French press brewed strong.

name: Olympia Coffee Morning Sun, 12oz
description: Morning Sun is Olympia Coffee Roasters version of a rich and delicious morning coffee. From their Colombian coffee producers, Morning Sun is their darkest roast, but you won't find any smoky flavors, just chocolatey and bold!

name: Olympia Coffee Northwesterly, 12oz
description: Northwest is best: especially where coffee's involved. Inspired by the Pacific Northwest’s specialty coffee scene, their newest, darkest roast captures the essence of warmth and nostalgia. Northwesterly Blend wraps you in comfort, whether brewed in your favorite mug or pulled as a rich, bold espresso.

name: Olympia Coffee Sweetheart, 12oz
description: Olympia Coffee San Sebastian coffees are part of the most complex coffee project they have undertaken. A project intended to develop lasting, quality-focused relationships between farmer and roaster. The Sweetheart roast profile is roasted just a little bit darker with a more developed body. This roast profile is ideal for espresso or a richer brewed coffee option.

tagline: This is an important sauce...seriously.
description: Simply put, these Bachan sauces are amazing. name: KariKari Garlic Chili Crisp, 16oz
description:
Husband and wife duo Rob Griset and Ruby Sparks developed the recipe for KariKari Garlic Chili Crisp in their tiny apartment on Seattle’s Capitol Hill in 2019. The pepper blend brings a compelling heat, while crisp bits of garlic, shallot, and peanut add crunchy texture and bold flavor. Rounded out with a hint of soy and mushroom for an umami finish, each bite is at once sweet, spicy, savory, and wonderfully complex.

After stirring the jar from the bottom, add a bit to your next stir-fry, rice bowl, or ramen for instantly elevated flavor. KariKari Garlic Chili Crisp also great with mac and cheese, fried eggs, roasted meats or veggies, or just about anything that benefits from a bit of heat and savory flavor. Try it yourself and see why it’s become an instant staff favorite – but be warned, you may find yourself with a new must-have condiment!

No high fructose corn syrup, no added starches, no added gums, and they don't water anything down. The result: more full-on flavor in each bite.

name: Momofuku Toasted Sesame Oil,
description: This pure, light toasted sesame oil puts the power in your hands. Subtle enough to know it's place with a dash & powerful enough to pack a punch with a glug for marinades & sauces. Think of this as both a cooking and finishing oil. It's perfect for enhancing marinades, salad dressings, rice dishes, and more!

name: Edmond Fallot Basil Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. With only 20 people working in their production facility, you can be assured that there is great care taken to create some of the best mustard, vinegar and pickles you will ever have. Made from black and brown mustard seeds and blended with fresh basil leaves, this mustard is extremely versatile in the kitchen. It's dynamic flavor allows it to be used simply on a sandwich or in your favorite cream sauce.

name: Edmond Fallot Black Currant Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. With only 20 people working in their production facility, you can be assured that there is great care taken to create some of the best mustard, vinegar and pickles you will ever have. This mustard is made by mixing together black and brown mustard seeds, verjuice, black currant cream, and dijon. These flavors meld together to create a mustard that has great texture and flavor. Perfect with roasted meats & in a vinaigrette.

name: Edmond Fallot Honey Balsamic Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. The piquancy of this mustard does not overpower the delicate sweet flavors of the balsamic and honey. Create a creamy vinaigrette, add to sauces, or use to marinate chicken.

name: Edmond Fallot Horseradish Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. This dijon packs a punch. Firey horseradish makes this mustard wonderful on a roast beef sandwich, mixed into a potato salad, or paired with seafood as a dip.

name: Edmond Fallot Mustard Seed Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. Assertive in flavor, but not overwhelming, it is perfect with Pate de Campagne and cornichons, or on a classic ham sandwich.

name: Edmond Fallot Peppercorn Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. The bright and spicy notes of green peppercorn are blended perfectly with dijon to create a delightfully pungent addition to any sandwich or burger. It is perfect in a sauce for a steak or roast, or whipped right into mashed potatoes.

name: Edmond Fallot Provencale Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. With only 20 people working in their production facility, you can be assured that there is great care taken to create some of the best mustard, vinegar and pickles you will ever have. This unique mustard combines tomatoes, red bell peppers, and Herbs de Provence to create a beautiful flavor to brighten any sandwich, white fish, or vinaigrette.

name: Edmond Fallot Tarragon Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. With only 20 people working in their production facility, you can be assured that there is great care taken to create some of the best mustard, vinegar and pickles you will ever have. This mustard is highly recognizable on our shelves due to it's vibrant green color. Fallot uses black and brown mustard seeds blended with fresh tarragon leaves to give it an extraordinary flavor. Perfect for dipping fresh vegetables, adding to potato salad, or for making a tarragon mustard cream sauce for chicken.

name: Edmond Fallot Walnut Dijon, 200g
description: Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. With only 20 people working in their production facility, you can be assured that there is great care taken to create some of the best mustard, vinegar and pickles you will ever have. This nutty, full-flavored mustard is great with anything savory. Made by mixing traditionally ground dijon mustard with walnuts from Perigord, France, it's flavor is one of a kind. Spread it on sliced chicken, a grilled gruyere sandwich, filet mignon, or create a beautiful vinaigrette.

name: Kozlik's Balsamic, Fig & Date Mustard, 250g
description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their Balsamic, Fig & Date is savory and sweet, with rich flavor of fruits, balsamic vinegar, sherry and vanilla. This mustard pairs well with pheasant, duck, sausages, charcuterie and in salad dressings.

name: Kozlik's Dijon Mustard by Anton, 250g
description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their classic Dijon is an every day mustard. Super creamy in texture with a pleasant heat, it is perfect for everything from sandwiches to salad dressings.

name: Kozlik's Horseradish Mustard, 250g
description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their Horseradish Mustard is made with hot white horseradish. Hot and spicy, it pairs well with roast beef, chicken, sausages, grilled meats and sandwiches.

name: Kozlik's Sweet & Smokey Mustard, 250g
description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their Sweet and Smoky mustard is a house favorite. Made with honey, hickory and garlic, it delivers that perfect barbeque taste. Try it with grilled sausages & peppers, or on a classic ham sandwich.

name: Kozlik's Triple Crunch Mustard, 250g
description: Kozlik's Canadian Mustard was established in 1948 and has remains family owned and operated to this day, producing hand-made mustard in small batches. Their recipe has not changed in over 60 years, nor has their commitment to sourcing the finest quality ingredients to make the best-tasting mustard possible. Their Triple Crunch is truly unique. Taste and texture come together in this blend of three different types of whole mustard seed, Canadian whisky and honey. Flavorful but not spicy, it is perfect as a rub on pork roasts, along side creamy pate or even with raw oysters.

name: Villa Jerada Chermoula Spread, 9oz
description: Medhi Boujrada, founder of Villa Jerada, has spent the past decade sharing his love for his native Morocco’s cuisine. His meticulously sourced spices and other ingredients can be found on the menus of Seattle restaurants such as Mamnoon and L’Oursin. Their flagship import, Atlas Olive Oil, has become a favorite of chefs, home cooks and the shelves at DeLaurenti. With an unflinching focus on quality and authenticity, Villa Jerada offers some of the finest Moroccan and Levantinian foods in Seattle. Their chermoula spread is an aromatic blend of sundried tomatoes, spices, and preserved lemon. Similar to tapenade, it can be used to season fish, meats, or vegetables, or enjoyed with cheese and crackers. A Good Food Awards 2021 Finalist, this savory, tangy spread is your secret to the taste of Morocco.

name: Villa Jerada Harissa Sauce, 170.1g
description: In every Moroccan Souk, store and home you will find this spicy condiment used as either a base for cooking, or as a garnish to add spice to your meal. Harissa remains a staple in the Moroccan kitchen, much like Ketchup, Tabasco or Siracha is for many American homes. Villa Jerada’s harissa stands out amongst other brands because of its unique flavor and quality. With beautifully red chilis, a half a preserved lemon and an abundance of organic Moroccan extra virgin olive oil in every jar, you will taste the difference. The applications of this amazing sauce are too numerous to list - vegetables, sauces, braised meats, soups...the list goes on. Any time you find yourself craving rich chili flavor with a bit of spice, just add some.

name: Villa Jerada Preserved Lemon, 380g
description: Villa Jerada Preserved Lemons are an essential Moroccan culinary tradition using small Beldi lemons, salt and time to give a bright citrus, complex umami flavor to a variety of dishes.

subtype: 아시아 소스/간장/미소 (Soy, Miso, Fish Sauce & Asian Sauces)
name: Villa Jerada Tahini, 16oz
description: Villa Jerada's Tahini is made from stone ground, small batch roasted sesame seeds, resulting in an extra creamy texture. It is a vital ingredient for hummus, but also can be spread over toast, whipped into smoothies, or baked into cookies.

name: Weak Knees Gochujang Sriracha, 10.5oz
description: Made by Bushwick Kitchen in Brooklyn, USA. The sweet-spicy flavors of a classic sriracha meet the fermented complexity of gochujang chile paste. Like nothing you've ever tasted - the perfect choice on anything where you would normally reach for traditional sriracha sauce. Breakfast sandwiches, eggs, dressings, fried rice, you name it.

name: Col. Pabst Worcstershire, 8oz
description: We were very excited to recieve this product a few years ago and it remains one of our favorite items in the store. This is NOT your usual bland Worcstershire sauce with wierd ingredients. This is a recipe that goes back generations and will be useful in your kitchen in many different ways!

name: Aardvark Habanero Hot Sauce, 8oz
description: Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC. A staff favorite, this sauce is made with habanero peppers and roasted tomatoes. Truly versatile, it makes a great topping for almost anything - pizza, french fries, sandwiches, fried rice or marinades.

name: Aardvark Serrabanero Green Hot Sauce, 8oz
description:
Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC.

Their Serrabanero Green Hot Sauce combines serrano and habanero chili with tomatillos, green tomatoes and spices to get the mythical flavor of Serrabanero. It is a tad spicier than you might expect for a green hot sauce but not at the expense of flavor.

name: Agostino Recca Anchovies in Olive Oil Tin, 50g
description: What began in the 1930's as a small family-run business has grown into one of the most recognized and well respected companies specializing in the canning of quality fish in Italy. These anchovies are carefully boned and filleted by hand and preserved in Sicilian olive oil. Use in sauces, on sandwiches, with pasta, or on pizza.

name: Benedicta Mayonnaise, 8.3oz
description: Benedicta Mayonnaise will give you the European tang you have been searching for since your last trip to France! This is NOT Hellmann's!

name: Black Garlic Molasses, 8.45oz
description: This black garlic molasses is a testament to the glories of aged foods. Through its heated aging process, black garlic loses the characteristic “bite” of fresh garlic, giving way to notes of caramel, tamarind, raisin, and balsamic. A bit sweet, a bit savory, and undeniably flavorful, it will add depth and complexity to just about any dish. It’s particularly tasty when paired with grilled meats, in burgers, or in stir fries.

name: Bonache Habanero, 6oz
description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Their Habanero Sauce is their flagship - mid-level heat, Belize-inspired hot sauce is made with sweet carrots, habanero peppers and lime juice. Great on eggs, tacos or on anything else you want to spice up!

name: Bonache Hatch, 6oz
description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Mild in heat, this sauce is made with the famous New Mexico Hatch chili pepper, fresh cucumbers and tomatillos. Great on everything!

name: Bonache Piri, 6oz
description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Hot and spicy, this Portuguese-style sauce is made with roasted tomato, Piri Piri peppers and lemon juice. Not for the spice-averse, it packs a punch.

name: Bonache Socorro, 6oz
description: Handcrafted in Ballard, USA, Bonache makes high quality, delicious sauces in small batches. Named after the town in New Mexico that the founder grew up in, this medium-high heat sauce is made with dried New Mexico chilies, fresh yellow radishes and lemon juice. Unique in flavor and great on everything!

name: Edmond Fallot Mustards 4pk, 100g
description:
Edmond Fallot has been an independently owned family business in the Burgundy region of France since 1840. With only 20 people working in their production facility, you can be assured that there is great care taken to create some of the best mustard, vinegar and pickles you will ever have.

Add an assortment of color and flavor to charcuterie trays and cheese boards with this collection of mustards from Edmond Fallot. Packaged in portion-sized jars, this four-pack includes dijon, honey-balsamic, blackcurrant and seed-style mustard. Sweet and savory, they're the perfect companion to crunchy crackers and cured meats.

name: Gabriele Rocchi Pistachio Spread, 230g
description: Gabriele Rocchi is an artisan baker in Firenze (Florence). He uses only the finest regional Italian ingredients in his batch made dolci. This spread is made using the finest ground Mediterranean Pistachios, sugar and EVOO for a delicous addition to any meal or dessert!

name: Garliki Fermented Garlic Culinary Paste Original, 170g
description: Simply put, GARLIKI "ORIGINAL" is a premium replacement for minced garlic. It is a versatile culinary "tool" crafted with just 3 ingredients: Garlic, Jacobsen Oregon Sea Salt, and Lime Juice. The much-loved flavor of garlic is transformed and intensified by using a spontaneous fermentation technique that leaves you with a savory cooking paste, ready for action!

name: Garliki Fermented Garlic Culinary Paste Umami, 170g
description: Garliki UMAMI will revolutionize your cooking experience, and we don’t make that claim lightly. The pungency and zing of fermented garlic is combined with ORGANIC CHICKPEA MISO (soy free!) to create a rich, slightly earthy, and intensely savory paste for a delightful culinary epiphany. Be prepared to take your favorite dishes to new places!

name: Garliki Fermented Garlic Culinary Paste with Herbs, 170g
description: Garliki HERBE is a robust blend of old world herbs and fermented garlic to create an instant fusion of flavor ready to apply to your favorite dishes. Goes great w/ bread, sauces, pizza, dips, dressings, veggies and more!

name: Guero y Maria Ghost Pepper Extra Hot Sauce, 5oz
description: Experience the fiery yet balanced flavor of Güero & María's Ghost Pepper Hot Sauce. Made with fire-roasted ghost peppers, chiltepin, onions, garlic, sea salt, and a blend of spices, this sauce delivers a bold heat with smoky undertones and a touch of savory depth. The roasting process enhances the natural flavors of the ghost peppers, creating a sauce that’s perfect for carne asada, grilled meats, and more.

name: Guero y Maria Habanero Hot Sauce, 5oz
description: Experience the fiery yet smooth heat and nuanced flavor of Güero & María's Habanero Hot Sauce. They carefully blend fermented habanero peppers from Becerra Gardens in Quincy, WA, with organic carrots, garlic, and onions, creating a sauce that’s intensely hot yet surprisingly balanced. The fermentation process mellows the raw heat of the habaneros, unlocking a complex profile with hints of natural sweetness and savory depth. Crafted with care, this sauce is a tribute to local ingredients and bold, authentic flavor!

name: Guero y Maria Salsa Verde Medium Hot Sauce, 5oz
description: Experience the vibrant flavors of Northern México with Güero & María's Salsa Verde. They blend fresh tomatillos, jalapeños, serranos, and smoky chiles de árbol with crisp onion, garlic, and hand-chopped cilantro. Their slow fermentation process unlocks layers of tangy, earthy, and smoky depth, creating a salsa that's both complex and craveable. Inspired by the rustic kitchens of Northern México, this salsa is a true taste of the region.

name: Les Moulins Mahjoub Traditional Tunisian Harissa, 6.5oz
description: Les Moulins Mahjoub, located in Tehourba, Tunisia, makes traditional products, mostly by hand. Their harissa, the classic Tunisian condiment, is made with all-natural, organic ingredients and gets its heat from roasted chili peppers. It’s seasoned with garlic, cardamom, salt, coriander, and extra virgin olive oil. The harissa has a grainy texture. Use it to add flavor, color, and heat to sauces or as a bold, vibrant condiment. Excellent with eggs, vegetables, and meats.

name: Maille Old Style Dijon Mustard, 207g
description: The vision of La Maison Maille is as true today as it was over 270 years ago - use the highest quality ingredients to create amazing flavors and memorable meals. This mustard is a key ingredient on your condiment shelf. Made with crisp, whole seeds, this mustard has a grainy texture and powerful punch. Perfect in sauces and marinades, with country pate, or on a classic ham sandwich.

name: Maille Original Dijon Mustard, 213g
description: The vision of La Maison Maille is as true today as it was over 270 years ago - use the highest quality ingredients to create amazing flavors and memorable meals. This traditional Dijon dates back to 1747! A indispensable ingredient on your condiment shelf, this classic mustard has a smooth, creamy texture and a pleasant heat. Perfect for chicken and fish recipes, on a sandwich or in dressings and marinades.

name: Mama Africa Pili Pili Sauce, 5oz
description: As the story goes, Mamy Monique Mpunga wa Muamba Miwa Tshilombo, Ntita Mukai, is the best cook ever. Coming from the Bakwa Bilonda Tribe in the Kasai Region of the Congo (DRC), thousands of miles away, in The heart of Africa, she inherited these recipes from her Mom, Mamu Mtongo wa Mfwamba, who we called "Mimi". In 1966 the recipe was refined the beautiful authentic African salsa that is call "pili-pili" or "Ndunga". Mama Africa will never eat without Pili-Pili on her table. She carries a jar with her at all times. Mama says "pili-pili will keep you warm and bless you with vitamins." She says also that the mosquitoes will never touch your spicy blood. Great hot sauce AND no mosquitos! Score!

name: Marshall's Bird's Eye Basil Sauce, 5oz
description: Fresh, glossy, peak-of-summer basil has an intoxicating perfume all its own, and this floral, fresh sauce is a celebration of that iconic warm-weather herb. To extract every last bit of basil’s powerful aroma, Marshall's steeps it in white balsamic vinegar, and then reduces it to a densely herbaceous elixir. Leeks add a hint of sweetness, while the slightly fruity Thai bird's eye chili and jalapeños add layer upon layer of chili fire to this versatile sauce. Perfect on eggs or in a Bloody Mary!

name: Marshall's Habanero Carrot Curry Sauce, 8oz
description: Bursting with lightly sweet heat, this balanced, goes-with-everything sauce is one of Marshall's most popular. Sunset-hued habaneros grown by Sunrise Organic farm pack serious heat, but they also have a strong fruity, floral quality. The famously hot peppers play well with fresh carrots from Winters Farm, while a bit of homemade mustard and turmeric enliven the already-vibrant color of this sauce.

name: Marshall's Heirloom Habanero Sauce, 5oz
description: This ultra-hot, straightforward habanero hot sauce is good to pour on just about anything! The simplicity of the sauce is all about the beautiful vibrancy of the beloved habanero pepper. This makes it a great match for pizza, burritos, or to spice up whatever you intend on eating!

name: Marshall's Red Chili Lime Sauce, 8oz
description: Inspired by sweet chili sauce, Marshall's red chili lime hot sauce incorporates the heat of red jalapeños from Sunrise Organics into the fruity sweetness of ripe tomatoes from Eloisa Organic Farm. Local honey from Portland-area hives add a hint of sweet, while a spritz of fresh lime brings it all into harmony. With a bold flavor and smooth texture, it’s ideal for pouring liberally on everything from avocado toast to bento bowls.

name: Marshall's Serrano Ginger Lemongrass Sauce, 8oz
description: Fragrant and well-rounded, this assertive hot sauce uses citrus to balance the heat of serrano peppers and bridge the aromatic qualities of ginger and lemongrass. Start slow and be forewarned...the serrano chili heat has a delayed fuse because of the power of the other ingredients. We love to serve this sharp, vegetal hot sauce with fish and poultry.

name: Marshall's Smoked Habenero BBQ Sauce, 8oz
description: This sauce won first place in The Scovie Awards! It was created by deconstructing traditional big name barbecue sauces, cherry-picking their favorite flavors and then eliminating common allergens (gluten, anchovies, Worcestershire, corn starch). Marshall's replicated and replaced them respectively with a carefully-chosen array of spices and locally-grown vegetables. Smoky, a bit spicy, with a lovely warmth from cinnamon and clove, this sauce is accessible to all BBQ fans while standing in a category all its own. From burgers to ribs to grilled chicken, use it anywhere you’d use your favorite barbecue sauce!

name: Marshall's Whiskey Smoked Ghost Pepper Sauce, 5oz
description: We love a good cocktail, and we love that Marshall's brings their favorite spirits into the hot sauce kitchen with them, too! Ol' Uncle Nearest distills Whiskey, and it's this whiskey that is used to develop this smoky, booze-kissed sauce. Onions get a long, slow roast in a mixture of Uncle Nearest 1856 Whiskey along with the addition of apple cider vinegar for sweetness & acidity. If that's not enough, dates and dried ghost peppers also get a nice long whiskey soak before combining all those liquored up ingredients for a silky-smooth, slightly smoky, fiery hot sauce with an unmistakable whisky bite . Try it on grilled meats or roasted root vegetables.

name: Martin Pouret Mayonnaise with Tarragon, 170g
description: Martin Pouret Tarragon Mayonnaise is a rich, artisan French condiment from Orléans made with free-range egg yolks, sunflower oil, signature Orléans mustard, and 5% fresh tarragon. It features a creamy texture with bright, sweet aniseed herbal notes.

name: Momofuku Mild Garlic Chili Crunch, 5.5oz
description:
Momofuku's Mild Garlic Chili Crunch is everything you love about their Original Chili Crunch, without the fiery kick. They amped up the garlic and onions so each bite is full of crunch and flavor.

Mellow, garlicky heaven. They packed this one with aromatics like crispy shallots, garlic, and onions to make the ultimate savory-crunchy oil. Then they added mild California chilis for a richer, rounder taste. These chilis add flavor, not fire.

name: Murder Hornet Black Label Hot Sauce, 5oz
description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

Bold, balanced, powerful. Black Label offers hot sauce enthusiasts a modern approach to ghost pepper heat. Complexity reigns supreme as the flavor profile begins slightly sweet, transitioning to citrus and umami notes that support that classic ghost pepper burn. Try it with ramen, burgers or wood-fired pizza. Naturally gluten-free.

name: Murder Hornet Blood Orange Agave Hot Sauce, 5oz
description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

An attractive blend of roasted habanero and red fresno chili peppers with bright citrus notes of blood orange, grapefruit and lime zest. Quickly becoming a crowd favorite, this versatile hot sauce boasts a rich flavor profile that covers your tastebuds like a warm tropical sunset. Ginger, mustard seed, and cumin add intriguing complexity after the sweet organic agave nectar prelude. Perfect for pork, shrimp tacos, baked salmon or fresh oysters. Naturally gluten-free.

name: Murder Hornet Honey Bourbon Hot Sauce, 5oz
description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

Roasted habaneros, red fresno chili peppers and black garlic create a deep and slightly smoky flavor that hits you with a savory sting. A sweet start of pure clover honey and brown sugar provides the prelude to the classic habanero back-end burn. Aged 4 years in American white oak barrels, the premium bourbon we select adds a refined depth while presenting the bridge between sweetness and heat. Try it on your eggs, steak, hamburgers, or mac 'n' cheese. Naturally gluten-free.

name: Murder Hornet Mango Verde Hot Sauce, 5oz
description:
Kevin and Ryan started making hot sauce in a test kitchen in Kirkland. What set's them apart? Quality ingredients, unrushed cooking techniques, just the right amount of heat & a perfect pour. They're sauces are great and by purchasing them, you are supporting real people doing great work!

Bright, balanced, tangy. Mango Verde is the preferred choice for those who enjoy a refreshing, subtly sweet addition to their favorite traditional verde cuisines. With an appropriate amount of mild heat, this is a hot sauce for the whole family. Try it on carnitas, fajitas, street tacos or eggs benedict.

name: New York Shuk Harissa BBQ Sauce, 14oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

A new American classic is born with their Harissa BBQ Sauce! Smokey from sun-dried chili peppers, and sweetened with Medjool dates, This finger-licking better-for-you sauce was created to help you build big flavors with ease, so you can spend less time in the kitchen and more time around the table.

One sauce, infinite uses - Marinate wings, ribs, salmon, brisket, tofu...flavor beans, roasted veggies, sandwiches, & burgers..dip fries, nuggets, and basically everything else!

name: Nong's Khao Man Gai Sauce, 12oz
description: Originally from Bangkok, Thailand, Nong moved to Portland in 2003 with $70 and two suitcases. Shortly after, she opened a small food cart designed to sell just one thing: Khao Man Gai. This traditional Thai chicken dish consists of poached chicken with Thai aromatics, rice and broth - it is served with a sauce made from fermented soy bean puree and mixed with garlic, ginger, thai chilies, vinegar and sugar. Garnished with a few pieces of cucumber & cilantro, it is a Thai staple. This is her handmade sauce, and the only sauce you can use to replicate this amazing dish. Its use does not stop there, though. It is also great as a marinade or a sauce with chicken, pork or fish.

name: Pistacchiosa Sicilian Pistachio Spread, 250g
description: Pistachios get the luxury treatment in this unbelievably smooth, sweet pistachio spread from Il Colle del Gusto. Extra-virgin olive oil lends a glossy sheen and velvety texture, but the flavor is all pistachio. The high percentage of Sicilian pistachio paste in this dreamy jarful makes for an intensely nutty flavor and aroma that enchants the second you pop open the lid. Pistachio lovers will want to eat it right out of the jar, but you can also use Il Colle del Gusto Pistacchiosa as you would chocolate sauce, spooned over fresh ricotta cheese or frozen yogurt or stirred into rice pudding.

name: Portlandia Foods Organic Ketchup, 14oz
description: Love ketchup but don't like not being able to pronounce all the ingredients on the back? Now you have a choice. Portland Ketchup is a game changer - tomato puree, vinegar, sugar, salt, onion, allspice and clove. Easy ingredients to pronounce, and good to eat. Use it whenever you crave some ketchup.

name: Portlandia Foods Organic Mustard, 13oz
description: Portland Mustard is a delightfully smooth and creamy reinvention of classic American yellow mustard with a hint of crushed black pepper. This is the perfect companion for your hot dogs, sausages, sandwiches, potatoes, or house-made dressings.

name: Queen Majesty Cocoa Ghost Hot Sauce, 5oz
description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. The result is really good hot sauce that is produced with care. Cocoa Ghost combines rich black cocoa powder with luscious pineapple, chipotle, and ghost pepper for a sweet, smoky depth and a remarkable, lingering heat. Perfect on tacos, burgers, and more, or mix it with your favorite BBQ sauce to make it sing! Very Hot!

name: Queen Majesty Hot Sauce Trinity, 6oz
description:
Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. The result is really good hot sauce that is produced with care.

Cant decide which one to try? Need a gift? Go for the Trinity Sampler! this set comes with 2oz bottles of the Jalapeno, Tequila & Lime, The Scotch Bonnet & Ginger and the Red Habanero & Black Coffee.

name: Queen Majesty Jalapeno, Tequila & Lime Hot Sauce, 5oz
description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. The result is really good hot sauce that is produced with care. The three ingredients on the label of this hot sauce say it all - jalapeno, tequila & lime. They highlight the chipotle morita pepper, a lightly smoked, ripe, red jalapeño, and the dried bean of the mesquite tree, which adds a subtle, flavorful nuttiness. Medium hot.

name: Queen Majesty Red Habanero & Black Coffee Hot Sauce, 5oz
description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. Balanced by subtle notes of coffee that give it a deep smokiness, it's excellent chilis and stews - also perfect to mix with ketchup for your burger & fries!

description: Queen Majesty hand selects the best ingredients available and makes their hot sauce every week in their commercial kitchen in NYC. name: Rancho Gordo Felicidad, 4oz
description: Rancho Gordo Felicidad Hot Sauce is a rich mix of pumpkin seeds and spices with the smoked chiles. It will almost make you think that there are tomatoes added, but it's all chile's that you're tasting!

name: Rancho Gordo Gay Caballero, 4oz
description: Rancho Gordo Gay Caballero is a blend of cinnamon and cloves along with zesty arbol chiles. Tasty, untamed and fancy just like you!

name: Rancho Gordo La Paloma, 4oz
description:
Rancho Gordo La Paloma is "Mild Sauce for Hot People!"

Not everyone wants to glow all the time. Sometimes a person just wants the flavor of chiles without all the perspiration.

name: Rancho Gordo Rio Fuego, 4oz
description: Rio Fuego is hot but not stupid hot. There are complex flavors and textures and it's a unique entry in the crowded world of hot sauces. Bold Chile flavor tamed by pumpkin seeds and vinegar!

description: This is the best tasting fish sauce in the world! name: Sable & Rosenfeld Olive Bruschetta, 454g
description: This is a flavorful blend of green olives, carrots, cauliflower, red bell pepper, celery and capers in olive oil. Perfect on sandwiches, grilled bread, pizza, salads, pasta, chicken or potato salad.

name: Salsa Espinaler, 3.11ml
tagline: Open a can of your favorite tinned fish...add a few glugs!
description: This classic Spainish appetizer sauce is great on everything. Once you go here, you don't go back. Douse your chips, olives, any tinned fish & salads. Mix it into marinades and dressings - it makes everything better!

name: Secret Aardvark Reaper Smoked Hot Sauce, 8oz
description:
Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC.

The heat intensity in their Reaper Smoked Hot Sauce will wake up your tastebuds but won’t melt your face! Well, maybe just a little. This is not a vinegar forward sauce, Aardvark Reaper Smoked Hot Sauce is a great addition to your red beans, burrito, pizza, and more! You’ll be surprised by how much you love the smoky heat!

name: Secret Aardvark Red Scorpion Fiery Hot Sauce, 8oz
description:
Secret Aardvark Trading Co. was founded in Portland in 2004. They started selling their hot sauce at farmers markets, and now their sauces can be found as far east as NYC.

Just like the genus of Scorpions, this hot sauce has a sting! Made with roasted tomatoes, carrots, and fermented scorpion peppers to add a sharp sourness. While it is a bit hotter than our flagship Aardvark Habanero Hot Sauce, we don’t sacrifice flavor for heat.

name: Sobelini Pizza Crunch Original, 170g
description: Sobelini Original Pizza Crunch was born in Italy to spice up the slice. Blending traditional Asian techniques with classic pizza toppings, it’s both new and familiar. A perfect mix of Calabrian chili flakes, fennel seeds, oregano, parmesan, and olive oil elevates any pie, and everything else.

name: Sobelini Pizza Crunch With Truffle, 170g
description: Earthy black porcini flavor mingles with that signature Sobelini heat and crunch. It’s a flex in a jar, drizzle it on white pies, risotto, pasta eggs, fries, whatever needs a spicy luxury-level glow-up. It’s giving: Nonna in a silk robe.

name: That Pickle Guy Hot Giardiniera, 16oz
description: A Chicago native moved to New Orleans and was desperate for some familiar food. Armed with some family recipes and a passion to create a winning giardiniera and muffaletta mix - That Pickle Guy was born. After leaving the corporate life, Greg Frederick put his small business ideas into motion. Beginning at farmer's markets in the Chicago area, The Pickle Guy is now found in dozens of stores across the country! So, what is giardiniera? Chicago-style, minced fresh pickled vegetables. Toss this into sauces, pasta, soups, chili, stir fry, roasts, sandwiches, pizza, hot Dogs, fajitas, salads or eggs...the options are endless!

name: Tutto Calabria Authentic Calabrian Chili Sauce, 250mL
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Tutto Calabria’s founding family, the Celli’s, have been harvesting Calabrian chilies since 1910. This hot and spicy sauce allows the Calabrian chilies to shine, imparting complex heat to any dish. Excellent with fish, chicken, or grilled vegetables, or as a dipping sauce for those who like some heat. Too hot for you? Just cut the sauce with a touch of olive oil, or mix it with mayonnaise for a spicy condiment!

name: Tutto Calabria Red Pepper Jelly, 7.7oz
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Their red pepper jelly is the perfect marriage of sweet and spicy without leaning too far into the heat. It pairs especially nicely with soft cheeses such as ricotta, but the applications are endless. Creamy cheese, smoked salmon, cracker…done.

name: Willamette Valley Mustards Hot'n Creamy Horseradish, 9oz
description:
Willamette Valley Mustard was founded and operated by the Barhyte family, and has been part of Oregon's agricultural and specialty food community since the 1980s. Jan and Susan Barhyte originally built the enterprise, which later expanded into a multi-generational, women-led legacy when Suzie Barhyte and her daughter-in-law Irene joined forces in 1995.

Willamette Valley’s Hot ’n Creamy Horseradish is a thick, smooth, German-style condiment designed to deliver a strong kick balanced by a rich, velvety texture. It is made with pure, freshly grated horseradish roots, and has an "extra-hot" profile. Perfect for meats, sandwishes, potato salad and adding to dips!

name: Xilli Cebollas Encurtidas, 10oz
tagline: Mayan-style Pickled Red Onions
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

In the Mayan region of Mexico, these pickled onions are a must-have for any of the Pibil dishes native to the region, including the famous Cochinita Pibil. They are tropically mild, citrusy, tangy and bright with just a hint of heat. They are a bright and tangy way to liven up anything from seafood, pork or anything with an avocado!

name: Xilli Chipotles Adobados, 10oz
tagline: Sweet & Tart Braised Moritas
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

In Nahuatl, chilpocli or XILLpocli means Chili (xilli), smoked (pocli), while Adobados can be translated as in adobo sauce, usually made with ground dry peppers, spices herbs, and vinegar. Ours comes braised until almost "spreadable." Slightly tart and sweet, super smoky, and supremely spicy. Elevate any dish; rub into meat, spread onto sandwiches, simmer into stews, or blend into cooking salsas.

name: Xilli Habaneros en Escabeche, 10oz
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

In the Mayan region of Mexico, this legendary, “tropical” version of pickled chiles is a staple to elevate the cuisine of the region to heroic levels.These are seriously hot, but also lightly floral. Use with finesse and subtlety in sandwiches, seafood dishes, or any Mayan food.

name: Xilli Jalapenos en Escabeche, 10oz
tagline: Herbed & Spiced Pickled Jalapenos
description:

Escabeche is the Spanish word for Pickle. In Mexico, these are standard in any fridge, restaurant or cantina. They are sour hot, tingly, spicy & crunchy. Perfect for sandwiches, tacos or straight from the jar!

name: Xilli Mayan Salsa Macha, 10oz
tagline: Dried Habaneros & Pepitas in Chili Oil
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

For their Regional Series, Xilli highlights some of the country's most unique, diverse, and culturally rich regions by emphasizing local ingredients, in this case, native chiles. 9 out of 10 on the hot scale, this Salsa Macha has dried habaneros, chipotle morita, yucatan herbs & Mayan honey & salt. Use it to enliven any of your favorite regional dishes, or to elevate your egg preparations, pizza, or even as a topping for tropical fruits.

name: Xilli Mole Negro, 10oz
tagline: True Oaxacan Mole
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

This Mole Negro is as mysterious as the name implies. It is mellow on the heat scale, but high on flavor. It's its own thing...pair it with anything from duck to chicken to eggs to rice.

name: Xilli Mole Poblano, 10oz
tagline: The Original Mole
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

The origin of the name mole reveals its prehispanic roots: 'mole' or 'molli' means 'sauce' in indigenous Nahuatl. Xilli's version of Mole Poblano contains 30 different ingredients and takes 5 days to make. Moderate in heat with a rich, bold, complex & decadent flavor, it is a dish unto itself. Great with poultry, eggs or rice.

name: Xilli Pipian Verde, 10oz
tagline: Pepita, Cilantro & Epazote Mole
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

The word Pepian derives from Pepita (Pumpkin Seed). This is a Classic green pepita and Mexican herb mole that will lift your spirits. Refreshingly mild, it is both herbaceous and nutty. A dish in itself. Pair it with poultry, eggs, or rice. Reduce it and use it as a dip.

name: Xilli Salsa Macha con Cacahuate, 10oz

description:

In Nahuatl culture, the term macho has a meaning separate from the Spanish term and can be translated as "one who is worthy of imitation," or "enlightened one". This Salsa is Macha for Machos. Addictively hot, it is at once nutty, smoky & spicy. The perfect enhancement for any dish; Eggs, Vegetables, Dumplings, Fried Rice, even Pizza.

name: Xilli Salsa Taquera, 10oz
tagline: Charred Tomatillos & Toasted Chipotles
description:
XILLI is a collection of authentic, traditional and artisanal Mexican Salsas, Moles, Escabeches and Adobos representing the country’s true culinary heritage. All of Xilli's preparations have been staples in Mexican kitchens for centuries - made by hand using only the freshest ingredients.

Tacos are the result of using tortillas as vehicles for almost any food. In Mexico, this salsa accompanies any variation. As its name implies, this indispensable salsa is the go-to in Mexican cuisine. It is sufficiently smoky with a twinge of tang, giving way to a warm but not smoking level of heat. Dollop generously on any taco or any other favorite food, Mexican or not.

name: Xilli Veracruz Salsa Macha, 10oz
tagline: Chipotle Meco & Coffee in Chile Oil
description:

The uses for Salsa Macha are only as limited as your imagination. Use this variation to enliven any of your favorite regional dishes, any roasted root vegetable, or try it as an unexpected accompaniment to a cheese plate.
