name: Dashfire Jerry Thomas Bitters, 100ml
description: Lee and Dawn Egbert started sharing their exceptional bitters with the world in 2013. Combining a passion for travel with a love of cocktails, they’ve created an extensive range of premium bitters inspired by flavors from around the globe. Dashfire’s own take on the classic, their J. Thomas bitters are citrusy, aromatic, and bitter, with notes of clove, raisin, rosemary, and gentian root. These bitters are perfect for a Clover Club or Rob Roy.

name: Dashfire Old Fashioned Bitters, 100ml
description: Lee and Dawn Egbert started sharing their exceptional bitters with the world in 2013. Combining a passion for travel with a love of cocktails, they’ve created an extensive range of premium bitters inspired by flavors from around the globe. Dashfire’s own take on the classic, it is rich in warming spices, and pairs especially well with barrel-aged spirits. We probably don’t need to tell you that an Old Fashioned is a natural cocktail choice for these bitters, but they would be just as good in a Manhattan or Allegheny.

name: Dashfire Sichuan Pepper Bitters, 100ml
description: Lee and Dawn Egbert started sharing their exceptional bitters with the world in 2013. Combining a passion for travel with a love of cocktails, they’ve created an extensive range of premium bitters inspired by flavors from around the globe. Inspired by the crown jewel of Sichuanese cuisine, the Sichuan peppercorn, these bitters pack an assertive punch – the unique, lip-numbing intensity of the peppercorns will add dimension to any cocktail. These bitters will spice up a Sidecare or Whiskey Sour.

name: Dashfire Spiced Apple Bitters, 100ml
description: Lee and Dawn Egbert started sharing their exceptional bitters with the world in 2013. Combining a passion for travel with a love of cocktails, they’ve created an extensive range of premium bitters inspired by flavors from around the globe. These bitters are like autumn in an eyedropper – just a dash will transport you to hay rides, corn mazes, and all the wonderful flavors of fall. Apple pie notes combine with cinnamon, clove, and allspice. Perfect for a fun twist on a Manhattan or Old Fashioned.

name: Dashfire Star Anise Bitters, 100ml
description: Lee and Dawn Egbert started sharing their exceptional bitters with the world in 2013. Combining a passion for travel with a love of cocktails, they’ve created an extensive range of premium bitters inspired by flavors from around the globe. Star Anise provides warming spice notes, along with hints of licorice and lemongrass. Try it in a Sazerac or La Louisiane, or in your next original cocktail creation.

name: Woodcutter's Douglas Fir Bitters, 100mL
description: For a true taste of the Great Northwest, look no further than these locally produced, organic Douglas Fir bitters. Forest Farmstead is a family-owned, sustainability-focused farmstead located in Rockport, Washington. Add a few drops of their Douglas Fir bitters to your cocktail or soda for a refreshing, bright note of evergreens. No matter where you live, with these bitters in hand the forest is only as far away as your liquor cabinet!

name: Aliseo Blood Orange Juice, 1L
description: Made with oranges grown near Mt. Etna in Sicily, Aliseo's Blood Orange Juice is all natural and NOT from concentrate. This juice makes a perfect addition to breakfast and brunch, either on its own, in a Mimosa or a cocktail.

name: Kimino Sparkling Yuzu Juice, 8.45oz
description:
The fine folks at Kimino are farmers and drink makers from Japan, following the "Kanso" philosophy, using only what is necessary. They hand pick seasonal fruits and use the naturally sourced water from the Hyogo mountains in the Kansai region to add to the flavor and texture. Yuzuis a round yellowish citrus fruit with fragrant, acidic juice used in cooking and libations all over in Japan.

The sparkling yuzu juice is made with hand-picked Yuzu from Shikoku Island, Hyogo region water and organic sugar cane. Fresh, crisp & refreshing!

name: Brioschi Effervescent Antacid, 250g
description: The days of discomfort after over eating are over. Well, we can't promise that, but Brioschi can make it better. Just dissolve into water, drink this bubbly beverage, take a walk around the block and you will be ready for dessert in no time!

name: Fee Brothers Aztec Chocolate Bitters, 4oz
description: Fee Brothers started in Rochester, New York in 1864. Now in their fourth generation, they are still making quality bitters, brines and cocktail mixes. Ancient Aztecs would celebrate with a bitter beverage made of cocoa beans, peppers & spices. Use a dash of Fee's Aztec Chocolate Bitters to expand the flavors of your cocktails and go full-Ancient-Aztec.

name: Jack Rudy Bourbon Cocktail Co. Cherries, 13oz
description: Jack Rudy Cocktail Co is a family run company focusing on reinventing classic staples of the American Bar. These Oregon cherries are soaked in bourbon, and are the perfect addition to any cocktail that uses whiskey. Don't feel like a cocktail? No problem. They are just as good enjoyed right out of the jar!

name: Jack Rudy Cocktail Co. Vermouth Brined Olives, 16oz
description: The Jack Rudy Cocktail Company is a family-run company based in Charleston, S.C., and Lexington, KY. They take long-forgotten staples of the American bar and reinvent them so we can enjoy cocktails from the golden age, as our grandparents might have. The small company got a huge boost when the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, GQ, and others praised their debut product Small Batch Tonic. They’ve since added many great products. Their Vermouth Brined Olives are premium cocktail olives in a brine of dry vermouth, juniper and coriander. The hearty olives are designed for classic cocktails and bloody mary’s. The flavorful brine also makes the best dirty martinis.

name: Jack Rudy Tonic Syrup, 17oz
description: Jack Rudy's Classic Tonic Syrup (formerly known as our Small Batch Tonic) is essentially a quinine concentrate. It’s designed to pair with your favorite Gin or Vodka, and is then stretched with soda water to make a bright, light, refreshing highball. With a backbone of quinine, culled from the Cinchona Tree, they've added a delicate mix of botanicals and then sweetened it with real cane sugar; the final product is a complex mixture that introduces a fine bitterness to any cocktail, and a great pairing with the botanicals of the finest Gins in the world.

name: Luxardo Maraschino Cherries, 400g
description: These cherries are the real deal. Produced the same way since 1905, they have no thickening agents or preservatives. Deep burgundy red in color, small, sweet and sour, they are a far cry from the electric red, processed maraschinos you found in your Shirley Temple as a kid. Without these cherries, no Manhattan is complete. Although ideal for cocktails, they are equally delicious right out of the jar, or spooned over ice cream and desserts.

name: Mexican Coke, 355ml
description: The real thing. Made with only pure cane sugar and served in a bottle. The way it was meant to be.

name: Orasella Maraschino Cocktail Cherries, 236g
description: Reclaiming the maraschino cherry and introducing modern drinkers to the traditional Italian recipe, free of preservatives, dyes, and other artificial ingredients. That’s the mission of the Seattle-based Orasella Maraschino Cherries. Made with local, Washington-grown cherries, the Evergreen State is the nation’s top cherry producer, Orasella Maraschino Cherries are harvested, prepared, and preserved by hand. Recognizable fruit flavored with pure maraschino liqueur. It’s that simple, that delicious.

name: Castelvetrano Olives
tagline: Hand-portioned by our deli!
description: These vibrant green beauties are the best-selling olive in our antipasti case, and with good reason. Plump, juicy, and bursting with bright, buttery flavor, they make a perfect accompaniment to antipasti, tapas, or your next charcuterie board. Packed in brine and with their pits intact, they will satisfy any salty cravings while still feeling fresh, bright, and light.

name: DeLaurenti House Mix Olives
tagline: Made in our kitchen - marinated in herbs, garlic & citrus
description: Our House Olive Mix! Made in our kitchen, this is a delicious blend of country olives, marinated in a blend of herbs, garlic and citrus. Great for snacking and antipasti! Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: Lucques
tagline: The best olive you've never had!
description: The best olive you've never had. If you are one of the ones who has, then you know. Firm & buttery with just the right amount of acidity, this is the perfect snacking olive. Enjoy them out of the brine or drain the brine and lace them with your favorite olive oil, lemon zest & a sprig of herbs.

name: Greek Mix Olives
tagline: Hand-portioned by our deli!
description: A handpicked blend of Kalamata, Mount Athos, and Mount Pelion olives. They are packed in brine with their pits intact, and seasoned with oregano and bay leaves. A very popular olive mix, this blend offers a fun variety of olives, and the seasoning is pleasant without being overbearing. These go great with feta, aged cheddar, hummus, or peppery salame.

name: Pitted Sicilian Olives
description: Kids can fit their little fingers in these babies and run around the house without the risk of poking themselves in the eye, you can use them in pasta, pizza, to make tapenade or drop in your Martini. Meaty, firm & mild, they are the skeleton key of olives.

name: Fratepietro Bella di Cerignola Olive, 500g
description:
The Fratepietro family business was founded in 1890 by Giovanni Fratepietro, and today is run by Giovanni’s great-grandson Andrea. He and his father Giovanni oversee the entire production process, ensuring these olives are among the best you can find on the world market. They are perfectly shaped Bella di Cerignola are carefully picked in October at ideal maturity, sorted by size and gently rinsed several times in a soda wash to take away any trace of bitterness. Finally they are soaked in a brine made with local salt from the nearby Margherita di Savoia nature preserve.

Bella di Cerignola is the largest olive in the world. Green or black in color, this typical Apulian variety has graced tables all over the world thanks to its high quality. Its cultivation has always been an important activity for Cerignola, a municipality in the province of Foggia, located in the north of Puglia, from which the fruit takes its name.

name: Moroccan Oil Cured Olives
tagline: Hand-portioned by our deli!
description: These unique olives are packed with flavor! Ripe black olives from Morocco’s Atlas Mountains are first dry-cured in salt, which concentrates their flavor and reduces any bitter notes. Then, the salt is removed, and the olives are soaked in oil. The result is a deeply flavorful, briny olive. They are drier in texture than most olives, but they retain a decidedly buttery characteristic.

name: Partanna Calabrian Chili Olives, 180g
description: Partanna's Calabrian Chili infused Castelvetrano olives are spicy and savory, bursting with flavors that will make you dream of lounging at their Sicilian farm. These mildlly spicy olives are gently preserved in a brine with Tarpani sea salt and a hint of Calabrian chili. The perfect pairing to any charcuterie or snack!

name: Partanna Castelvetrano Olives, 340g
description: There is no mistaking the bright green, meaty, buttery qualities of a good Castelvetrano olive. Grown in western Sicily, they are the perfect addition to your spread of cured meats and cheeses.

name: Partanna Pitted Castelvetrano Olives, 260g
description: There is no mistaking the bright green, meaty, buttery qualities of a good Castelvetrano olive. Grown in western Sicily, they are the perfect addition to your spread of cured meats and cheeses.

name: Partanna Sicilian Lemon olives, 180g
description: Partanna's delicious Sicilian Lemon infused Castelvetrano olives are sweet and savory all at once, bursting with flavors that will make you dream of lounging at their Sicilian farm. These little gems are gently preserved in a brine with Trapani sea salt and a hint of Sicilian citrus. The perfect pairing with charcuterie, martinis with a twist or straight out of the jar!

name: Antica Valle d'Ofanto Olive Mix in EVOO, 290g
description: A blend Cerignola, Nocellara, and Leccino olives ready to set in a bowl for cocktails or parties. These snacking olives are great on their own as an appetizer. When you finish the olives, and you will, use the oil!

name: Bio Orto Organic Pitted Peranzana Olives in Oil, 190g
description: These organic pitted Peranzana olives are preserved in their own cultivar's extra virgin olive oil to enhance their distinct flavor profile. Firm & rich, the olives are hand harvested in Italy's Puglia region in the heal of the boot. They are perfect for snacking & salads, but earn their keep as the indespensible olive for your famous puttanesca sauce!

name: Bio Orto Whole Organic Peranzana Olives in Brine, 350g
description: These organic, whole Peranzana olives from Puglia are carefully washed, immersed in a saltwater brine and left to cure for a year. Hand harvested with care, these olive firm in texture and packed with flavor. Remove them from the brine and marinate in your own way, add them as-is to your antipasti platter or remove the pits and add them to pasta or salads!

name: Partanna Muffuletta Mix, 550g
description: Italian Muffuletta you say? Yes. Invented by Sicilians in New Orleans and elevated by Sicilians in Castelvetrano. This muffuletta combines the best Sicilian olives and vegetables to create a salad that works perfectly with ANY sandwich!

name: Contadini Leccine Olives in Brine, 550g
description:
Leccine olives are one of Italy's most beloved varieties, and Contadini's come from the Salento area in Apulia. They hand-pick them at peak ripeness, between October and November.

The process is simple and patient: after harvesting, they keep them in brine for about 6 months to reduce bitterness, then jar them in water, unrefined salt, and lemon juice. With just a short ingredient list and no artificial preservatives, these olives let you experience the true flavour of Apulian Leccine. Small in size and with an intense fragrance of freshly pressed oil, they're perfect as pizza toppings, in salads, or served during an aperitivo.

name: Contadini Termite di Bitetto Olives in Brine, 550g
description:
Known as "apple olives" for their size and roundness, these olives boast a full-bodied texture that pairs perfectly with aperitifs and fish dishes. Grown in the heart of Apulia's olive groves, near Bari, they are hand-harvested using time-honoured methods between October and November.

They are then preserve in brine for 6 months to remove bitterness without using artificial preservatives. The result is the beautiful Termite di Bitetto olive - a simple olive with a flavour that balances sweetness and pleasant acidity.

name: Divina Castelvetrano Olives, 7oz
description: The Castelvetrano has quickly become one of the world's most sought-after varietals. Native to Sicily, these olives are cured without fermentation and kept refrigerated, a key step that locks in its bright, emerald-green color and sweet, mild flavor. Be careful of the pit on these one's!

name: Divina Blue Cheese Olives, 13oz
description: These big green olives are hand-picked and stuffed with a creamy blue cheese! Perfect on their own or try them out in your next Bloody Mary!

name: Divina Cracked Green Olives, 6oz
description: Cracked with a stone during curing, these young green olives are mild, grassy and firm. Remove the pit all together and make tapenade, take them out and marinate them in olive oil & herbs of your choosing, or simple enjoy them right from the jar.

name: Divina Feta Cheese Olives, 13oz
description: Feta cheese and big green olives, is there a better mix? We love these olives, salty and savory stuffed with rich creamy Feta.

name: Divina Garlic Stuffed Olives, 13oz
description: Zesty pickled garlic complements plump, fruity Halkidiki olives from Mt. Athos in this savory snack. These olives are a great way to crank traditional Mediterranean flavors up a notch in a hearty farro salad or alongside cheese, hummus and pita.

name: Divina Greek Olive Mix, 6oz
description: Can't decide which olives you feel like? No need to. This is a delightful medley of Greek olives - Kalamata, Mt. Athos, Mt. Pelion Blond & Black, Gordal, and Nafplion - all in aromatic wild herbs. Easy-to-serve, even easier to enjoy.

name: Divina Kalamata Olives, 6oz
description: The iconic olive for pizza, pasta or salad. Firm and meaty, these beauties are estate grown and imported from Greece's Peloponnese Peninsula. Cultivated and naturally cured the way they were centuries ago - entirely without pesticides, coloring, or additives. These fruity, full-bodied, organic olives are a pantry staple.

name: Divina Marinated Feta & Olives, 360g
description: Divina's Greek Feta marinated with smoky and fruity olives is the perfect start to any happy hour or cheese board. And if that wasn't enough, it's wonderful tossed into grain bowls or chopped and stuffed into an avocado with some hot sliced peppers!

name: Divina Organic Pitted Green Olives, 6oz
description: These pitted green olives are organic, fruity and full-bodied. Estate grown and imported from Greece's Peloponnese Peninsula, they are cultivated and naturally cured the way they were centuries ago - entirely without pesticides, coloring, or additives. Essential in Greek salads, great on pizza, and perfect for your puttanesca sauce.

name: Divina Pitted Kalamata Olives, 6oz
description: These pitted Kalamata olives are fruity and full-bodied. Estate grown and imported from Greece's Peloponnese Peninsula, they are cultivated and naturally cured the way they were centuries ago - entirely without pesticides, coloring, or additives. Essential in Greek salads, great on pizza, and perfect for your puttanesca sauce.

name: Divina Smoked Kalamata Olives, 7.8oz
description: These wood-smoked Kalamata olives are packed with flavor! Deeply smoky and delightfully fruity, you're sure to love these in a grilled chicken salad with Feta, tossed into a bean or turkey chili or puréed with garlic and capers into a tapenade.

name: Divina Spicy Bloody Mary Olives, 13oz
description: The classic brunch cocktail just got turned on its head with the creation of a savory, robust and fiery Bloody Mary brine that’s matched up with Divina's classic pitted Mt. Athos green olives. And yes, once you've enjoyed the olives, the brine can go straight into your cocktail!

name: Divina Spicy Buffalo Blue Cheese Olives, 13oz
description: Break out the carrots and celery and get ready to harness your inner Buffalo spice in these fun and unique blue cheese stuffed olives. They are poppable and perfect in a Bloody Mary or served with wings!

name: Divina Sundried Tomato Stuffed Olives, 7.8oz
description: Hand-stuffed with savory sundried tomotoes, these olives are rich, robust and juicy. Try them paired with pasta or grain salads or for garnishing your Bloody Mary!

name: Donostia Anchovy Stuffed Olives, 7oz
description: Donostia brings the culinary culture of Donostia-San Sebastián to kitchens across the United States with their line of select ingredients for authentic pintxos and tapas. The sought-after Manzanilla is a straw-colored, plump, and meaty olive great for stuffing. Donostia’s olives are handpicked in Andalusia, naturally fermented, and cured in the Sevillian style. These ones are stuffed with minced anchovies from the Bay of Biscay. The umami flavor of the anchovies makes these olives pop. Marvelous on their own or as part of your antipasto tray.

name: Donostia Blue Cheese Stuffed Olives, 7oz
description: From the south of Spain, these firm, extra fancy grade Manzanilla olives are the real thing. Stuffed with Spanish blue cheese, these are perfect along side cured meats and cheeses, or as a light appetizer with a cocktail.

name: Donostia Lemon Paste Stuffed Olives, 7oz
description: Donostia brings the culinary culture of Donostia-San Sebastián to kitchens across the United States with their line of select ingredients for authentic pintxos and tapas. The sought-after Manzanilla is a straw-colored, plump, and meaty olive great for stuffing. Donostia’s olives are handpicked in Andalusia, naturally fermented, and cured in the Sevillian style. The lemon-paste stuffing adds a pleasant tartness to the olive. These make an impressive martini or bloody mary garnish.

name: Donostia Piquillo Olives, 49oz
tagline: The Tower of Olive Power!
description: From the south of Spain, these firm, extra fancy grade Manzanilla olives are the real thing. Stuffed with roasted Spanish piquillo peppers, these are perfect along side cured meats and cheeses, or of course dropped into a dry Martini. This tower of power ensures your status as an olive immortal.

name: Donostia Piquillo Olives, 7oz
description: From the south of Spain, these firm, extra fancy grade Manzanilla olives are the real thing. Stuffed with roasted Spanish piquillo peppers, these are perfect along side cured meats and cheeses, or of course dropped into a dry Martini.

name: Espinaler Anchovy Stuffed Olives, 12oz
tagline: Try these with Espinaler Sauce!
description: These pitted Manzanilla olives are plump, mild and stuff with a generous portion of anchovy paste. Why do it your self when Espinaler has already done it for you? Great as a snack to boost your sodium stores - you can't have your calves cramping at cocktail parties folks! Spice them up with Espinaler's famous hot sauce!

name: Filthy Piri Piri Stuffed Olives, 8.5oz
tagline: Perfect for your Bloody Mary!
description: These naturally cured queen olives are hand stuffed with care in Miami, FL with a red flame Piri Piri pepper, making them the near perfect accoutrement to your famous Bloody Mary!

name: Iliada Organic Jumbo Green Olives, 370g
description: These big fat Greek green olives are handpicked from organic olives groves. They have a firm crunchy-like texture and bright flavor. Great right out of the jar, or pitted and thrown into salads & pasta. Also perfect for marinating in olive oil, herbs, garlic and citrus.

name: Dequemana Arbequina Olives, 12oz
description: Dequemana Arbequina Olives are on the small side but they have a big distinctive flavor! Catalunya's olive of choice, they are also used very often to produce incredible Spanish Olive Oil!

name: Dequemana Empeltre Olives, 12oz
description: Dequmana Black Empeltre Olives are picked ripe and cured for 12-14 months to make a slightly sweet flavor. Very full and ripe, these are certainly a unique olive!

name: Dequemana Gordal Olives, 12oz
description: Dequemana Gordal Olives are perfect for that person who loves a big meaty olive! One of Spain's larger olives, these will be a hit on your Spanish charcuterie board!

name: Dequemana Mixed Olives, 12oz
description: Dequemana Mixed Olives are one of our favorite's here at the shop! A unique blend of several Spanish Olives that are marinated in Vinegar with Red Pepper and Garlic, savory for sure!

name: Regalis 5 Olive Mix, 345g
description: Can't decide which olive to get? Problem solved! This olive mix is a selection of uniquely traditional Spanish olives. Containing Natural Gordal, Manzanilla, Verdial, Cuquillo, and Cornicabra olives, this jar offers a mix of sizes, colors, textures, and flavors. A neutral brine perfects the ratio of saltiness to bitterness without compromising the flavor profile of each distinct variety they feature.

name: Regalis Cracked Verdial Olives, 345g
description: These verdial olives are cracked and marinated in smoked pimenton & laurel. The verial olive's firm, buttery flesh is packed full of flavor and ready to hit your tapas platter.

name: Regalis Hot Piri Piri Stuffed Gordal Olives, 345g
description: Large Gordal Olives are stuffed with small vibrant red piri piri north African chili peppers resulting in a deeply spicy, salty kick. Great on your antipasti platter or as a garnish in your Bloody Mary!

name: Regalis Orange Stuffed Gordal Olives, 345g
tagline: Sarah's Favorite...she has great taste!
description: Sweet Navelina Orange rind is peeled and inserted into each olive creating a sweet, citrusy, umami packed wonder! Perfect for snacking or as a cocktail olive!

name: ItalBrand Caperberries, 15.9oz
description: Caperberries are the larger, pickled fruit of the caper bush, offering a milder, more olive-like flavor than capers. These preserved in brine and are perfect for salads, as a garnish for dishes like paella or seafood, or in cocktails. Their taste is briny and tangy with a crunchy texture, pick them up by the stem and eat them just like an olive!

name: ItalBrand Non-pareile Capers, 16oz
description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Non-pareile (unparalleled) are the smallest and most desired variety. Firm in texture with a bright, briny flavor, capers are essential such dishes as veal piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. Give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

name: ItalBrand Non-pareile Capers, 3.5oz
description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Non-pareile (unparalleled) are the smallest and most desired variety. Firm in texture with a bright, briny flavor, capers are essential such dishes as veal piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. Give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

name: Italbrand Non-pareils Capers in Sea Salt, 800g
description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Non-pareile (unparalleled) are the smallest and most desired variety. Firm in texture with a bright, briny flavor, capers are essential such dishes as veal piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. These capers are preserved in sea salt - give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

name: ItalBrand Surfines Capers, 32oz
description: Capers are the unopened flower buds of the spiny shrub Capparis spinosa. Surfines (vs non-pareils) are slightly larger, from 7-8mm, and have a more robust flavor and a slightly crunchier texture, making them a good choice for sauces and dishes where the caper's flavor is a bit more pronounced. They are perfect such dishes as veal or chicken piccata, tartar sauce, or pasta puttanesca. Give them a quick rinse, use them liberally and refridgerate after opening.

name: Agostino Recca Caperberries, 490g
description: The fruit of the caper bush, caperberries are brined and oftentimes used like you'd use olives or pickles. Serve as garnish alongside antipasti dishes or drop them into a cocktail. More mild in flavor than capers, these caperberries can be used as a more subtle substitute in a variety of recipes.

name: Agostino Recca Capers in Salt, 500g
description: Agostino Recca isn't just about anchovies & fish. They are also about all the things that go with them. These salted capers are a perfect example. Firm, flavorful and preserved in sea salt, they are the essential ingredient in your pasta puttanesca, veal/chicken piccata or your bagel & lox.

name: Barral A La Provencale, 37cl
description: Barral Provencale Olives are a spicy mix of olives marinated with green peppers, pickles, and onions. Perfect for any charcuterie platter!

name: Barral Lucques, 37cl
description: Barral Lucques Olives are larger, meaty and have a particular sweet flavor. Very mild with basically no acidity, they are great to have with pate or crushed in a salad.

name: Barral Oil Cured Olive, 37cl
description: Barral Oil Cured Olives are harvested when ripe and dry-cured. They are mixed with olive oil and tossed with Provence herbs, becoming salty and aromatic!

name: Barral Picholine, 37cl
description: Barral Picholine Olives are a small meaty olive known for their firmness, nutty flavor, and shiny skin. Maybe the most famous of all French Olives, these are perfect with any Charcuterie.

name: Caravaglio Capers in EVOO, 200g
description:
Stunning Aeolian Island sunshine and sea breeze aromas abound in this jar. Precious Salina capers grown on the island of Salina, just off the northern coast of Sicily are heralded for their fragrant bouquet and delicate crunch. These prized flower buds are hand-harvested at optimal plumpness, then carefully sorted. The capers are set to dry for a few days in the sun, and then packed under sea salt where they undergo lactic fermentation. After 10 days, the capers are cleaned and packed again under new sea salt to age for an additional two months, allowing their floral flavor to blossom. They are then jarred and preserved in in extra virgin olive oil, salt, and wine vinegar, along with aromatic oregano and bay leaves.

Spoon Caravaglio capers straight out of the jar over grilled fish, roast chicken and sliced pork loin. Wonderful as a sauce to any seafood pasta dish, as well as the perfect condiment to pasta and rice salads.

name: Casina Rossa "Lilliput" Capers in Wine, 110g
description: Welcome to Gulliver's Travels folks. These Lilliput capers are the prize variety of capers. Tiny, rare, and delicate, they have a tangy flavor, and a firm texture. Preserved in a combination of white wine and prosecco, they are perfect for salads, bagels & lox, veal or chicken piccata and of course your pasta puttanesca.

name: Casina Rossa Caperberries in Wine, 180g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these caperberries are immersed in brightly-flavored prosecco. These are perfect for garnishing fish, meats, poultry and antipasti platters. These are also an excellent alternative to olives in your favorite cocktail.

name: Casina Rossa Caperberries in Wine, 110g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these caperberries are immersed in brightly-flavored prosecco. These are perfect for garnishing fish, meats, poultry and antipasti platters. These are also an excellent alternative to olives in your favorite cocktail.

name: Casina Rossa Capers in Sea Salt, 70g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these non-pareil capers are preserved in sea salt and ready to jump into action. Pasta, chicken, veal, bagels/lox, salads...you name it!

name: DeLaurenti Blue Cheese Olives, 10oz
description: It's a mystery...how do they get the blue cheese in there? We don't ask questions, we just enjoy the olives. These beautiful, firm green olives are a perfect addition to your antipasti platter or your Bloody Mary!!

name: DeLaurenti Blue Cheese Olives, 5oz
description: It's a mystery...how do they get the blue cheese in there? We don't ask questions, we just enjoy the olives. These beautiful, firm green olives are a perfect addition to your antipasti platter or your Bloody Mary!!

name: DeLaurenti Garlic Stuffed Olives, 10oz
description: Try our house brand Manzanilla olives stuffed with garlic! Handstuffed and handpacked, these olives are perfect in a mediterranean salad, on an antipasti platter, or dropped into a Bloody Mary.

name: DeLaurenti Pimento Stuffed Olives, 10oz
description: Our house brand Manzanilla olives stuffed with pimento! Hand stuffed and hand packed, they are the absolutely perfect Martini olive. The only question is whether or not you take 1 or 2.

name: DeLaurenti Triple Stuffed Olives, 5oz
description: Can't decide on what you want stuffed in your olives? Now there is no need. These beautiful Spanish green olives are ripe, firm and meaty and stuffed with either onions, pimento or almonds. Great in a martini or for simple snacking.

name: DeLaurenti Vermouth Olives, 5oz
description: Our house brand Manzanilla olives soaked in dry vermouth! The perfect olive for your cocktail!

name: Jack Rudy Cocktail Co. Vermouth Brined Olives, 16oz
description: The Jack Rudy Cocktail Company is a family-run company based in Charleston, S.C., and Lexington, KY. They take long-forgotten staples of the American bar and reinvent them so we can enjoy cocktails from the golden age, as our grandparents might have. The small company got a huge boost when the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, GQ, and others praised their debut product Small Batch Tonic. They’ve since added many great products. Their Vermouth Brined Olives are premium cocktail olives in a brine of dry vermouth, juniper and coriander. The hearty olives are designed for classic cocktails and bloody mary’s. The flavorful brine also makes the best dirty martinis.

name: Marino Farms Wild Harvested Salted Capers, 6.4oz
description: For almost 10 years the Marino family has been producing amazing extra virgin olive oil and fresh herbs from their distinctive territory in Sicily, and in 2018 they began harvesting local fresh capers and salting them with Trapani Sicilian sea salt. We feel lucky to have them on the shelves and in our kitchen!

name: Petricor Caviar Olives, 100% Taggiasca Olives in Brine, 200g
description: These small and delicate olives are 100% Taggiasca and are hand selected and harvested and processed on the same day. The olives are washed for a month with just water and then continue to ferment in brine, along with thyme and bay leaves. These olives are made naturally, in an ancient tradition of preservation and without the use of starters, chemicals or preservatives. This results in delicate olives produced according to traditional techniques. These olives are an elegant addition to antipasto, cheese plates, tinned seafood, and smoked meat platters. They pair perfectly with white meat like rabbit - a true Ligurian delicacy.

name: Ritrovo Selections Mixed Olive Salad, 280g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is a delicious mix of Leccino, Nocellara del Belice, and Cerignola olives. Great for antipasti, parties and snacking!

name: Ritrovo Selections Olives al Balsamico, 280g
description: These Ritrovo Selections olives by Casina Rossa are bathed in aged balsamic and ready for snacking! These firm, rich green olives have a delicate balance of salt, sweet & sour. Perfect for antipasti, with cheese & charcuterie.

name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Hot Pepper, 280g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with Italian hot peppers. The balanced spice makes these olives perfect for the cocktail hour with a crisp pale ale.

name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Lemon, 280g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with fresh lemon rind. With notes of bright citrus, these olives compliment cooked dishes as well as martinis.

name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Truffle, 280g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with flecks of aromatic truffle. The savory and earthy truffle flavor makes these olives an excellent snack for cocktail hour.

name: Tutto Calabria Hot Pepper Stuffed Olives
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. Take that pepper expertise and put in a ripe, firm green olive grown in Southern Italy, and here's what you get. Great for antipasti, snacking & cocktails!

name: Villa Jerada Dry Cured Olives, 200g
description: Experience the essence of Morocco: Villa Jerada's dry-cured black Beldi olives are hand-harvested, sea-salt cured, and finished with olive oil. Elyse tried them and fell in love. The only cured olives she has ever loved!

name: Villa Jerada Non-Pareil Moroccan Capers, 200g
description: Handpicked from Morocco's lush Safi region, Villa Jerada capers deliver an unmatched balance of tangy, briny, and zesty flavors - perfect as a garnish or to elevate salads, seafood, and sauces.

name: DeLaurenti House-made Lasagna
tagline: Made with care in the DeLaurenti kitchen!
description:
Lets face it...the only lasagna that is truly enjoyable to eat is the lasagna you make yourself. It's not complicated, but it takes time. Most of the time, time you do not have. We're here to help. Rather than picking up a box of Stoeffer's at the store by your house, you can now enjoy a lasagna made with care in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen. House-made sauce, fresh pasta, the best ricotta, and with the option of meat or veg. The only thing you need to do is set aside an hour to bake it!

serves 2 to 4, 6x6x2.5, apx 3#

name: Tirrena Caserecce, 500g
tagline: Made with 100% Tuscan Wheat!
description:
The Frescobaldi family has embodied the traditions of Tuscan culture, wine & olive oil for well over 1000 years. This pasta is crafted exclusively on the Frescobaldi Estates and comes from the best terroir for growing ancient grains. Cool soils, a mild climate and breezes from the Tyrrhenian Sea give the finished product it's unique character.

Tirrena is a semi-whole durum wheat semolina pasta. Therefore, it is rich in fibers, polyphenols and vitamins. This guarantees its superior nutritional qualities and high digestibility. Bronze drawn and dried for over 72 hours, the pasta has a distinctive hazelnut color and an extraordinary ability to absorb flavor.

description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of smoked mozzarella, asiago and garlic. Wrapped with fresh egg pasta, it's perfect with a light tomato sauce.

name: DeLaurenti Spinach & Cheese Ravioli, 8oz
description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of fresh chopped spinach, fresh ricotta, Parmigiano Reggiano and pecorino romano, with a hint of nutmeg and spices. Wrapped with fresh spinach on one side, and egg pasta on the other, it is perfect with a light red sauce.

name: Sfoglini Bigoli, 1lb
description:
Bigger and better than Spaghetti, Bigoli originated in the Veneto region of Italy around the early 1600’s when Bartolomio Veronese, aka Abbondanza ("Abundance"), patented the first press for making Bigoli. Bigoli is thicker than spaghetti, providing more rough surface area for holding sauce. This makes Bigoli a popular option for rich meat sauces with wild game ragù and according to tradition, is often eaten - in salsa - with onions, fish and seasoned breadcrumbs.

This pasta was crafted using a bronze die extrusion process that creates a rougher surface for the sauce to cling to. It’s made with premium organic semolina flour, milled from the heart of durum wheat. This type of flour has been a staple in traditional Italian pasta for centuries and helps to create pasta that holds its shape and delivers the perfect al dente bite.

name: Sfoglini Cascatelli, 1lb
description: Three-time James Beard Award winner Dan Pashman, creator and host of The Sporkful food podcast, presents Cascatelli. Translating to "waterfalls" in Italian, Cascatelli features wavy ruffles along a curved, half-tube shape. ach feature of Cascatelli was thoughtfully designed to bring about these perfect pasta qualities. For example, the ruffles and half-tube shape capture more sauce in every bite, and the variations in textures create a more exciting sensory experience. Additionally, Cascatelli is made using a bronze die extrusion process that creates a rougher surface for the sauce to cling to. This isn't a TV gimmick, this is the real thing.

name: Sfoglini Vesuvio, 1lb
description: Meet Vesuvio, brought to you by the artisans at Sfoglini and Dan Pashman, three-time James Beard Award-winner and creator and host of The Sporkful food podcast. This unique pasta mimics the swirling, spiraling contours of the volcano Mount Vesuvius in Naples, Italy. Vesuvio’s ridges and spiral shape create multiple surfaces where the sauce can cling, ensuring that each bite is bursting with flavor. Like all Sfoglini pasta, it has also been bronze die extruded, a process that imparts a rougher surface texture that holds onto sauce. This pasta is made with durum semolina flour, a staple in traditional Italian pasta for centuries. Durum semolina helps to create pasta that holds its shape and delivers the essential al dente texture for a better bite. Not a TV gimmick, this pasta is the real thing.

description: Made locally and delivered fresh, this ravioli is a combination of fresh oven roasted butternut squash, sauteed onions and a touch of Parmigiano Reggiano. Wrapped with traditional fresh egg pasta, it is perfect with brown butter and sage sauce.

These pasta sheets are the perfect solution for situations like this. Just make a nice filling and start building. Not thin enough for you? Just run them through your home pasta roller and you are set. You say you want to make the best lasagna ever? These pasta sheets are your ticket. Just cut them lengthwise down the middle, parboil the pasta strips for 30 seconds, rinse and lay them flat. Three strips fits perfectly width wise in a 9 x 13 inch full size lasagna pan - creating one layer. Trim the ends and keep on going. Roll the sheets and cut them to any width you would like. Can't use it all? Freeze them! You see where we are going with this - you need these.

description: A DeLaurenti staff favorite! Handcrafted right here Seattle, Lagana Pasta makes fresh, extruded pasta with sustainably-grown Shepherd’s Grain flour and water. All of their cuts provide a delicate base for all of your favorite sauces.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Pici, 250g
description:
A rustic, very thick pasta originating from Siena, Tuscany, Pici is similar to spaghetti, but much more substantial. The hearty strands are twirled into elegant nests, perfect for soaking up flavorful sauces. Pici is best enjoyed in wintertime, as the pasta shines with rich pairings such as meat ragù, Porcini Mushroom Cream, or garlicky tomato sauce. For a classic Tuscan touch, try alle briciole - tossed with crispy breadcrumbs sautéed in olive oil.

Cooking tiime 20-22 minutes

name: DeLaurenti Gnocchi, 16oz
description: There are few things better than homemade gnocchi. That said, there are times when you want the enjoyment of eating them, without the requisite effort. These gnocchi are for just such an occasion. They cook quickly and can be combined with a myriad of sauces. Some of our favorites - brown butter & sage, tomato cream, and gorgonzola! Keep them in the freezer and have them at the ready!

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Anellini, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Anellini, or "little rings," is one of the first shapes of pasta children learn to eat in Italy. For soups, it is wonderful in just clear chicken broth or beef broth with a poached egg and topped generously with Parmigiano-Reggiano.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Bucatini, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Bucatini is essentially a thick spaghetti noodle with a pin hole running through the middle. It also happens to be one of the best selling cuts of pasta in our store. It is the essential cut for Bucatini All'amatriciana - the classic sauce made with tomatoes, pancetta and red pepper and finished with Pecorino Romano. Not surprisingly, there is a recipe for this sauce in our cookbook, and all the ingredients are available in our store!

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Calamarata, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Cut to resemble rings of calamari, this pasta is very famous in Campania and Southern Italy. Serve with a spicy calamari sauce, and cut the calamari in wide rings mimicking the pasta for a unique effect. It is also delicious with any fish or meat ragu.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Cannelloni, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Cannelloni, meaning "large reeds" in Italian, are usually large sheets of pasta rolled around stuffing and then baked. After World War II, the shape became very famous in the US as Manicotti. No need to par boil these - simply stuff the pasta with your desired stuffing, cover with Béchamel sauce or tomato sauce and bake for 40 minutes.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Cannolicchi, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Cannolicchi are typical razor shells from clams of the Adriatic Sea. This short tube pasta mimics that shape. It is a tight, twisted flat strip of pasta with edges that keeps its beautiful shape once cooked, capturing the sauce in the middle. Serve with clams, mussels or any shellfish sauce. Use in fish soups instead of crostini or potatoes. Also wonderful with pesto and string beans cut the same length as the short tubes.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Capellini, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Also known as angel hair, Capellini is the thinnest of all long pasta shapes. A long-time children's favorite, this shape is perfect when broken and used as pastina (soup pasta). It's also great served simply with butter and Parmigiano-Reggiano.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Casareccia, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Also known as Cavatelli in certain areas of Italy, Casareccia, meaning "home-style" is very typical of the south of Italy and was orginally made by pushing the dough with a knife or a wooden pin. Ideal for Pasta e Ceci (pasta and chick-pea soup) or any other soup, as well as with a hearty meat ragu or with a sauce of broccoli and anchovies.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Cavatelli, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From an Italian expression of cavare, meaning "to get, to carve," this small pasta has the five thumbprints reminiscent of the motion of getting or grabbing something. The fingerprints are left on the dough from the slight rolling motion of the pasta-maker. It's great in soup, or with a hearty meat or vegetable ragu.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Chitarra, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Chitarra, meaning "guitar" in Italian, is a square-cut spaghetti very traditional of Abruzzo. The dough was traditionally rolled over a box strung with metal guitar strings at even spacing, producing a pasta with a square shape.Traditionally served with lamb ragu or tomato sauce and fresh sheepsmilk ricotta, chitarra is also served with shellfish, garlic and red pepper.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Fettuccine, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Meaning little ribbons, fettucine is the Roman relative of tagliatelle from Bologna. Thicker and wider than tagliatelle, it is the typical Sunday lunch pasta in many corners of Italy today. Great with any sauce imaginable.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Lasagne, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. A beautiful golden color, these egg pasta sheets are light and delicate. They layer easily and have the perfect texture and flavor to make your famous Northern Italian inspired lasagna.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Pappardelle, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. This Tuscan wide noodle was born to go with thick sauces. Try with meat ragu, carbonara, or olive oil and sauteed mushrooms.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Egg Tagliatelle, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the Italian word tagliare, meaning "to cut," as tagliatelle was traditionally hand-made and cut with a knife. Wider then fettuccine this pasta is mostly associated with Bologna, but today is very common throughout Italy. Traditionally served with a hearty bolognese sauce, this pasta is also commonly served with cream or butter-based sauces.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Fettuccine, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the word affettare, meaning "to slice," these ribbons are wider than tagliatelle and are made without the use of eggs. As this pasta is egg-free, serve as you would spaghetti or linguine for added texture.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Fusilli col Buco, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Originally made by wrapping a bucatino around a knitting needle by Neapolitan housewives, these twice-as-long curly fusilli are very popular due to their hollow bite. Great with a simple tomato sauce or any olive oil-based sauce.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Garganelli, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Garganelli is one of the most typical pasta of Emilia-Romagna. The name comes from garganel, or the esophagus in the end of a chicken neck, a short tube with ridges all around. This pasta shape is made with a small square of egg pasta, wrapped around a pencil or a wooden stick, then rolled over a petine ("weaver's comb") or basket to give it the ridges on the outside. Try it with any meat or vegetable ragu where the sauce can be captured in the middle.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Gnocchi, 250g
description: Ok...we've been waiting for this for a long time. You know that Rustichella d'Abruzzo makes amazing pasta & all the things that go with it. We know you can make it yourself, but man, this gnocchi is really good without the fuss. Think of it as your Monday through Thursday gnocchi. Tender & pillowing soft without the rubbery texture that is the calling card for most gnocchi that comes in a package. Dress them up with your favorite sauce...tomato, pesto, cream or brown butter!

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Lemon Fetucini, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Similar in shape to tagliatelle, tagliolini is traditionally served with butter and shaved truffle. The lemon flavor in this pasta pairs perfectly with seafood sauces and fish.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Linguine, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the word lingue, meaning "tongues" in Italian, this tongue-shaped long pasta is also known as bavette. This shape is served throughout Italy, mostly with olive oil, garlic and clams, or other seafood sauces.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Orecchiette, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Orecchiette meaning "little ears," is the most famous pasta from Puglia. Created by pressing the dough with the thumb, this pasta is also known as Orecchie di Prete in Abruzzo, meaning "the ears of the priest." Traditionally served alla Pugliese (with broccoli rabe, sausage and garlic) or with a hearty meat ragu so that the sauce is cupped in the dumplings. It's bite-size shape also makes it wonderful in pasta salads.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Orzo, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Orzo means "barley" in Italian because of its grain-shape. This pasta, shaped like a melon seed, belongs to what Italians called Pastina: pasta that is used in soups. Unfortunately this shape is often made with very low-gluten quality semolina, so it becomes mushy and unpleasant. Unlike common orzos however, this orzo from Rustichella d'Abruzzo keeps its shape and texture and has a real, pleasurable bite and texture. Especially great for use in soups, but also wonderful as a side dish with pesto or in salads.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Penne Rigate, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. One of Italy's most popular cuts, penne rigate has a wider tube than the original penne ("quills"), but rigate ("with ridges") on the outside. This cut is great with virtually all sauces, but ideal for with ground meat, game or vegetables so that the sauce is trapped in the middle and on the points. It's also a great choice for making pasta salad.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Radiatore, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Meaning "radiators" in Italian, this shape designed in the 1960s is reminiscent of the shape of car radiator or home water-heaters. It is perfect served with arugula, sauteed onions and chopped fresh tomato, or any sauce with finely chopped ingredients so that they will be trapped in between the ridges.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Riccia, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Riccia is a long, flat, narrow noodle with curly edges - think skinny lasagne noodles. Pair with a rustic meat ragu.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Rigatoncini, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. This pasta is the small version of rigatoni ("ridged") tubes. Larger than a penne rigate, but cut across rather than slanted. It is one of the most popular southern Italian shapes. Try it with a spicy tomato sauce, Gricia (pecorino and pancetta) as in Rome, or with tomato and sardine sauce topped with wild fennel pollen for a Sicilian variation.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Spaghetti, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. From the Italian word spago meaning "string or thread," there is no pasta in the world more famous than this. With its rough texture and incredible bite, the Rustichella d'Abruzzo spaghetti is a true classic. No one needs suggestions on how to enjoy your spaghetti, but we love it with any olive oil or light tomato sauce that allows you to enjoy its flavor and texture. Spaghetti with meatballs is a must, as is our recipe for spaghetti with spinach, pancetta and pine nuts found in our cookbook!

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Spinach Tonnarelli, 500g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. This durum wheat semolina pasta is slightly thinner than spaghetti. When cooked, it will become a pale olive green with a perfectly al dente texture and a subtly herbaceous flavor reminiscent of chervil. This pasta is perfect with pesto, green beans and lots of torn basil and parsley. It’s delicious with butter and peas—or any delicate green such as spinach—and crispy bits of pancetta.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Strozzapreti, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. Known as Stringozzi in the region of Friuli, strozzapreti literally means "priest stranglers," in reference to the popular belief of the great appetite of priests. Very uneven in texture with an unusual bite, it is perfect with Arrabbiata sauce, as well any type of game, duck or rabbit ragu.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Trofie, 250g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. The most typical of Ligurian shapes, trofie are always served with pesto, potatoes and green beans when in season. The name is derived from a Greek word meaning "nourishment," it is also wonderful served cold as a pasta salad or in soups.

name: Casa del Grano Fregola Sarda, 500g
description: Made with durum wheat, fregola sarda is a small round pasta that is been lightly toasted. The toasting gives the pasta a rich nutty flavor that carries through even after cooking. Nicknamed "Sardinian couscous", fregola is great for soups, side dishes and entrees. It is traditionally served with clams.

name: Poschiavo Spaghetti, 500g
description: Not all great pasta comes from Italy. Hard to believe, but this spaghetti proves it. This pasta has been made by the Fisler family in the Valle di Poschiavo just over the Italian border in Switzerland since 1900. Their pasta is made using coarsely ground hard durum wheat, resulting in a great chew and a nutty flavor.

name: Ritrovo Selections Barolo Tagliolini, 250g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this delicate, thin-cut noodle has rich flavor and color from the infusion of Barolo wine. Don't limit yourself on sauces - this goes well with anything olive oil or tomato based.

name: Ritrovo Selections Porcini Tagliolini, 250g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this pasta is delicate and thin-cut with a rich flavor and color from the porcini mushrooms. This shape is perfect with olive oils sauces with roasted vegetables and Parmigiano-Reggiano. Drizzle with truffle oil to add a finishing touch.

name: Ritrovo Selections Squid Ink Tagliolini, 250g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this thin cut tagliolini is ideal for seafood pasta dishes and with olive oil or tomato based sauces. Black hued from the squid ink, it has a delicate marine flavor without being fishy.

name: Ritrovo Selections Tajarin, 250g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this Piedmontese-style pasta is made with fresh eggs in small batches. Fine cut with a delicate texture and a tender bite, it is perfect with butter and sage or olive oil and sauteed mushrooms. Finish either dish with freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano.

name: Ritrovo Selections Truffle Tagliolini, 250g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this elegant egg pasta is made with truffle and porcini mushrooms from the Piedmont. It cooks beautifully and has a lovely aroma and flavor. Serve with truffle and mushroom-based sauces.

Build pizzas and fire them at home...oil up both sides and brown in a skillet until crunchy/chewy and top with a pinch of sea salt...pair with meats cheeses & antipasti...you can even store them in the freezer until you are ready to use them!
