Their special Rosey Harissa is skillfully blended using delicate rose petals and the best sun-dried chili peppers, adding a fragrant hit to your favorite dishes. Mild in heat, big on flavor!

name: New York Shuk Shawarma Blend, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

Meet their Middle Eastern pantry in a jar! Inspired by the bold flavors of shawarma, the Middle Eastern street food classic of meat cooked on a rotating spit, this is your go-to spice for adding a piquant flavor to everything from vegetables and fish to grilled meats.

name: New York Shuk Za'atar, 2oz
description:
New York Shuk is a maker of handcrafted Middle Eastern pantry staples. The word shuk means "market" in Hebrew, and for Ron and Leetal, the marketplace represents the center of a community - the meeting point where commerce and culture come together. They try to bring this communal energy, as well as the freshness of a bustling outdoor market to everything they do at New York Shuk.

Za’atar is the gateway spice to the Middle Eastern pantry. Their version, based on an ancient Jerusalem recipe, uses traditional za’atar leaves, sumac, sesame and olive oil for an intriguing and versatile blend that earns its place at the table during breakfast, lunch and dinner.

name: Matiz Piment d'Espelette, 45g
description: Highly prized in the Basque region of France, Matiz Piment d’Espelette offers a mildly sweet-spicy heat with aromatic hints of fruit and dried hay. This unique dried red pepper from Espelette enhances any dish - from French ham omelets to grilled fish, sausages, and even desserts!

name: Ritrovo Selections Truffle & Salt, 100g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is the original truffle salt! Award-winning and intensely aromatic, it is a blend of Italian black truffle and Adriatic sea salt. Incredibly versatile, it is great on everything from pasta to popcorn to filet mignon. Reach for this salt any time you are in need of the earthy flavor of black truffle!

name: Villa Jerada Aleppo, 60g
description: Imagine a chile pepper walking through an orange grove, and you have the flavor of dried Aleppo pepper - an essential, prized ingredient known for its mild heat and burst of fruitiness and a go-to ingredient in Levantine cuisine. Its warm complexity makes it a brilliant solo player for seasoning grilled meats and stews, while also playing nice with others: mix it with cumin and cinnamon for a simple spice rub. Or add a little verve to your dessert game by sprinkling it on fresh peaches or, yes, even ice cream. Aleppo also pairs well with grilled meats, soups, tomatoes, salads and tastes delicious when used as a topping on pizza, and crunchy potato chips.

name: VIlla Jerada Dukkah, 50g
description: Dukkah, a versatile Egyptian condiment with a name that means to pound, produces a coarsely ground mixture of aromatic herbs, spices and hazelnuts. It compliments dips, roasted vegetables, meats, and stews or best simply served in the traditional way with hard boiled eggs olive oil, and bread. Made with oregon hazelnuts, coriander, cumin, cayenne, salt & sesame seeds.

name: Villa Jerada Kefta Rub, 50g
description: Villa Jerada's Kefta Rub adds a fragrant touch to meat that's reminiscent of street stalls, cafes, & dinner tables that stretch across the Moroccan landscape like a simple but complex favorite shared by locals and remembered by the traveler. Perfect for meatball tagines, braises and grills, it is a blend of cumin, paprika, morita pepper, coriander, cinnamon, mint & cayenne pepper.

name: Villa Jerada Moruno Rub, 50goz
description: Moruno, a popular and beloved Spanish blend with a Moroccan influence, embodies the flavor and culture prevalent on the tapas scene. Villa Jerada's recipe adds a rich layering of aromatic and savory complexity to meats and stews. Perfect for lamb, meat skewers and savory tagines with it's combination of saffron, cumin, coriander, fennel, black pepper, saffron, dried oregano, thyme, pimento, turmeric.

name: Villa Jerada Ras el Hanout, 60g
description: The undisputed crown jewel of Moroccan and North African spice, Ras el Hanout translates to "top shelf," but we strongly recommend you keep this jar within arm’s length. The best of both home cooking and expertise, you’re holding Villa Jerada's family recipe tweaked and perfected by their spice merchant in the Casablanca Marché aux épices, Omar. So much greater than the sum of its parts, Ras el Hanout is traditional for use in Mrouzia (Moroccan lamb confit), but use it well and often on grilled chicken, in tomato soup, and on any and all roasted vegetables!

name: Villa Jerada Saffron, 1g
description: Saffron is famous for its title as the most expensive spice by weight in the world. Made from the dried threads of the Saffron Crocus flower, it is traditionally used in Risotto alla Milanese, seafood paella and a variety of sauces. A little goes a long way, adding bold, savory flavor and a distinct golden color to all your recipes.

name: Villa Jerada Shawarma, 1.76oz
description: Shawarma means to turn, a Levantine method of marinating and cooking grilled meats throughout the middle east. Villa Jerada's recipe is based a Syrian family recipe which is hand blended in small batches to bring out the warm, aromatic and bright flavor of this popular mix. Use on grilled meats, with roasted chickpeas or cauliflower, mixed in with yogurt as a sauce accompaniment, or simply sprinkle over popcorn. It is a combination of paprika, onion powder, nutmeg, cumin, bay leaf, cardamom, garlic powder, ginger, coriander, cayenne, cinnamon, all spice, cloves, turmeric, sumac, black and white pepper

name: Villa Jerada Sumac, 60g
description: There’s just something about sumac. Savory, citrusy, that deep red/purple hue: it's hot summer in a jar. And versatile as the day is long. In your za'atar, yogurt, lamb, chicken and fish, vinaigrettes, marinades, atop fruit, yogurt or even ice cream!

name: Villa Jerada Urfa Biber, 50g
description: Urfa Biber tells the story of a mild red pepper that’s dried by the sun, wrapped tight to sweat, and transformed by the moon. Dark purple hues dried of the earth to a raisin like perfection adding a complex approachable smoke and heat.Pairs well with pungent cheese, robust vegetables, braised meats and salads

name: Walkerswood Jerk Seasoning, 280g
description: This stuff is amazing. Walkerswood sources all their ingredients fresh from local farmers across the Jamaica. This traditional jerk seasoning is made with scallions, scotch bonnet peppers, allspice and nutmeg. Use as a rub or marinade with chicken, lamb, burgers, pork, fish and vegetables. The spice is intense, so start conservatively and work up from there. Make the jar last even longer by adding a little olive oil to thin the mixture before applying.

name: Michele Ferrante Hot Controne Pepper, 40g
tagline: Hand ground
description: This pepper powder is a mracle. Air-dried, hand-ground Campania,. it is zesty yet nutty in flavor with notes of wood smoke and plenty of heat. Perfect for pasta, beans & proteins.

name: Momofuku Savory Salt, 3.4oz
description: Momofuku Seasoned Salt is the result of 10 years of flavor research in the Momofuku Culinary Lab. Savory Seasoned Salt is supercharged salt and pepper. It mixes kosher salt with garlic, tamari, kelp, and mushroom powder. Perfect on grilled steaks and vegetables!

name: Momofuku Spicy Salt, 3.4oz
description: Momofuku Seasoned Salt is the result 10 years of flavor research in the Momofuku Culinary Lab. Spicy is a flash of heat. It blends their Savory base with gochugaru, cayenne pepper, and dried chilies. Perfect for using on shrimp, stewed meats, and ripe mango!

name: Momofuku Tingly Salt, 3.4oz
description: Momofuku Seasoned Salt is the result 10 years of flavor research in the Momofuku Culinary Lab. Tingly is a jolt of flavor. It is a blend of our Savory base with Sichuan peppercorns and citrus. Perfect on fish, popcorn, and roasted vegetables.

name: Aux Anysetiers du Roy Herbes de Provence, 28g
description: Herbes de Provence, or Provençal herbs, is a traditional blend of aromatic herbs that flourish in hills of southern France during the hot summer months. There are many variations to this traditional blend depending on who you ask or what they are cooking. In this case, these traditional crocks are hand-packed with thyme, basil, savory, fennel and lavender flowers. Herbs de Provence is a great addition to virtually any Mediterranean dish, including lamb, beef, chicken, fish, roasted vegetables, salads or even pizza sauce.

name: El Rey de la Vera Hot Paprika, 75g
description: El Rey de la Vera represents four generations of paprika producers. Smoked pimenton, or paprika, is a staple of the Mediterranean diet and is used to give both color and flavor to many traditional dishes. Rey de la Vera’s unique drying process over an oak wood burning stove gives the paprika it's distinctive aroma, flavor and color. Their hot paprika is made from a mixture of Guindilla and Jarandilla peppers. The former providing the heat, and the latter lending it's vibrant color and mild flavor.

name: El Rey de la Vera Sweet Paprika, 75g
description: El Rey de la Vera represents four generations of paprika producers. Smoked pimenton, or paprika, is a staple of the Mediterranean diet and is used to give both color and flavor to many traditional dishes. Rey de la Vera’s unique drying process over an oak wood burning stove gives the paprika it's distinctive aroma, flavor and color. Their sweet paprika is made from the small, round Nora Pepper, which is native to the Valencia region of Spain.

name: Esprit du Sel Grey Sea Salt, 500g
description: Established in 1986 to preserve and promote the French salt marsh heritage, Esprit du Sel produces authentic, rare and traditional Fleur de Sel. Harvested from the clear waters off the Island of Re on the Atlantic coast of France, this salt tastes just like the sea from which it came. This grey salt is neither treated or washed, so it remains rich with minerals. Perfect for salt-encrusted roasting recipes, it's rugged textured, briny crystals also make an excellent base for rubs, roasts, marinades and soups.

name: Grasslands & Barbecue All-Purpose Seasoning, 227g
description:
Grasslands Barbecue is a highly acclaimed Texas-style barbecue food truck and catering company based in Hood River, Oregon.

Their Go-To rub for beef, pork, chicken, and veggies. They especially love pairing this with tri-tip, potatoes, IPAs you can actually see through, popcorn, and essentially everything.

This rub contains no salt because they prefer to salt separately and ahead of time, for depth of favor and personal preference.

name: India Tree Tellicherry Pepper, 4.5oz
description: Located in Seattle's Ballard neighborhood, India Tree offers an exciting assortment of quality ingredients for cooking and baking, ranging from pantry essentials to party decoratifs. Pepper fact: black pepper is the berry of an evergreen vine native to India. The berries, growing in long clusters, are harvested while they are still green, then sun-dried until they shrivel and turn brownish-black. Tellicherry are the largest, the plumpest, the most pungent and the most aromatic of all black peppers. Get a good pepper grinder, fill & repeat.

name: La Baleine Coarse Sea Salt, 750g
description: La Baleine sea salt has been produced by Salins-du-Midi in the Aigues-Mortes saltworks, in Camargue, France since 1856. This coarse sea salt is great for rubs, roasting & finishing. The course crystals provide more texture than their fine counterpart, yet they are soft and dissolve quickly giving a burst of clean, light salty flavor with each bite.

name: La Baleine Fine Sea Salt, 750g
description: La Baleine sea salt has been produced by Salins-du-Midi in the Aigues-Mortes saltworks, in Camargue, France since 1856. This finely ground sea salt is perfect to use instead of traditional table salt in baking, cooking or blending. The super-fine texture penetrates deep into foods and readily dissolves.

name: Nong's Khao Man Gai Sauce, 12oz
description: Originally from Bangkok, Thailand, Nong moved to Portland in 2003 with $70 and two suitcases. Shortly after, she opened a small food cart designed to sell just one thing: Khao Man Gai. This traditional Thai chicken dish consists of poached chicken with Thai aromatics, rice and broth - it is served with a sauce made from fermented soy bean puree and mixed with garlic, ginger, thai chilies, vinegar and sugar. Garnished with a few pieces of cucumber & cilantro, it is a Thai staple. This is her handmade sauce, and the only sauce you can use to replicate this amazing dish. Its use does not stop there, though. It is also great as a marinade or a sauce with chicken, pork or fish.

name: Omnivore Limone Salt, 6oz
description: Omnivore was founded by Angelo Garro, a master blacksmith, passionate hunter, forager, cook and Slow Food icon widely known through his role in Michael Pollan’s The Omnivore’s Dilemma. His Omnivore Salt, a spiced salt blend described by Alice Waters as “indispensable,” draws on knowledge Garro picked up while foraging as a youth in Sicily. Omnivore Limone Salt is a zesty, herbaceous, aromatic citrus and sea salt blend ideal for poultry, fish, and spring vegetables. Its delicate balance of herbs and lemon zest adds aromatic and herbaceous flavors to your recipes. Add this to your food before or during cooking to rehydrate the dried herbs and let their flavor infuse your recipes!

name: Omnivore Salt, 6oz
description: Omnivore was founded by Angelo Garro, a master blacksmith, passionate hunter, forager, cook and Slow Food icon widely known through his role in Michael Pollan’s The Omnivore’s Dilemma. His Omnivore Salt, a spiced salt blend described by Alice Waters as “indispensable,” draws on knowledge Garro picked up while foraging as a youth in Sicily. He learned the wonder of herbs like the wild fennel that grew around his childhood home, and spices like the chili peppers his grandmother hung to dry in her kitchen, when mixed with salt, give character to any food and make cooking simple. Omnivore Salt is an organic, well-balanced, earthy, peppery, delicate picante sea salt blend. Just a pinch of the versatile cooking (or finishing) salt will add balance to your recipes and bring out the natural flavor of your food.

name: Queen Majesty Ancho Chili Powder, 5oz
description: Limited edition Manzano Serrano hot sauce, hand made in NYC. Try the Ancho hot sauce powder!

name: Rancho Gordo Oregano Indio, .4oz
description: Rancho Gordo's Oregano Indio, sometimes known as Oreja de Raton, or Mouse's Ear, is less citrusy than the standard Mexican oregano and there's an indescribable earthiness that makes it infectious. Put it on almost everything.

name: Rancho Gordo Stardust Dipping Powder, 2.4oz
description: Rancho Gordo Stardust is a mixture of medium-heat dry New Mexican chiles and herbs and spices. It is a blend of dried chiles, crystallized lime, brown sugar, sea salt, and Mexican oregano. Dip your raw, fresh cut fruits and vegetables into Stardust for a peppy zap of chile and citrus, a perfect snack!

name: Tutto Calabria Bruschetta, 180g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world! Made with dried Calabrian peppers, oregano, garlic and basil, all you need is a can of good Italian tomatoes and some heat to simmer and you have a warmly spiced, herbaceous sauce for pasta. Also great to season soup, or grilled meats.

name: Tutto Calabria Calabrian Oregano, 1oz
description: Calabrian oregano leaves are just different - more aromatic & more flavorful. They are cultivated by local farmers who follow practices handed down from generation to generation. This oregano is one of the most used aromatic herbs in Italy, particularly in the South. Perfect for pizza, sauces, dressings, grilled chicken & fish.

name: Tutto Calabria Chili Flake, 250g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world! These famous bright red crushed Calabrian peppers will make any recipe hot! Great on sandwiches, pizza and mixed into dressings, dips and sauces.

name: Tutto Calabria Dried Oregano, 40g
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. A staple of Italian cuisine, oregano is one of those herbs that is more flavorful dried, than fresh. Hand-harvested from the hot, mountainous region of Calabria, this wild oregano has unlimited uses in the kitchen. Ideal for sauces, pizza, meats, vegetables, and spicy foods.

name: Tutto Calabria Hot Chili Powder, 110g
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. This chili powder will amp up the spice in any dish! It is fragrant, sweet, and yes….spicy. These peppers are traditionally dried, then powdered. Soon to become your next go-to pantry staple!

name: Tutto Calabria Spaghettata, 2.82oz
description: Tutto Calabria began production in the 1970's and was one of the first companies to introduce traditional Calabrian products to not only the Italian market, but also the world. This spice mixture is made with dried Calabrian peppers, parsley, garlic, dried tomatoes and salt. Packed with flavor and already portioned, just drop it in your pot of simmering tomatoes, let it cook, and you have a perfect marinara sauce. It is also great combines with some olive oil for dipping, or used in rubs and marinades.

name: Ritrovo Peppercorn Trio for Cacio e Pepe, 35g
description: Carefully selected trio of peppercorns packed in a grinder to conveniently add freshly ground pepper to the classic, Roman Cacio Pepe pasta dish. Complex and aromatic. Don’t hesitate to use it on eggs over easy, filet mignon, or to enliven a burrata salad!

name: Bartolini Quick Soup Mix
description: Need some soup, but don't have a ton of time? No problem. Bartolini provides a base of lentils, farro, barley & beans, just add stock, simmer, wait about 45 min and voila! Soup. This packages takes well to customizing as well. Start by sauteing onions, garlic, carrots & celery...add some pancetta and/or tomatoes...you get the picture. Hearty, delicious & nutritious!

name: Aneto Chicken Broth, 1L
description: Unlike most broths on the market, Aneto uses no concentrates or powders. They make their stock like you would - find the highest quality meat, fish and vegetables and simmer them in a pot for up to 3 hours. This chicken broth is the real thing. Use it in any dish for genuine homemade flavor. It is perfect for soups, stews, purees, and paella. It's even delicious to sip hot in a mug all by itself. Imported from Spain, it is a wonderful pantry staple.

name: Aneto Fish Broth, 1L
description: Unlike most broths on the market, Aneto uses no concentrates or powders. They make their stock like you would - find the highest quality meat, fish and vegetables and simmer them in a pot for up to 3 hours. This fish broth is the real thing. It is perfect for seafood soups, stews, purees, and paella. Imported from Spain, it is a wonderful pantry staple.

name: Aneto Low Sodium Chicken Broth, 1L
description: Unlike most broths on the market, Aneto uses no concentrates or powders. They make their stock like you would - find the highest quality meat, fish and vegetables and simmer them in a pot for up to 3 hours. This chicken broth is the real thing. Lower in salt, this allows you to add as much or as little as you would like. It is perfect for soups, stews, purees, and paella. It's even delicious to sip hot in a mug all by itself. Imported from Spain, it is a wonderful pantry staple.

name: Aneto Seafood Paella Base, 1L
description: This is a remarkable product. It allows you to make a perfect paella in just a few minutes - no need to add onions, tomatoes or saffron, as they are already included in the broth. Just add the rice and whatever seafood you prefer! Imported from Spain, it also works wonderfully in recipes that require a rich broth - soups, stews, risotto, and noodle dishes.

name: Aneto Valencian Paella Base, 1L
description: This is a remarkable product. It allows you to make a perfect paella in just a few minutes - no need to add onions, tomatoes or saffron, as they are already included in the broth. Just add rice. Traditional Valencian paella usually includes a combination of rabbit, chicken and/or snails. Imported from Spain, it also works wonderfully in recipes that require a rich broth - soups, stews, risotto, and noodle dishes.

name: Aneto Vegetable Broth, 1L
description: Unlike most broths on the market, Aneto uses no concentrates or powders. They make their stock like you would - find the highest quality meat, fish and vegetables and simmer them in a pot for up to 3 hours. Use this stock in recipes where vegetables are the star of the show. It is perfect for soups, stews, purees, and paella. It's even delicious to sip hot in a mug all by itself. Imported from Spain, it is a wonderful pantry staple.

name: Fatworks Chicken Fat Organic Cooking Oil, 212g
tagline: Kettle Rendered Chicken Schmaltz
description: Nothing really compares to organic Chicken Fat Schmaltz. It has the richness of duck fat but with a milder and more aromatic flavor. Schmaltz adds complexity to a variety of dishes that you simply cannot reproduce any other way. Schmaltz is a joy to cook with and is the easiest way to add depth and complexity to leafy vegetables, stir-fries, pan-fried steaks, fish, poultry, soups, stews, baked goods, and for a special treat spread it right on a piece of bread like you would a high-quality butter or fine olive oil. It's no exaggeration to say Schmaltz gives potatoes and other root vegetables a flavor that is beyond anything most of us have experienced. If potatoes could talk to schmaltz they would say, "You complete me!" Fatworks Chicken Schmaltz is made with 100% Organic Free Range Chicken and is rendered with the typical care and passion that you would expect from Fatworks.

name: Fatworks Leaf Lard Cooking Oil, 396g
tagline: Kettle-Rendered Made From Pastured Pork
description:
The finest Pasture Raised Leaf Lard available. The gourmet baker's secret weapon. The perfect gateway fat for those who don't want too much pork flavor in their lard. Rendered from the prized pasture-raised "leaf" (internal fat) making it less "porky" tasting than our other lard offering which comes from back fat.

Both have their uses but as there is no meat muscle in the leaf, this lard has a milder pork flavor. This makes for an amazing cooking fat that is delicate, light and "clean" tasting. Bakers have cherished Pasture Raised Leaf Lard because it creates the best crusts and cakes while not imparting any flavor of its own. And because of its high smoke point, Fatworks Pastured Raised Leaf Lard is simply perfect for frying and sautéing, especially when you want the natural flavors of your ingredients to shine. Fatworks Pure Premium Pasture Raised Leaf Lard is essential for anyone interested in cooking with traditional fat. They source the fat from small family farms in the US.

name: Fatworks Organic Leaf Lard Cooking Oil, 396g
tagline: Kettle-Rendered Made From Organic Pork
description:
Sourced from U.S family farms. This is the most prized lard available. Organic means you can be guaranteed that this has been certified to have no GMO's pesticides, added hormones or antibiotics. Fatworks Organic Free Range Leaf Lard is the perfect fat for keto and paleo fat connoisseurs and the gourmet baker's secret weapon!

Rendered from the prized free-range "leaf" (internal fat) making it less "porky" tasting than their other lard offering which comes from back fat primarily. Both have their uses but as there is no meat muscle in the leaf it has a milder pork flavor and slightly higher saturated fat making it the perfect lard when you need a delicate, light, and "clean" taste. Bakers have cherished Leaf Lard because it creates the best crusts and cakes and cookies while not imparting any flavor of its own. And because of its high smoke point, pork leaf lard is simply perfect for frying and sautéing, especially when you want the natural flavors of your ingredients to shine. Fatworks Certified Organic Leaf Lard is essential for anyone interested in cooking with traditional fat.

name: Fatworks Pure Beef Tallow, 396g
tagline: Made From 100% Frass-Fed Beef
description: Grass-Fed Organic Beef Tallow — Fatworks brought back healthy fat in 2010 and in Doing so started a fat revolution! No hydrogenating, no deodorizing. They render "Grandma Style" and hot pack in glass. Pasture Raised.

name: Savory Choice Beef Broth, 5.1oz
description: This beef broth is really good and really convenient. No more opening a 32oz container of broth, using a cup and letting the other 24oz go bad in your fridge. Seasoned and ready to use, each pouch makes 1 cup of broth. Store in your cupboard and have it at the ready.

name: Savory Choice Chicken Broth, 5.1oz
description: This chicken broth is really good and really convenient. No more opening a 32oz container of broth, using a cup and letting the other 24oz go bad in your fridge. Seasoned and ready to use, each pouch makes 1 cup of broth. Store in your cupboard and have it at the ready.

name: Savory Choice Vegetable Broth, 5.1oz
description: This vegetable broth is really good and really convenient. No more opening a 32oz container of broth, using a cup and letting the other 24oz go bad in your fridge. Seasoned and ready to use, each pouch makes 1 cup of broth. Store in your cupboard and have it at the ready.

name: Star Porcini Mushroom Stock Cubes, 100g
description: A long-trusted brand in Italian kitchens, these cubes are excellent for enhancing any risotto or braised meat dish. One or two cubes in hot water makes a flavorful porcini broth.

name: DeLaurenti Housemade Marinara, 16oz
description: Made in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen. This is your go-to sauce to have at the ready in your freezer. DOP tomatoes, onions, garlic, extra virgin olive oil...only the best ingredients. Great as is, or ready to customize with sausage or spice!

name: DeLaurenti Housemade Meat Sauce, 16oz
description: Made in the comfort of the DeLaurenti kitchen. This is your go-to sauce to have at the ready in your freezer. DOP tomatoes, Cascioppo's sausage, onions, garlic, extra virgin olive oil...only the best ingredients. Ready to go as is - just add pasta!

name: DeLaurenti Housemade Pizza Sauce, 16oz
description: As seen, and enjoyed, in our cafe! The same sauce that has been on the classic cheese & pepperoni pizza you have enjoyed for years in our shop! Made in our kitchen with the perfect blend of the best tomatoes, herbs & spices! No need to recreate it, you just need to bring it home and put it on a pizza!

name: DeLaurenti Pesto
description: The house pesto that you have found in our freezer for years. A must have for home. Having pesto at the ready will provide you with effortless pasta, pizza & panini options, plus the security of knowing that it's resting in your freezer will help you sleep better!

name: Ciacco Lemon Basil Pesto
description: Genovese DOP basil, EVOO, pine nuts, cheese, salt, garlic, wine vinegar,and lemon...as simple as it gets but packs a punch of flavor to anything you add it to. Not just for pasta, you can use this mixed into yogurt for a savory dip or spread it on Piadina for a sandwich.

name: DeLaurenti Sugo al Funghi Porcini, 500g
description: Our house brand tomato and porcini sauce is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. And yes, there are real porcini mushrooms in this sauce. Great with your favorite cut of pasta or served over polenta.

name: DeLaurenti Sugo al Tartufo, 500g
description: Vine ripened tomatoes...truffles...any questions? This sauce has the rich flavor of truffle, garlic, and mushroom without an overpowering aroma. The perfect addition to fresh egg linguine, or your famous polenta.

name: DeLaurenti Sugo alla Puttanesca, 500g
description: Our house brand Puttanesca sauce is made with Italian cherry tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add green olives, capers and pine nuts and you have a sweet, savory and mildly spicy version of a regional favorite. Perfect with bucatini, or any other cut of pasta with ruffled edges to soak up the sauce.

name: DeLaurenti Sugo alla Vodka, 500g
description: Our house brand Sugo alla Vodka is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. The sauce is finished with a dash of vodka, fresh cream, garlic and basil. Perfect for your favorite cut of pasta, cheese ravioli or tortellini.

name: DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa, 500g
description: Our Sugo della Casa - the house sauce. Made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. You will recognize and be able to pronouce the following ingredients: tomatoes, olive oil, celery, carrots, Barolo wine, sea salt and herbs. Great for a quick weeknight pasta with Cascioppo's sausage or as the sauce for your lasagna with Calabro fresh ricotta.

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Due Formaggi, 500g
description: Our house brand Sugo Due Formaggi is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add sharp aged pecorino, creamy ricotta and fresh herbs and you have perfect sauce for your favorite cut of pasta or your ravioli!

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Piccante, 500g
description: Just like the Sugo della Casa - house tomato sauce, but with a little kick of spice. Made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made, the addition of just enough Italian chili pepper give this sauce a warm, pleasant spice.

name: Monte's Marinara Tomato Sauce, 16oz
tagline: Same great recipe, just thicker!
description: There is 100+ years & 3 generations of family tradition behind this sauce. The Monte Family emigrated to Brooklyn from Sant’Angelo di Lombardi & Avellino, Italy in 1906 and began serving traditional Neopolitan Fare to the community at what opened as Angelo’s Tavern - eventually to become known as the famed Monte’s Venetian Room. This sauce has been enjoyed by everyone from Frank Sinatra to James Cagney. The foundation is the tomatoes. Vine ripened & grown in California, the family swears that they are every bit as good as the Italian variety. This Marinara is the same great recipe of their Oringal Tomato Sauce, just thicker!

name: Monte's Spicy Tomato Sauce, 24oz
description: There is 100+ years & 3 generations of family tradition behind this sauce. The Monte Family emigrated to Brooklyn from Sant’Angelo di Lombardi & Avellino, Italy in 1906 and began serving traditional Neopolitan Fare to the community at what opened as Angelo’s Tavern - eventually to become known as the famed Monte’s Venetian Room. This sauce has been enjoyed by everyone from Frank Sinatra to James Cagney. The foundation is the tomatoes. Vine ripened & grown in California, the family swears that they are every bit as good as the Italian variety. Taste this warmly spiced tomato sauce & you'll agree!

name: Monte's Sweet Pepper Tomato Sauce, 24oz
description: There is 100+ years & 3 generations of family tradition behind this sauce. The Monte Family emigrated to Brooklyn from Sant’Angelo di Lombardi & Avellino, Italy in 1906 and began serving traditional Neopolitan Fare to the community at what opened as Angelo’s Tavern - eventually to become known as the famed Monte’s Venetian Room. This sauce has been enjoyed by everyone from Frank Sinatra to James Cagney. The foundation is the tomatoes. Vine ripened & grown in California, the family swears that they are every bit as good as the Italian variety. Taste this warmly spiced tomato sauce & you'll agree!

name: Strianese Organic Passata, 720g
description: Tomatoes did not start in Italy, but the Italians found the best place to grown them - the San Marzano Valley outside of Naples in Southern Italy. The Strianese company is a great producer of DOP (Denominazione di Origine Protetta) and organic tomatoes. We have been using their products in our kitchen and in our homes for many years. This fresh, organic strained tomato puree is a perfect back drop for all your seasonings - be it in tomato sauce, braises or soups. It's lighter than tomato sauce and without the chunky texture of peeled plum tomatoes. Use a little, put the cap back on, put it in the fridge and have it ready for the next time you want to add the fresh taste of San Marzano Tomatoes.

description: Tomatoes did not start in Italy, but the Italians found the best place to grown them - the San Marzano Valley outside of Naples in Southern Italy. name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Arrabbiata Sauce, 680g

The best pasta deserves the best sauce, and their line of specialty sauces was designed to be just that. Arrabbiata means “enraged," and this sauce, made with hot red pepper and garlic, is indeed very spicy. Great with any of their pasta cuts, especially Bucatini.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Olive Tomato Sauce, 680g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. The best pasta deserves the best sauce, and their line of specialty sauces was designed to be just that. Made with vine-ripened tomatoes, sauteed onions, and Italian black olives, this sauce goes well with any kind of pasta.

name: Rustichella d'Abruzzo Pomodoro e Basilico, 680g
description: Appreciated by chefs and home cooks alike, Rustichella d'Abruzzo has been making artisan Italian pasta since 1924. The best pasta deserves the best sauce. This line of specialty sauces was designed to be just that. A classic pairing of tomatoes and basil. Perfect with your favorite cut of pasta, when you are making chicken cacciatore, or as base for seafood stews.

name: Bianco di Napoli Tomato/Basil, 24oz
description: This is a deliciously simply organic marinara sauce from James Beard Award winning restaurateur Chris Bianco and 3rd generation tomato processor Rob DiNapoli. Produced from 5 simple organic ingredients harvested at their peak ripeness- tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, basil and sea salt. All ingredients grown in California!

name: Bianco di Napoli Whole Peeled Tomatoes, 28oz
Pomi Chopped Tomatoes, 26oz

These conveniently chopped tomatoes are ready to use anytime you want to add the fresh taste of garden-ripe, Italian tomatoes to all their favorite recipes.

name: Pomi Marinara Sauce, 26oz
description: Pomi Marinara is a delicious sauce made with 100% Italian tomatoes. We love the Pomi brand here at the shop and recommend serving this with your favorite pasta!

name: Pomi Pizza Sauce, 14.1oz
description: Pomì has become a staple and a trusted brand for our customers seeking premium quality, Italian tomatoes and sauces conveniently sealed in a BPA-free, stay-fresh package. name: La Medina Semi-Dried Tomatoes, 540g
description: These semi-sundried tomatoes are versatile, convenient and packed with flavor! They are hand-picked and hand-cut tomatoes marinated in sunflower oil, vinegar, herbs, spices and seasonings. Much more tender than sundried tomatoes, they are perfect for salads, pastas and pizza. No need to discard the oil, either - you can reuse it to marinate something else, use it for dressings, or incorporate it into mayonaisse.

name: DeLaurenti Alfredo Sauce, 250g
tagline: Italian white sauce with with cheese & cream
description: Get serious...really good cream sauce that is in a bottle? Yes! We've waiting a long time for this. Our great friends at Ritrovo Selections have again helped us by finding the best there is to find when it comes to all things imported from Italy. Our Alfredo has the cheesy richness that has come to be associated with this iconic cream sauce. All natural ingredients and Italian sourcing result in a creamy, decadent condiment for pastas such, fresh fettucine, or La Romagna Pappardelle. Heat and use to top steamed vegetables, fill crepes or make an Alfredo-topped eggs Benedict!

name: DeLaurenti Cacio e Pepe Sauce, 250g
tagline: Italian white sauce with DOP Pecorino Romano & black pepper
description: Get serious...really Cacio e Pepe sauce that is in a bottle? Yes! We've waiting a long time for this. Our great friends at Ritrovo Selections have again helped us by finding the best there is to find when it comes to all things imported from Italy. This sauce combines DOP pecorino romano cheese with fragrant black pepper in an all natural roux to create the classic Roman dish that dates back ages. Not just for pasta, this sauce can also dress up a grilled chicken breast or steak!

name: Rossodoro Sugo di Pomodoro, 16oz
description: This sauce is made by our neighbor Michela Tartaglia at Pasta Casalinga here at the Pike Place Market. It is the same sauce she uses for all their pasta dishes. Born and raised in Torino, Michela spent her summers on her Italian family’s olive farm near Naples. This sauce is part of a set of secrets and techniques she inherited from her mother and grandmothers. Fresh, flavorful & delicious!

description: Fratelli Contorno is a Sicilian canned foods producer established in 1916. Four generations later, they continue to focus on Sicilian regional specialties – but unlike 1916, they now produce their goods in a solar-powered production facility. Dense and flavorful, it’s perfect for enriching sauces, soups, or braises.

name: Cuoco Pasta con Sarde, 15oz
description: Cuoco Brand hails from Sicily. Their Cuoco Seasoning for Macaroni with Sardines has been on the shelves at DeLaurenti for longer than any of us have been here. It is the authentic seasoning for the classic Sicilian dish Pasta con Le Sarde. The balanced sauce gets its saltiness and bite from sardines and rich flavors from wild fennel, onions, and raisins. Various types of pasta can be used, but bucatini is traditional.

name: Don Pomodoro Arrabbiata Pasta Sauce, 25oz
description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their arrabbiata sauce allows you to enjoy a great meal in the time it takes to boil your pasta. Calabrian red chiles add a warm spice to this sauce, balanced with Italian tomatoes, extra virgin olive oil, carrots, and garlic. Your next weeknight dinner awaits!

name: Don Pomodoro Marinara, 25oz
description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their marinara sauce is a great choice for anyone who wants the convenience of a prepared pasta sauce, but doesn’t want an over-sweetened mass-market marinara. Made without added sugar, this sauce is simple yet delicious. You will recognize and be able to pronounce all the ingredient on the back of the jar. Enjoy it as is, or customize with sausage, vegetables or both!

name: Don Pomodoro Puttanesca, 25oz
description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their puttanesca sauce tastes like southern Italy. Made with onions, green olives, and capers, it is an easy way to craft a delicious meal in the time it takes to boil your pasta. Great enjoyed as is, or add a little more character by sautéing a few anchovies in some chili flakes before adding the sauce to the pan. Want to keep going? Add some tuna & finish it with fresh chopped Italian parsley!

name: Don Pomodoro Tomato & Basil Pasta Sauce, 25oz
description: Don Pomodoro products are made in small batches in Calabria, Italy, with traditional recipes and premium ingredients. Their Tomato & Basil Pasta Sauce starts with a soffritto of onion, carrots, and garlic to form a base before the premium San Marzano tomatoes and extra virgin olive oil are added. The sauce is finished with fresh basil harvested daily from the Don Pomodoro fields. With this sauce, you can make a delicious pasta in about the time it takes to cook the noodles. To make it as the Italians do, add the al dente pasta to the sauce and give it a quick finish. Save a bit of the cooking water to add to the finished dish to get the desired consistency.

name: Gia Sundried Tomato Paste, 80g
description: When you need tomato paste, nothing else will do. If you happen to love using this miracle ingredient for sauces, braises and soups but feel like adding the distinctive taste of sundried tomatoes, this is the stuff. It combines the same smooth texture and versatility with sundried tomatoes, olvie oil, herbs & spices. And you know how to use it already!

name: Paradiso dei Golosi Sundried Tomatoes, 5.3oz
description: Grown in Puglia, the heal of the Italian boot, these sundried tomatoes are made without additives or sulfur. Tender and vine-ripened, they have the natural balance of sweetness and acidity.

name: Ritrovo Selections Pesto Rosso, 180g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is a Sicilian spin on a classic recipe that captures all the sun-drenched flavors of southern Italy. This sun-dried tomato and almond pesto is wonderful with pasta, bruschetta, or grilled pork, chicken or fish.

name: Segreti di Sicilia Sugo alle Olive, 290g
description: Sicilian cuisine tells the story of the many cultures that have intersected on the island—Greek, Arab, French, and Spanish. Frantoi Cutrera’s line of Segreti di Sicilia products is made exclusively with ingredients from Sicily and from traditional Sicilian recipes. They are good enough to serve to company or for a quick pasta dinner. Their Sugo alle Olive is made with Sicilian green (Nocellara Etnea) and black olives (Tonda Iblea) and seasoned with onion, red garlic, red pepper, and a premium extra virgin olive oil made from the same green olives used in the sauce.

name: Segreti di Sicilia Tonno con Capperi, 290g
description: Sicilian cuisine tells the story of the many cultures that have intersected on the island—Greek, Arab, French, and Spanish. Frantoi Cutrera’s line of Segreti di Sicilia products is made exclusively with ingredients from Sicily and from traditional Sicilian recipes. They are good enough to serve to company or for a quick pasta dinner. Their Tonno con Capperi is a classic example of the Spanish influence in Sicilian food. Capers add tang to the rich tomato sauce and meaty tuna. Italian parsley enhances the flavor, and red pepper lends a slight spice.

name: Tutto Calabria Hot Spaghetti Sauce, 190g
description: Tutto Calabria is a 50-year old, family-run business that aims to share the wonderful flavors of their native Calabria (toe of the boot) with the rest of the world. Their hot spaghetti sauce uses both sweet and hot peppers, vine-ripened tomatoes, garlic and basil for a complex, spicy flavor. It’s great for more than just pasta, too! Try it as a sandwich condiment, or as a spicy pizza sauce!

name: Calpac Peeled Black Garlic, 2oz
description:
Local craftsman source, ferment and age this culinary gem using ancestral practices handed down through generations learned in Japan. Fermenting quality garlic with proper care and technique brings out its many layers of flavor. Notes of dried fig, raisin and balsamic are present along with aromas of black truffle and grape must.

Cal Pac peeled black garlic is used to add a sweet, savory, and umami-rich depth of flavor to dishes like pasta sauces, dressings, and marinades, often mashed or blended due to its soft texture. It's also great in compounds butters, mashed into potatoes or cauliflower, spread on toast, or used in unique desserts like savory ice cream.

name: Oliveri Dried Porcini, 1.76oz
description:
The Oliveri name has been synonymous with the best porcini in Piemonte since the 1920s. Raised in the heart of the Alto Monferrato, an area tucked between Piemonte and Liguria with a rich gastronomic heritage, Emilio Oliveri's grandfather became well-known for selling his and other local foragers' porcini harvest as far as Genova. Later, in the center of Acqui Terme, a small town founded by the ancient Romans and most famous for its mineral-rich geothermal springs, Emilio’s father opened a shop showcasing the finest local food treasures, drawing food enthusiasts from all over country.

Emilio Oliveri took his family's passion for porcini - "little masterpieces of nature" as he calls them - to the next level. Over the last 20 years, in addition to continuing to run his father’s store, Emilio, together with his wife Marina, started a small artisanal laboratory to produce genuine and distinctive mushroom products and specialties of the piemontese pantry. Oliveri's young, close-knit team of artisans is proud to create products that represent and help sustain their region’s traditions and authentic culture.

name: Oliveri Porcini Powder, 35g
description:
Oliveri Dried Porcini Mushroom Powder is a convenient flavor-enhancer for so many dishes. Porcini mushrooms are first dried to intensify their flavor, then pulverized into this potent, savory powder. A sprinkle of this savory seasoning instantly transforms a simple recipe into a gourmet dish.

Add a concentrated burst of earthy umami to soups, broths, marinades, spice rubs, and gravy. Sprinkle over steak tartare, fresh robiola cheese, and fried eggs. Bloom a spoonful in heavy cream with sautéed shallots to make a porcini-laced sauce for Egg Tagliatelle Capricciose. Knead the powder into fresh egg pasta dough or gnocchi dough—serve the finished pasta simply with melted butter and sage.

name: Oliveri Sliced Porcini in Olive Oil, 180g
description:
Sott’olio (under olive oil) is one of the most common ways to preserve mushrooms, but the typical production process of immediately blanching the mushrooms in a mixture of vinegar and white wine can mask porcini’s distinct aroma and flavor. Oliveri decided to break from tradition, creating an innovative way to capture the phenomenal fragrance of fresh, wild-foraged porcini in a jar.

When the freshly foraged mushrooms arrive, they are first hand-brushed to remove any dirt and debris, then trimmed. Oliveri performs a careful visual inspection and selects only the most perfect mushrooms to be preserved sott'olio. Oliveri's unique preservation process involves first steaming the mushrooms to keep them intact and preserve their firm, meaty texture. This way Oliveri ensures that the white wine and wine vinegar play a supporting role, enhancing the mushrooms’ authentic flavor and letting it shine, rather than overpowering it. The porcini are then placed by hand in jars and marinated in extra virgin olive oil with warming spices like cinnamon, bay leaf, and clove in order to exault their beautiful woody flavor.

Enjoy these precious porcini straight from the jar as the center of an aperitivo. Use as an accompaniment to beef tartare or slice over carpaccio. Top poached eggs or add to an eggs benedict. Garnish seared filet mignon.

name: Mancha-Oro Spanish Saffron, 0.8g
description: The La Mancha region in Spain is renowned for it's high quality saffron. Famous for its title as the most expensive spice by weight in the world, it is made from the dried threads of the Saffron Crocus flower. Traditionally used in Risotto alla Milanese, seafood paella and a variety of sauces, it adds distinctive flavor, aroma and color to all your recipes.

name: Ritrovo Selections Truffle & Salt, 100g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this is the original truffle salt! Award-winning and intensely aromatic, it is a blend of Italian black truffle and Adriatic sea salt. Incredibly versatile, it is great on everything from pasta to popcorn to filet mignon. Reach for this salt any time you are in need of the earthy flavor of black truffle!

name: Torres Black Truffle Chips, 125g
description: The Torres Company started as a family-run potato chip stand in 1969. The same attention to detail and passionate commitment to quality ingredients still governs them today. The result is an amazing line of snacks that not only taste amazing, but are also all natural and healthy. How can you make an otherwise perfect potato chip even better? It's easy...just add the essence of summer black truffles! Like the original, these chips are impossibly light, crisp and delicious, with the added bonus of aromatic summer truffles!

name: Villa Jerada Saffron, 1g
description: Saffron is famous for its title as the most expensive spice by weight in the world. Made from the dried threads of the Saffron Crocus flower, it is traditionally used in Risotto alla Milanese, seafood paella and a variety of sauces. A little goes a long way, adding bold, savory flavor and a distinct golden color to all your recipes.

name: Seattle Caviar Paddlefish, 1oz
description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Paddlefish, species polydon spathula, is found in the Yellowstone River and throughout the Mississippi River system. This prehistoric species produces a natural caviar and is very similar in appearance to Caspian Sevruga. It has a mild flavor and a medium bead size.

name: Seattle Caviar Ikura, 2oz
description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Chum Salmon are specifically prized for its roe and Salmon Caviar is often referred to as "Ikura" the Japanese term for caviar.

name: A L'Olivier Porcini & Truffle Olive Oil, 250ml
description: In 1822, Monsieur Popelin, a pharmacist, set up a shop devoted to olive oil in Paris and A L'Olivier was born. Today, the family owned company still makes amazing olive oil, along with high quality vinegars and nut oils. Their Porcini and truffle infused extra virgin olive oil is woodsy and mushroomy with an earthy black truffle aroma. It is ideal for finishing risotto, pasta, potatoes & creamy soups.

name: DeLaurenti Porcini Powder, 3.2oz
description: If you say you want the intense flavor of porcini mushrooms, but you also want a sauce that is smooth and creamy - this is your answer. Perfect for adding depth to soups, risotto, pasta sauces and reductions for grilled meats.

name: Matiz Organic Chestnuts, 200g
description: Not just for the holidays anymore, these Spanish chestnuts are conveniently peeled, cooked, and ready to use. Sweet and moist, enjoy them straight from the package or use in stuffing, casseroles, salads and desserts.

name: Merlini Porcini Mushrooms, 20g
description: Porcini mushrooms are a staple in Italian cooking. Whether you enjoy them fresh, in oil, or in this case dried, they add a distinct character to risotto, steak and sauces. Unlike other dried porcini, these are actually mushrooms, not bits and pieces. When you are ready to use them, just reconstitute them in hot water!

name: Moliterno al Tartufo
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
description: One of the most striking cheeses in our case, Moliterno al Tartufo looks more like rough cut marble than cheese. This is a result of the unique way of incorporating the truffle flavoring to the cheese. Made on the Italian island of Sardinia with raw sheep's milk, the unflavored cheese is partially aged, and then pierced and injected with ribbons of black truffle paste. As the truffle paste moves through the cracks and crevices of the cheese, it creates a distinct marble design. Although the truffle presence is assertive, it remains in balance with the cheese itself. It has a pronounced aroma of truffles and earth with a pleasant crumbly texture.

name: Regalis Black Summer Truffles, 1oz (0.88oz drained)
description: Subtle and delicate, these summer harvest Abruzzese truffles are milder than their winter harvest cousins. Perfect for adding a gentle note of truffle to any dish, they are preserved in their own juice for purity of flavor.

name: Regalis Black Truffle Oil, 100ml
description: Regalis has been providing truffle delicacies to professional chefs and home cooks since 2012. This black truffle oil is made with estate-grown California extra virgin olive oil naturally infused with earthy Spanish black winter truffles. Comparable to French Perigord black truffles, Spanish truffles add slightly more pungency and earthiness to the final product.

name: Regalis Truffle Carpaccio, 84g
description: Regalis has been providing truffle delicacies to professional chefs and home cooks since 2012. These fragrant Italian summer truffles from Abruzzo are sliced and preserved in extra virgin olive oil. Use as a garnish for pasta, risotto or home-made truffle butter.

name: Regalis White Truffle Oil, 100ml
description: Regalis has been providing truffle delicacies to professional chefs and home cooks since 2012. This white truffle oil is made with estate-grown California extra virgin olive oil naturally infused with pungent Italian white winter truffles. It is perfect for finishing pasta, beef carpaccio or creamy mushroom soup.

name: Ritrovo Selections Olives with Truffle, 280g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, these tender green olives from Abruzzo are packed in olive oil with flecks of aromatic truffle. The savory and earthy truffle flavor makes these olives an excellent snack for cocktail hour.

name: Ritrovo Selections White Polenta w/Truffle, 250g
description: Imported by our Seattle neighbor, Ritrovo Selections, this white corn flour with dried truffles couldn't be easier to prepare. Simple and quick to cook, just top it with sauteed mushrooms and you have a dish that can stand alone or work as a side for poultry or meat.

name: Rougie Duck Fat, 320g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world. This is the result of the company's stress free environment and closely supervised growing process. Their duck fat is flavourful and, dare we say...healthy. Truth: it contains less saturated fatty acids than butter and hardly more than olive oil. Incredibly versatile, duck fat has a high smoking point, making it great for browning and roasting. Try using it in place of butter for roasting chicken or frying potatoes!

name: Rougie Mousse Royale
description: Rougie selects only the best foie gras of 100% corn-fed duck liver. This 100% whole duck foie gras parfait makes for a completely ready-to-eat delicacy. Rougie prepares this delicate, melting foie gras mousse through the processing of high-quality lobes of Duck Foie Gras with milk cream, egg foam, a drop of Port Wine, and spices. The stunningly delicate texture and unique flavor allows it to be used as an ideal ingredient for salads, sandwiches, and as a stand-alone dish.

name: Sabarot Chanterelle Mushrooms, 30g
description: Sabarot mushrooms are rigorously selected worldwide and handled with the utmost care. Chanterelles are one of the most prized wild mushrooms in the world and have never been successfully cultivated. They are both fragrant, fruity and meaty. Great sauteed with meat dishes, in risotto or in soups and sauces. Steep in warm water for 30 minutes before using.

name: Sabarot Forest Mushrooms, 40g
description: Sabarot mushrooms are rigorously selected worldwide and handled with the utmost care. Their Fairy Ring mushrooms are perfect for preparing all your omelets, gratins, or soups. Steep in warm water for 30 minutes before using.

name: Sabarot Mousserons Fairy Ring Mushrooms, 30g
description: For over 30 years, Sabarot has been creating supply chains worldwide to ensure the quality and origins of its mushrooms.

name: Sabarot Black Trumpet Mushrooms, 40g
description: Sabarot mushrooms are rigorously selected worldwide and handled with the utmost care. Known as the "Horn of Plenty," black trumpets are considered a great delicacy. They are wonderfully fragrant and have a potent, woodsy flavor. Fantastic in vegetarian cooking, they add a richness and depth that is often the role of meat in a recipe. These mushrooms are delicious sautéed in olive oil or butter, and work well as a smoky flavoring ingredient in soups, sauces, pasta dishes. Steep in warm water for 30 minutes before using.

name: Star Porcini Mushroom Stock Cubes, 100g
description: A long-trusted brand in Italian kitchens, these cubes are excellent for enhancing any risotto or braised meat dish. One or two cubes in hot water makes a flavorful porcini broth.

name: Truffle Gouda
tagline: Raw Cow - Melkbus - Netherlands
description: Melkbus' line of cheeses are made on single-family farms identified by the numbers printed on each wheel of cheese. Truffle Gouda comes exclusively from Farm 149. This farmstead cheese starts out like traditional Boerenkaas (raw milk farmer cheese), until black truffle shavings are generously added to the curd prior to pressing. Intensely truffley, this is not only our most popular truffle cheese, but also our most popular gouda. Its texture is semi-soft and creamy with balanced flavors of sweetness, earth and truffle.

name: Truffle Mousse
tagline: Chicken liver mousse with black truffle
description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Truffle Mousse is silky smooth in texture and ultra-rich in flavor. Made with creamy chicken livers, truffles and marinated porcini mushrooms in sherry, it is perfect with a traditional French baguette and cornichons.

name: Acetaia Extravecchio Traditional Balsamic DOP
description:
Leonardi Balsamic Vinegar was born in the hills of Modena where the typical grape varieties of Lambrusco and Trebbiano are grown to obtain the grape must that is transformed into one of the world's great delicacies. There is good balsamic vinegar, and there is Traditional Balsamic Vinegar. The former is very good, the latter is in a different league. Pure grape must is reduced, fermented & aged in a series of wood barrels until it has the flavor, texture & aroma to achieve Traditional status. There is no substitude for time, and no short cuts in the process. This Extravecchio (extra aged) DOP vinegar is the grand daddy of them all.

Aged a minimum of 25 years, it is nothing short of sublime. It has the perfect balance of sweet & sour, with a velvet texture that can be poured drop by drop. This is an occasion vinegar - perfect to drizzle on grilled vegetables, aged cheeses, cured meats, or fresh berries. For the purest enjoyment, pour a few drops into a spoon and enjoy!

name: Acetaia Leonardi Traditional Balsamic DOP
description: Leonardi Balsamic Vinegar was born in the hills of Modena where the typical grape varieties of Lambrusco and Trebbiano are grown to obtain the grape must that is transformed into one of the world's great delicacies. There is good balsamic vinegar, and there is Traditional Balsamic Vinegar. The former is very good, the latter is in a different league. Pure grape must is reduced, fermented & aged in a series of wood barrels until it has the flavor, texture & aroma to achieve Traditional status. There is no substitude for time, and no short cuts in the process. This particular vinegar is aged a minimum of 12 years. It has the perfect balance of sweet & sour, with a velvet texture that can be poured drop by drop. In short, it is exquisite. Perfect to drizzle on grilled vegetables, aged cheeses, cured meats, or fresh berries. For the purest enjoyment, pour a few drops into a spoon and enjoy!

name: DeLaurenti Organic Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: Curious about what good balsamic vinegar tastes like, but not ready to drop $50 to find out? This is your answer. And that is why we sell more of this vinegar than any other. Years ago, we wanted to provide our customers with a great balsamic vinegar that wouldn't cost them an arm and a leg. With help from our friends at Ritrovo (local importer of choice), we connected with Maletti, one of the best small producers of balsamic vinegar in Italy. They make more expensive vinegars (which are also available), but none better for the price. This vinegar is to be used without reservation! You won't see the dollars dripping out all over your wild greens - when it's gone, just get more! Nicely balanced and with great viscosity, this vinegar will become a pantry staple!

name: DeLaurenti White Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
tagline: Kathleen's Favorite! Get some - she has great taste!
description: This is your go to, workhorse white balsamic vinegar. You won't always need it, but when you do, nothing else will do. Tired of staining your mozzarella & burrata for your famous caprese every summer? Those days are over. Get the same great balance of sweet and sour without the hassle. Great for drizzling, marinades and your famous vinaigrette!

name: Villa Manodori Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: Villa Manodori has been one of our best selling balsamic vinegars for years. Once customers taste it's amazing balance of sweet and sour and experience it's silky texture, there is no going back. Made using Trebbiano grape must and red wine vinegar, it is aged for 9 years in a series of oak, chestnut and juniper barrels. It is the perfect accompaniment to fresh greens, grilled vegetables, aged cheese and fresh fruit. Also great for finishing grilled meats and enriching sauces.

name: Villa Manodori Dark Cherry Balsamic, 250ml
description: Villa Manodori produces premium extra virgin olive oils and balsamic vinegars under the guidance of Massimo Bottura, the chef and owner of three-star Michelin restaurant Osteria Francescana in Modena, Italy. Named the world’s best restaurant in 2018, it is the only Italian restaurant ever to hold that title. This balsamic vinegar is made from Trebbiano grapes and red wine vinegar and aged for nine years in barrels made from Vignola cherry wood. Thick and viscous, the balsamic has a refined balance between sweet and tart. Excellent as a glaze for pork and duck, or drizzled over fruit-based desserts.

name: Maletti Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: Curious about what good balsamic vinegar tastes like? This is your answer. Friend and local importer, Ritrovo, helped us out by connecting us with Maletti, one of the best small producers of balsamic vinegar in Italy. Aged in French oak barrels that previously aged wine, this 6 year vinegar has extraordinary density, depth of flavor and a clean, delicate finish. Superb in a wide range of dishes, it is perfect drizzled on fresh berries, on a simple green salad with flakes of Parmigiano-Reggiano, or for finishing grilled meats.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 2 Medals Gold Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

A classic of the Giusti family, the 2 Gold Medals is a versatile vinegar that is medium in density, with a velvety structure and a delicate, round acidity. It is fresh and fruity, good density, over notes of mature fruits, licorice and black pepper.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 3 Medals Red Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

This 3 Gold Medal vinegar is viscous and fruity, with a recipe created at the beginning of the 20th centur.The vinegar itself, obtained from sweet, sun dried grapes is dense and sweet - making it perfect for drizzling on buratta, grilled vegetables, pork, chicken & fresh fruit.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 4 Medals Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

The 4 Gold Medals celebrates the 400 years of the Giusti family production. It's particularly sweet, dense and persistent with a rich aromatic bouquet that derives from the long aging in barrels. The aromas and flavors of plum jam and red fruits intertwine with hints of honey and vanilla. Perfect for drizzling on aged cheeses, pumpkin soup or pasta, red meat, avocados & fresh fruit.

name: Giuseppe Giusti 5 Medals Red Stripe Balsamic, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

The 5 Gold Medal Vinegar is the ultimate pride and expression of the art of Giusti vinegars. The "Banda Rossa" was the personal gift from Uncle Giuseppe to family members. This elixir has a robust body and concentration, and is distinguished by its extraordinary complexity and rich bouquet of aromas.It features notes of black cherries and sweet spices, with marked fragrances of the ancient woods in which it aged. Try it on fresh berries, aged cheeses, risotto, eggs or even in a cocktail!

name: Giuseppe Giusti White Balsamic Glaze, 150ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

This white balsamic cream is a versatile condiment obtained solely from white grapes. It is fresh and mildly sweet, with fruity and floral notes.Perfect to drizzle on fresh vegetables, fruit and seafood.

name: Giuseppe Giusti White Balsamic Vinegar, 100ml
description:
More than four centuries have passed since the ancestors of the Giusti family set up the first batteries of wooden barrels in the attic of their house in via Farini in Modena. Today, Giusti Balsamic Vinegars of Modena enhance the dishes of the world’s top chefs and grace the shelves of the most exclusive stores in Italy and around the world.

This White Balsamic Dressing is made from sweet raw juice pressed delicately from Trebbiano grapes, then combined with white wine vinegar and aged in French oak and ash casks. This process preserves all the fruity and floral aromas of the grapes, resulting in a condiment with low acidity and notes of sweet yellow fruits and dried citrus. Perfect for dressings, seafood & even cocktails!

name: Ottavi Clementine Vinegar, 250ml
description: This vinegar is amazing. Made with candied & fresh clementines, organic spirit vinegar & unrefined cane sugar, it is zesty, intense, and tangy. Ideal on shellfish, as a deglazing agent for poultry, or to give a boost to your summer vinaigrettes!

name: Ottavi Fig Vinegar, 250ml
description: Like it's Clementine Orange cousin, this vinegar is unique, smooth and spirited. It is fruity & lightly sweet with a subtle, pleasant aroma. Made solely from fresh, ripe figs from Ottavi's orchards, 8% organic spirit vinegar and unrefined cane sugar, it is perfect for deglazing poultry, as an accompaniment for foie gras & of course salads.

name: Acetaia Leonardi 3 Yr Balsamic, 250ml
description: Leonardi has been producing balsamic vinegar for 4 generations. Dark brown and velvety, this versatile condiment has an amazing balance of sweet and sour. Use this for an amazing salad dressing, or drizzle it on aged cheeses, fresh berries or grilled vegetables.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP Gold Seal, 250mL
description:
Acetaia Leonardi's Francobolli Series (francobolli means "postage stamps") is a selection of three I.G.P. Balsamic Vinegars and a Condimento Balsamico Bianco. With attractive labels that look like vintage postage stamps, this range of vinegars satisfies every balsamic need in the kitchen. Adhering to I.G.P. regulations, Acetaia Leonardi identifies the age and viscosity of their vinegars with a proprietary symbol—coins—with each coin representing approximately 2 years of aging.

Leonardi's Sigillo Oro is a careful blend of very dense cooked grape must and high quality wine vinegar. This vinegar is lightly pungent with aromas of oak and cherry with a long, bright, sweet finish.

Drizzle over prosciutto and figs, sliced figs with gorgonzola and walnuts, or any salumi platter. Ideal over a tuna or beef tartare. Drizzle over thinly sliced roast beef or pork roast. Perfect over baked apples, stone fruit, cheese cake, gelato and panna cotta.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP Red Seal, 250mL
description:
Acetaia Leonardi's Francobolli Series (francobolli means "postage stamps") is a selection of three I.G.P. Balsamic Vinegars and a Condimento Balsamico Bianco. With attractive labels that look like vintage postage stamps, this range of vinegars satisfies every balsamic need in the kitchen. Adhering to I.G.P. regulations, Acetaia Leonardi identifies the age and viscosity of their vinegars with a proprietary symbol—coins—with each coin representing approximately 2 years of aging.

Leonardi's Sigillo Rosso is a careful blend of cooked grape must and high quality wine vinegar. Enjoy aromas of fresh raspberries and a lively acidic finish. Use for all types of salads, dressings, and marinades. Deglaze any roasting pan and brush onto grilled meats. Perfect poured on peak-season tomatoes.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP Silver Seal, 250mL
description:
Acetaia Leonardi's Francobolli Series (francobolli means "postage stamps") is a selection of three I.G.P. Balsamic Vinegars and a Condimento Balsamico Bianco. With attractive labels that look like vintage postage stamps, this range of vinegars satisfies every balsamic need in the kitchen. Adhering to I.G.P. regulations, Acetaia Leonardi identifies the age and viscosity of their vinegars with a proprietary symbol "coins" with each coin representing approximately 2 years of aging.

Leonardi's Sigillo Argento is a masterful blend of cooked grape must and high quality wine vinegar. Thick as maple syrup, with notes of cooked grapes like a good Amarone, and a long subtle acidic finish.

Drizzle over a sizzling hot grilled steak or pork chop, as well as on grilled eggplant, peppers, mushrooms, and zucchini. Wonderful swirled into butternut squash soup or creamy Parmigiano risotto. Highlight the freshness of freshly sliced plums, nectarines, and peaches. Use instead of caramel or chocolate sauce over baked pears and apples.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Saba Mosto d'Uva Cotto, 250mL
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of vinegars. Their Saba is a thick syrup made from cooking grape must (freshly crushed grape juice with all the skins, seeds and stems) down in copper kettles until it’s reduced by two-thirds. It’s then aged for two years. What emerges is a fruit-forward syrup, the essence of grapes, if you will, and is redolent of raisins and Italian plums. Use as you would any balsamic reduction; drizzled over meats, fish, chicken, cheese, berries, and stone fruit.

name: Acetaia Leonardi White Balsamic, 100ml
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of vinegars. Their Balsamico Bianco is made with Trebbiano grapes, blended with Italian white wine vinegar, and aged in wood barrels for four years. The all-purpose vinegar has citrus and pear notes and a good balance of acidic tartness and fruity sweetness. Use this in salad dressings and sauces.

name: Acetaia Leonardi Whitle Balsamic
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of vinegars. Their Balsamico Bianco is made with Trebbiano grapes, blended with Italian white wine vinegar, and aged in wood barrels for four years. The all-purpose vinegar has citrus and pear notes and a good balance of acidic tartness and fruity sweetness. Use this in salad dressings and sauces.

name: Leonardi Crema all' Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP, 100ml
description: The premier balsamic vinegars come from Modena, and Acetaia Leonardi is a classic producer. The fourth-generation family-owned operation grows their own Lambrusco and Trebbiano grapes for their award-winning line of balsamic vinegars. Their Crema, or glaze, is a balsamic reduction made by cooking down grape must (freshly crushed grape juice with all the skins, seeds and stems) until it has the consistency of syrup, then blending it with their aged balsamic vinegar. The glaze is sweet and tangy and is exceptional drizzled on nearly anything: cheese, meats, roasted vegetables, even ice-cream.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa 30 yr Anniversary Balsamic, 100ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. This amazing vinegar was created to commemorate La Vecchia's 30th anniversary. Dense & syrupy, it has an intensely sweet flavor profile that is the result of the grape must being cooked down further before being transfered to wood barrels for aging and fermentation. It is perfect for salad dressing, or for drizzling drop by drop over shards of Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh berries, grilled meats or even ice cream.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Apple and Citrus Balsamic, 100ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Condimento Balsamic is truly a unique product. Made with 60% apple syrup, 30% balsamic vinegar, 10% acacia honey & fresh citrus rind, it is at once sweet, sour & fruity. Velvety in texture, it makes a perfect dessert topping. Try drizzling it on fresh ricotta, ice cream or seasonal berries.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Foglia Rosa Balsamic, 250ml
tagline: Pink Leaf Balsamic
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Foglia Rossa Balsamic is a Gold Medal winner at the USI Vinegar 2024 Competition. It has an intense fresh acidity with mature red fruit notes, making it ideal with cold dishes, grilled vegetables & eggs. Aromas of oak, cherry & chestnut on the palate define this award winning vinegar.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Foglia Verde Balsamic, 250ml
tagline: Green Leaf Balsamic
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in the town of Castelvetr, near Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Foglia Verde vinegar is a versatile blend with the perfect balance of sweetness and acidity. If there were an official price/quality index for balsamic, this vinegar would score in the upper right hand corner. Use it liberally on everything from salads to fresh berries.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Foglia Viola Balsamic, 250ml
tagline: Violet Leaf Balsamic
description:
La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar.

Violet Label Balsamic Vinegar of Modena IGP is a vinegar with a fine aromatic structure. The consistency is moderately syrupy, and its medium density makes it perfect for everything from grilled vegetables to white meats and fish.

Perfect for those who appreciate a vinegar that is not too sweet, but no less intense. Like any high-quality Balsamic Vinegar, it is characterized by an elegant aromatic bouquet, the result of aging in barrels of fine woods. It has lovely fruity notes of cherry and mulberry, with pleasant hints of vanilla from the oak and acacia.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Nobili Sapori Balsamic, 250ml
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Nobili Sapori Balsamic is a blend of cooked grape must and wine vinegar that has been aged for 5 years in a variety of wooden barrels. Bright and tangy, it is a great value that is perfect for salad dressing, recipes and marinades.

name: La Vecchia Dispensa Organic Balsamic, 250ml
tagline: 100% Organic
description: La Vecchia Dispensa started as a family restaurant in Modena in 1973. Since the 1980s, however, they have been wholly dedicated to the production of fine balsamic vinegar. Their Organic Balsamic is a blend of cooked grape must and high quality aged wine vinegar. It has a balanced sweet & sour character with a bright and fruity finish. Use it on salads, grilled vegetables or reduce on the stove for a glaze to finish grilled meats or fish.

name: Calogiuri Fig Vincotto, 250ml
description: This unique condiment is made from grape must aged four years in wood barrels. Figs are added during the third year of aging, giving the vinegar a balanced sweet and tart complexity. Use it for salad dressing, finishing grilled meats and vegetables, with fresh cheese, or even drizzle over ice cream.

name: Elsa 12 yr Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: This classic vinegar is made from the ancient Lambrusco grape varieties - Maestri, Salamino, and Sorbara. Careful and lengthy aging in cherry, chestnut, acacia, oak and juniper barrels imparts a rich, complex flavor and a velvety texture. Perfect for salad dressing, drizzling on fresh strawberries, and roasted meats.

name: Elsa 6 yr Balsamic Vinegar, 250ml
description: This classic vinegar is the starter version of it's older sibling. Made from the same ancient Lambrusco grape varieties - Maestri, Salamino, and Sorbara.
