This gives it the characteristic pear-shaped body, which is sure to stand out on any cheese plate. A relative of Fior di Latte (fresh) mozzarella, but with a bolder and more buttery flavor. An excellent cooking cheese on dishes like lasagna and pizza.

name: Boorenkaas Farmstead Gouda
tagline: Raw Cow - Cheeseland - Netherlands
description: Boorenkaas Farmstead Gouda is a younger gouda, made by hand in small batches with the pure, unpasteurized milk from farmer’s own dairy cows. It has rich, complex flavor which compliments every dish. Try it as an appetizer, melted onto your favorite sandwich, or on a dessert plate!

name: Calabro Smoked Mozzarella
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Calabro Cheese Co. - East Haven, CT
description: Naturally smoked for a deep aromatic flavor, this old-style mozzarella delivers the same creamy texture and excellent melt as the classic version, with an added hint of smokiness. Perfect for pizzas, panini and rustic dishes baked in wood-fired oven.

name: Danish Havarti
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Castello - Denmark
description: Made in the traditional Danish fashion, this Havarti is creamy, buttery and mild with a slight tang. Great for melting and grilling.

name: Emmenthaler
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Le Superbe - Emmental, Switzerland
description: Production of this ancient cheese can be traced back to the 13th century. In its youth, it is semi-firm, mild, and nutty, becoming more aromatic and intense as it ages. Made with raw cow's milk, Emmenthaler is known for its characteristic cherry-sized holes that occur during the fermentation process. It is one of the world's greatest melting cheeses - use it in fondue, gratin or macaroni and cheese. Lastly, it is the required cheese for your pastrami sandwich.

name: Ferndale Farmstead Mozzarella
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Ferndale Farmstead - Ferndale, WA
description:
Located just a few miles northwest of Bellingham, family-run Ferndale Farmstead combines old-world, artisan-taught cheesemaking techniques with a “seed to cheese” approach to their production. This means that not only do they source their milk from their own herd of cows, but they also grow their own feed using sustainable agricultural practices that address both the nutritional needs of the cows and the environmental needs of the land.

Delicate in flavor and texture, this mozzarella is made the old-fashioned way, with Italian cultures instead of vinegar. The result is a delightful fresh cheese that combines exceptional grass-fed Washington whole milk with traditional Italian production techniques.

name: Fontina Val d'Aosta
tagline: Raw Cow - Fromagerie Haut Val'Ayas - Piedmont, Italy
description: Often imitated, never duplicated - Fontina Val d'Aosta is the original Italian fontina. It is semi-firm & creamy, with a washed rind that imparts a mildly pungent aroma. Flavors are rich and nutty with a subtle hint of fruit and grass. One of the world's greatest melting cheeses, it is the centerpiece to Piedmont's famous fonduta - a silky blend of Fontina val D'Aosta, cream, eggs, and shaved white truffle. Also fantastic on a sandwich with prosciutto, or added to mozzarella on a pizza.

name: Gruyere 1655
tagline: Raw Cow - Fromagerie le Cret - Fribourg, Switzerland
description: Master Cheesemaker Jean-Marie Dunand runs the village dairy at 3,000 ft above sea level in the heartland of traditional Gruyère production in the Fribourg region of Switzerland. The dairy, which dates back to 1900, has been run by Dunand since 1986. He makes 18-20 wheels of Gruyère each day, 365 days a year, using freshly delivered milk from eight small local farms. After three months, the wheels are moved to the caves of Fromage Gruyère, where they are finished aging for the next 9 months before release. Each wheel is rigorously evaluated by an expert team before earning the 1655 label. The result is a cheese that is perfectly balanced. Sweet, salty, nutty, fruity, mushroomy and earthy.

name: Jack
tagline: Cow - Rumiano Cheese Co. - Crescent City, CA
description: A California original, Monterey Jack was originally made by the Franciscan monks of Monterey, California during the 1800’s and later marketed by businessman David Jacks, hence the name Monterey Jack. This staple cheese has a creamy texture & mild flavor. Great to have in the fridge for hot and cold sandwiches, tacos, nachos or for old school cheese and crackers.

name: Provolone
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Belgioioso - Green Bay, WI
description: This is the workhorse Provolone that we commonly use on a variety of sandwiches in our cafe. As mentioned, it's great on a sandwich, hot or cold, but is also a fantastic melter for your lasagna or pizza. Mild, lactic, and creamy, it provides great flavor without being overwhelming. Looking for something more intense? Check out our Italian Provolone Piccante.

name: Provolone Piccante
tagline: Pasteurized Cow - Mitica - Lombardy, Italy
description: This is real Provolone. Imported from the Lombardy region of northern Italy, it is made with raw cow's milk that has been aged 6 to 7 months. Flavors are intensely piquant, strong, nutty and fruity. Before we cut it down to size, this wheel of cheese looks like a giant head of garlic that weighs about 50 pounds. Perfect for everything from sandwiches to pizza to antipasti to lasagna.

name: Parmigiano Reggiano - 24 month
tagline: Raw Cow - Boni - Emilia-Romagna, Italy
description: The king of Italian cheese, and one that belongs in your refrigerator 100% of the time - and it does not come in a green can. Parmigiano-Reggiano's different stages of maturity are recognized by aging seals given at 18, 24 and 30 months - this one is the 24 month version. You can grate or shave Parmigiano on just about anything except your fish; it is also underused as a table cheese. When you have grated all the paste you can, save the rind for flavoring stocks, soups and braises!

name: DeLaurenti Grated Blend
description: Our famous house blend of Parmesan and Romano. Grated for ease and ready to use.

name: Grana Padano DOP
tagline: Raw Cow - Agriform - Emilia-Romagna, Italy
description: From the Emilia-Romagna region in Northern Italy, Grana Padano is made with raw cow's milk and aged an average of 16 to 18 months. Akin to Parmigiano-Reggiano, its first name, Grana, was bestowed upon it for its granular texture. Its last name, Padano, refers to the Po Valley Plain where it is produced. It is firm with a thick rind, and a straw yellow, granular paste. While it has just enough moisture to make an excellent table cheese, Grana Padano is usually grated or shaved on pasta and salads, or used as an ingredient.

name: Moliterno al Tartufo
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
description: One of the most striking cheeses in our case, Moliterno al Tartufo looks more like rough cut marble than cheese. This is a result of the unique way of incorporating the truffle flavoring to the cheese. Made on the Italian island of Sardinia with raw sheep's milk, the unflavored cheese is partially aged, and then pierced and injected with ribbons of black truffle paste. As the truffle paste moves through the cracks and crevices of the cheese, it creates a distinct marble design. Although the truffle presence is assertive, it remains in balance with the cheese itself. It has a pronounced aroma of truffles and earth with a pleasant crumbly texture.

name: Parmigiano Reggiano Cravero
tagline: Raw Cow - Essex St. Cheese/Cravero - Bra, Italy
description: This Parmigiano Reggiano begins with the milk of cows that graze among the mountains of Benedello di Pavullo, one of very few Parms made exclusively from mountain pasture milk. After 13 months of aging at the San Pietro dairy, Giorgio Cravero selects wheels to move to his cheese hall in Bra, Italy, where his family has been aging Parmigiano Reggiano since 1855. Cravero continues to age the cheese for a minimum of 24 months. During this time, he and his team flip the wheels every other week, much more frequently than is typical for Parmigiano Reggiano. The result is a cheese with an exceptionally smooth, creamy texture. With notes of butter, tropical fruit, grass, and freshly baked bread, this Parmigiano is equally at home on a cheese board as it is in your favorite dish. Pair it with a sparkling white wine for a simple indulgence!

name: Parmigiano Reggiano Vacche Rosse
tagline: Raw Cow - Latteria Soresina - Emilia-Romagna, Italy
description: This unique Parmigiano is made exclusively from the milk of the Reggiana breed of cow, known for its beautiful red coat. This cheese tastes like the Parmigiano-Reggiano of days gone by. It is higher in butterfat and natural proteins, producing a more fruity, nutty and grassy flavor that surpasses traditional Parmigiano Reggiano. Reserve for special dishes, or eating on its own with cured meats and aged balsamic vinegar.

name: Pecorino Ginepro
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Mitica - Emilia-Romagna, Italy
description: Pecorino Ginepro is one of the most unique cheeses in our case. For the first month of aging this semi-firm, sheep's milk cheese is bathed in balsamic vinegar and juniper berries, then aged in oak barrels. The resulting rind is a mottled brown while the paste remains bone white with a slightly granular and flaky texture. Flavors are rich, sweet & herbal with aromas of earth and fruit.

name: Pecorino Romano Fulvi DOP
tagline: Raw Sheep - Sini Fulvi - Lazio, Italy
description: What was once rationed to Roman legionnaires is now a staple in Italian households. Sini Fulvi's Pecorino Romano bears the "Genuino" label, signifying that it is produced in Lazio, the area surrounding Rome. Aged 10 months to 1 year and coated in black wax per tradition, Fulvi is in a class by itself. What separates Fulvi from other Pecorino Romanos is the higher butterfat content of the whole (not skimmed) sheep’s milk. This gives the cheese more moisture than its Sardinian counterparts. Although great eaten as is, it is made to grate on pastas & salads. An indispensable ingredient in your Bucatini all’Amatriciana.

name: Pecorino Romano Locatelli
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Locatelli - Sardinia, Italy
description: Locatelli's version of Pecorino Romano is one of the finest. This ancient cheese is made with 100% sheep's milk and aged a minimum of 9 months. The result is a cheese that is dry, sharp and spicy; making it one of the world's great grating cheeses. Perfect on pasta, salads & pizza. It also pairs wonderfully with pears, apples, hazelnuts & honey.

name: Pecorino Sardo
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
description: Pecorino Sardo is produced on the island of Sardinia off the west coast of Italy. Historically, this sheep's milk cheese was produced by sheperds in small mountain huts known as "pinnette". The natural smoke from the hut's central, open fires gives the cheese its characteristically smoky overtones. The texture of the outer rind of Pecorino Sardo is dry and hard and, depending on age, a pale golden-rust color or a deep rich burnt brown. The texture of the cheese is very firm and dense and straw-ivory in color. Flavors are sweet, rich and nut-like with notes of burned caramel, smoke and salt.

name: Piccolo Canestrato
tagline: Pasteurized Sheep - Central Formaggi - Sardinia, Italy
description: Made from 100% sheep's milk, Canestrato is a great all-around pecorino. Produced in Sardinia, it is just as good on a cheese board as it is as a grating cheese. Semi-firm and slightly crumbly in texture, it has a nice balance of salt and sweet, finishing with a pleasant spice. The rind features distinctive hatch marks left by its traditional wicker basket mold during aging.

name: Staff Pick - Meats, Cheeses & Antipasti
tagline: You choose how many people, we do the rest!
description:
We have fantastic, passionate staff members working in our deli. This is your opportunity to trust them to choose what they are excited about. Just tell us how many people, and we will do the rest. What arrives will be a thoughtfully chosen selection of meats, cheeses & antipasti for the number of people you specify. The items themselves may or may not be offered elsewhere on the site, this is your chance to get whatever our staff feels is the best right now! If you love everything in our deli and trust us enough to choose, we're ready to put it together!

name: CasCioppo's Hot Sausage
tagline: Seattle's famous handmade spicy Italian sausage
description: A Seattle landmark since 1947, CasCioppo's famous Italian sausage has been our house sausage for over 40 years. Made with garlic, spices, and red pepper, this hot sausage is perfect for grilling, lasagna, meat sauce, pizza, or any other place when you want things to taste better. Cook to temperature with or without the casing and enjoy. Apx 5 to 6 links to a pound.

name: CasCioppo's Mild Sausage
tagline: Seattle's famous handmade sweet Italian sausage
description: A Seattle landmark since 1947, CasCioppo's famous Italian sausage has been our house sausage for over 40 years. Made with garlic and a blend of spices, this sweet sausage is perfect for grilling, lasagna, meat sauce, pizza, or any other place when you want things to taste better. Cook to temperature with or without the casing and enjoy. Apx 5 to 6 links to a pound.

name: DeLaurenti Housemade Meatballs
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description:
Ok, these are the real deal - created and produced in the comfort of our kitchen upstairs at the store. Approximately 6 meatballs per pound, FULLY COOKED and ready to go! Your only job is choosing the number of meatballs & deciding whether you want them lightly covered in sauce or plain. Want more than twelve? Just choose the number, a quantity & multiply it! Ie: 12 meatballs, qty of 2 = 24 meatballs! Want them swimming in sauce instead of just covered? Order more DeLaurenti Marinara to go with it!

As an ode to Nate's Nonna, we love to serve 3 meatballs in a bowl with red sauce, Reggiano & a piece of grilled bread. This was the only thing that would keep him and his cousins from tearing the house apart. They lined up and were dispensed a sampler meatball in sauce and a piece of bread for dipping. Receiving it was committing to good behavior. They are great served as such, piled into a soft roll, or, of course combined with some marinara & tossed with spaghetti! If you would like, we include enough sauce to cover. You might want to order another container of marinara!

name: Olympia Provisions Frankfurter, 4pk footlongers
tagline: Old School Frankfurter that hangs out of the bun!
description: Heralded as the best hot dog in America, Olympia Provisions foot-long frankfurter, made with pure pork shoulder and a natural lamb casing, is smoked with hickory and apple wood. Do you love a snappy, old fashioned frankfurter that hangs off the end of the bun? Well, we do too! At some point in the last thirty years, the hot dog has become a bun-fitting, casing-free mockery of what a frankfurter should be. When the folks at Olympia Provisions set out out make their first frankfurter, they wanted to make the frankfurter that they remembered loving as kids. The real O.G. foot-long - with two extra inches of pure meat enjoyment and a casing with a snap! This is guaranteed to be one of the best hot dogs you'll enjoy.

name: Riccio's Hot Calabrian Sausage
tagline: Traditional Calabrian-style hot sausage
description: Riccio's Sausage is made with the highest quality ingredients. They seek to bring you the most authentic and traditional Calabrian flavors by using only the best cuts of prime pork shoulder and absolutely no preservatives. Salsiccia Calabrese, the most popular sausage of Southern Italy, is seasoned with salt, peperoncino picante (Chili pepper), and peperoncino dolce (Sweet Chili pepper). Squeeze them out of the casing and incorporate them into pasta, or throw them directly on the grill and enjoy them with grilled peppers & onions!

name: Riccio's Hot Calabrian Sausage, 16oz
tagline: Traditional Calabrian-style hot sausage - 4 links per package
description: Riccio's Sausage is made with the highest quality ingredients. They seek to bring you the most authentic and traditional Calabrian flavors by using only the best cuts of prime pork shoulder and absolutely no preservatives. Salsiccia Calabrese, the most popular sausage of Southern Italy, is seasoned with salt, peperoncino picante (Chili pepper), and peperoncino dolce (Sweet Chili pepper). Squeeze them out of the casing and incorporate them into pasta, or throw them directly on the grill and enjoy them with grilled peppers & onions! Hot means hot but not TOO hot. Hot when you can taste the great ingredients, not just the fire.

name: Riccio's Mild Calabrian Sausage, 16oz
tagline: Traditional Calabrian-style mild sausage - 4 links per package
description: Riccio's Sausage is made with the highest quality ingredients. They seek to bring you the most authentic and traditional Calabrian flavors by using only the best cuts of prime pork shoulder and absolutely no preservatives. Salsiccia Calabrese, the most popular sausage of Southern Italy, is seasoned with salt, peperoncino picante (Chili pepper), and peperoncino dolce (Sweet Chili pepper). Squeeze them out of the casing and incorporate them into pasta, or throw them directly on the grill and enjoy them with grilled peppers & onions! Mild in this case does not mean without some spice, it means warmly spiced rather than hot!

name: Baker's Sous-Vide Bacon
description: In 2011, Chef Tony Baker began his mission to recreate the high quality bacon he was accustomed to while growing up in the countryside of England. Unable to find bacon that met his high standards for freshness and ingredients, he founded his own brand. Baker’s Bacon began with a partnership between long time smoke master and bacon expert Steve Sacks at Prime Smoked Meats in Oakland, California. Baker and Sacks worked together for over a year experimenting with cures until they settled on the recipe that is still in use today. With the use of humanely raised heritage pork and a time honored curing technique, Baker’s Bacon delivers sweet and smoky flavors, perfect for your morning breakfast, a BLT, or any other time of day when bacon is required!

name: DeLaurenti Sausage Dust, 1/4 lb
tagline: Old School Pittsburgh Style!
description: Achieve pizza greatness by making sure you have sausage in every bite of your sausage pizza! There's a time for chunks, there's a time for rounds, and there is a time for DUST! Fully cooked and ready to top your pizza Pittsburgh-style, this sausage dust will crisp up in the oven and take your pie to the next level!

name: Despana Traditional Chorizo
tagline: Made with imported Pimenton de la Vera spice
description: Made using a family recipe from Northern Spain, Despaña chorizo incorporates De la Vera paprika, garlic powder, and natural casings to create this classic Spanish pork sausage. Rich and mildly spicy, these are perfect for paella, stews, pasta dishes, or anywhere you want to add smoky-sweet heat and savory pork. Approximately 5 links to a pound.

name: Leoncini Pancetta
tagline: Lightly smoked Italian pancetta
description: Imported from Italy, Leoncini's Pancetta is a fully cooked and lightly smoked slab pancetta. Our best selling pancetta, it is perfect for pastas, vegetables, pizza, and wrapping your shrimp. We recommend trimming the rind before use to avoid popping in the pan while you sauté. Although the smoke is subtle, it is definitely present.

name: Levoni Pancetta
description: The Levoni Company has only been making great charcuterie since 1911. Over 100 years and still going strong. When it was essential to fight the harsh climates even with food, to endure physical exertions of manual labor and face daily trips on foot or by bicycle, the fat parts of the pig used to be considered "gold" because they brought a lot of energy. This is how pancetta became a sought-after food... Of course, its deliciousness helped its success on Italian tables quite a bit. Equally at home on a charcuterie board and in sandwiches as it is in recipes, this pancetta has a delicate aroma, characterized by pepper and cloves. The perfect addition to pastas, vegetables, pizza, and wrapping your shrimp.

name: Molinari Coteghino, 14oz
tagline: The News Years Classic!
description: Cotechino is originally an Emilian sausage made of pork, lard, pork rind and spices. Because of the pork rind, it was once viewed as peasant food, but it has nevertheless won a place of honor at the table on Christmas and New Year’s Eve. Cotechino di Modena has earned PGI recognition. It is delicious with eggplant, or lentils and it's consumption is closely linked to the New Year’s holiday. It represents abundance and is served for good luck!

name: Smoking Goose Guanciale
tagline: Cured pork jowel with black pepper & coriander
description: From Smoking Goose in Indiana, this guanciale, or pork jowel, is dry-rub-cured with black pepper and coriander before being lightly smoked over apple wood. Perfect for your Carbonara or Bucatini all'Amatriciana, or for any other time you entertain bacon being an option.

name: Smoking Goose Lardo
description: What is Lardo? It is melt-in-your-mouth, cured pork back fat. Seasoned with juniper berries, rosemary, and bay leaf, Smoking Goose's Lardo is delicate in texture and rich in savory flavor, sure to add a new dimension to any dish. Wrap thin slices around melon or grilled shrimp, melt into roasted potatoes, or enjoy it simply on top of warm, grilled bread. All Smoking Goose recipes begin on the farm. They partner with small, family farms in Indiana and neighboring states raising animals as nature intended: no Gestation Pens, Antibiotic Free, 100% Vegetarian Feed, No Growth Promotants.

name: Fra'Mani Sweet Apple Ham
description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. Not surprisingly, this Sweet Apple Ham is tender & delicious. It pairs a touch of smoke with the subtle flavors of apple juice. It is hand trimmed with a delicious layer of cover fat that gives is an unforgettable luscious taste. Perfect for sandwiches & all your other roasted ham needs!

name: Rovagnati Mortadella
tagline: Italian mortadella with pistachios, sliced
description: In the ancient days of "waste not want not," mortadella was born. While originally made using leftovers and whatever was available, today Rovagnati uses only prime cuts of pork shoulder, leg, and belly. This Italian Mortadella is the real deal, no mystery meat. It is flecked with pistachios, sliced thin and ready for your antipasti platter or sandwich.

name: Braceri Ham with Herbs
description: Braceri cooked ham with herbs is made in the ancient village of Lavezzola in Italy's Emilia-Romagna region. Lavezzola has always embodied a long-standing bond between food and landscape and is famous for traditional Italian charcuterie. Slow cooked for up to 17 hours, it is covered with a bouquet of fennel, rosemary, coriander, clove, anise, and caraway. Staff favorite next-level ham!

name: Carnegie Deli Pastrami
tagline: The NYC original since 1937
description: This is the most famous deli meat from the most famous deli in NYC. If you have been, you know. If you haven't, imagine a tower of warm pastrami aloft what amounts to be two diminutive pieces of rye bread. Too much for you? Not to worry - when you have this pastrami at home, you can make the sandwich any way you want! Add a few slices of emmenthaler, some grainy mustard and a pickle and save yourself the cost of airfare!

name: Columbus Roasted Turkey
tagline: Artisan turkey breast, sliced
description: Columbus Craft Meats is an artisan deli and cured meat company that takes great pride in using only the best ingredients.  In that vein, this is plain, all natural, oven roasted turkey.  No fillers, no forming, and no additives or preservatives.  It is lightly seasoned and then slow-roasted in the oven for a juicy, satisfying flavor. It tastes like...turkey.  The same turkey we used every day to make one of our most popular cafe sandwiches, the Tacchino.

name: Fra'Mani Mortadella
tagline: Classic Mortadella withOUT the Pistachios!
description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salume products since 2006. Mortadella is not bologna, it is what bologna aspires to be. Fra' Mani uses only prime cuts of pork shoulder, leg, and belly that is meticulously hand-trimmed and minced. After slow roasting, it's finished with a light fruitwood smoke. We slice this thin, ready for your antipasti platter or sandwich. Natural nitrates.

name: Jack Mountain Smoked Ham
tagline: Slow smoked artisan ham from Burlington, WA!
description: Jack Mountain Meats, our neighbors to the North up in Burlington, WA, is an artisan food company dedicated to locally sourced, handcrafted, quality food. They utilize modern equipment and technology while maintaining old fashioned, handcrafted techniques. Their hams are selected each week, carefully trimmed then brined with their own in-house spice blends and rubbed with thyme and garlic. After resting for three days, they are smoked all day over hazelnut shells. The result is a delicious, savory ham you will absolutely love.

name: Jambon de Paris
tagline: Artisan French-style ham, sliced
description: Bec Fin's Jambon de Paris is slow-cooked to maintain its natural juices and flavor. The result is a far less salty, moist and tender French-style cooked ham. Perfect on a baguette with Comte and cornichons, or in an omelet or quiche.

name: Leoncini Prosciutto Cotto
tagline: Classic Italian cooked ham, sliced
description: Leoncini's Prosciutto Cotto is gently brined before being slow roasted to perfection, preserving all the natural juices and flavors of the ham. Delicate in texture and bright pink in color, it is well marbled and flavorful. Great for antipasti and sandwiches.

name: Molinari Finocchiona Salame
tagline: Classic dry cured fennel salame
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Finocchiona Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with fennel. Finely minced in texture, sweet and flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame
tagline: Classic dry cured salame with black pepper
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame - 12oz Piece
tagline: Classic dry cured salame, 12 oz whole
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! In its whole form, great to cut by hand a little bit, or a lot at a time!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame, 3.25lb stick
tagline: Classic dry cured salame, whole
description:
Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! This is the whole 3+ pound stick!

*Final weight & price will be determined when we process your order.

name: Molinari Toscano Salame
tagline: Classic dry cured salame, sliced
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Toscano Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with whole black peppercorns. Coarsely ground in texture, tangy and flavorful. A DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Taylor Pork Roll, 1lb
tagline: The New Jersey Classic
description: Taylor Ham, AKA Taylor Pork Roll, was developed in 1856 by John Taylor of Trenton, New Jersey. Springsteen and Taylor Ham - easily the two best things to come out of New Jersey. Don't knock it until you try it! Here's what you do: slice it up, and make a few cuts around the outside edge to keep it flat during cooking. Pan fry until light brown and enjoy! Combine it with a fried egg and cheese on a soft kaiser roll for the ultimate Jersey breakfast sandwich!

name: Tempesta 'Ndujadella
description: Tempesta Artisan Salumi’s latest innovation! After over two years of research and development, Tempesta brings together the savory slice-ability of their award-winning Mortadella with the fire of their heritage ‘Nduja! ‘Ndujadella is their Mortadella, made as you would only find made by craftsmen in Bologna, infused with Calabrian fire. They fold their aged ‘Nduja directly into the emulsion! The traditional garnishes of black peppercorns and pistachios have been replaced with the skins of Calabrian chilies. A truly unique charcuterie offering, the texture is yielding, but sliceable. The signature heat and fruity aroma of the Calabrian chilies is bold, while gaining depth over the course of aging as ‘nduja. The cooked fat of the mortadella lends a richness that fills the palate with savory flavor. Unique offering as a piccante addition to any charcuterie board or a mind-blowing addition to any sandwich. One taste and you’ll be hooked!

name: Tempesta Wagyu Pastrami
tagline: Yes, this is made with Wagyu Beef!
description: There is pastrami, and then there is PASTRAMI. This is capital letter pastrami. Tempesta's version is made with American Wagyu Beef that has been seasoned in a flavorful brine for days before getting rubbed in molasses and spices. Next it is slow smoked and cooked in sessions with maple wood. Incredibly tender and delicious, it will take your game-day Reuben to the next level!

name: Zoe's Meats Roast Beef
tagline: Artisan roast beef, sliced
description: Marinated using their house blend of garlic, herbs, and spices, Zoe's Roast Beef is tender, juicy, and intensely flavored. It makes a daily appearance in our cafe on one of our most popular sandwiches, the Arrosto - a combination of roast beef, reserve Gruyere, arugula and truffle mayonnaise. Also highly recommended for the next time French Dip is on the menu.

name: DeLaurenti House Pate
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Our ultra smooth House Pate is back with a new recipe! A house favorite for years! Serve with cornichons and a crusty Macrina baguette. Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: Fabrique & Delice Duck Mousse
tagline: Silky mousse made with fresh duck livers marinated in port
description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Duck Mousse is buttery and smooth in texture, and ultra-rich in flavor. Made with fresh duck livers marinated in port wine, it is perfect enjoyed with a traditional French baguette and cornichons.

name: Fabrique & Delice Pate de Campagne
tagline: Country-style pork pate with black pepper
description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Pate de Campagne is a coarsely ground country-style pate liberally seasoned with black pepper. It has a great rustic texture and a rich, meaty flavor. Fantastic served with a crusty baguette, pickled vegetables and whatever wine you enjoy.

name: Henaff Pork Liver Confit with Black Pepper, 90g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives. This pork liver confit is seasoned with cognac, black peppercorn, salt and spices.

name: Henaff Pork Liver Pate, 130g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives.

name: Henaff Pork Pate de Campagne, 130g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives. The recipe, originating from the village of Brenton, includes pork neck, garlic, and onion for a unique combination of flavors.

name: Henaff Pork Pate, 153g
description: Henaff has been a family business in Brittany, France for over 100 years and is the French leader in pork pates. Henaff only uses fresh meat from the best locally raised pigs. No coloring, no artificial flavor and no preservatives. This is their flagship Pate that has been around for the long haul. Still a favorite after all these years!

name: Rillettes de Gascogne (Duck)
description: Le Bec Fin has been crafting traditional charcuterie since 1999 by using finest cuts of all natural meats, world's best spices and fresh vegetables - the result is some of the most delicious artisanal charcuterie you'll find. Their Rillettes de Gascogne are made by simmering shredded duck meat in duck fat. Add some grainy mustard, cornichons, crusty baguette, and you will have a perfect spread!

name: Rougie Duck & Pork Pate with Orange, 80g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this smooth pate is blended to perfection and doused with a liberal dose of refreshing orange liquor. Serve slightly chilled with a crusty baguette, cheese and a glass of Sauternes!

name: Rougie Duck Foie Gras, 80g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this foie gras is buttery, smooth, and ultra-rich. To fully enjoy its full flavor, keep things simple. Warm up a knife in hot water and cut half-inch-thick slices. Place the slices on toasted baguette and add fleur de sel and black pepper to taste. Pour a glass of Sauternes and enjoy!

name: Rougie Duck Rillettes, 80g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Similar to pate, these tasty rillettes are prepared with duck meat, white wine and herbs. Fully cooked and ready to eat, serve slightly chilled with a crusty baguette, cheese and a glass of Sauternes!

name: Rougie Foie Gras Torchon, 3.25oz
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this foie gras is buttery, smooth, and ultra-rich. To fully enjoy it's full flavor, keep things simple. Warm up a knife in hot water and cut half inch thick slices. Place the slices on toasted baguette and add fleur de sel and black pepper to taste. Pour a glass of Sauternes and enjoy!

name: Rougie Mousse Royale
description: Rougie selects only the best foie gras of 100% corn-fed duck liver. This 100% whole duck foie gras parfait makes for a completely ready-to-eat delicacy. Rougie prepares this delicate, melting foie gras mousse through the processing of high-quality lobes of Duck Foie Gras with milk cream, egg foam, a drop of Port Wine, and spices. The stunningly delicate texture and unique flavor allows it to be used as an ideal ingredient for salads, sandwiches, and as a stand-alone dish.

name: Truffle Mousse
tagline: Chicken liver mousse with black truffle
description: Fabrique Delice has been making classic French-style pates and other specialty products for the last 30 years. Their Truffle Mousse is silky smooth in texture and ultra-rich in flavor. Made with creamy chicken livers, truffles and marinated porcini mushrooms in sherry, it is perfect with a traditional French baguette and cornichons.

name: The Grand Salame
tagline: A hand picked assortment of salame from our meat case!
description:
You have to have a salame lover on your list. Perhaps it's you? Dad? Grandpa? Either way, just tell us how much you would like to spend, and we will pick out a great selection for that special someone on your list. We are going to stick to small format sticks & chunks of delicious salame to ensure they keep well. The number of sticks in the assortment and the variety with vary with the budget you choose. If the meat case is this person's favorite section of the store, this gift is for them!

*Since this is a gift, we will keep the prices off the items.

name: Leporati Prosciutto di Parma, 24 month
tagline: handcut paper thin with care when you order it!
description: The Leporati family has been making prosciutto for more than 3 generations. The quality of their products is evident - only the most carefully raised and selected hogs are used to make their reserve prosciutto. Cured with just enough salt, this prosciutto is left to age in drying rooms on traditional wooden frames for at least 24 months. Bold, buttery, aromatic and a bit more concentrated than its 16 month counterpart. Trimmed and sliced paper thin with care when you order it. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Pio Tosini Prosciutto di Parma
tagline: Traditional Italian Prosciutto di Parma
description: The roots of the Pio Tosini company run deep and date back to the beginning of the last century (1905) in the heart of northern Italy, where Ferrante Tosini (Pio Tosini’s father) started his business slaughtering pigs and curing his own cuts of pork meat in the back room of the family’s grocery store. Today, Pio Tosini is still a family company, where Pio’s son-in-law and nephew carry on their family’s century old tradition and passion. Because they use less salt in the curing process, their hams must be of the highest quality and age for a longer time (up to 20 months) to achieve their signature sweetness. The result of this passion and experience is a Prosciutto di Parma that is unsurpassed in flavor, texture and quality. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Fermin Jamon Iberico de Bellota
tagline: The Top of the Cured meat mountain - one of the world's great delicacies
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Still family owned and operated in the medieval mountain town of La Alberca, they were also the first to bring authentic Spanish Iberico and Serrano ham to the US. Along with caviar, foie-gras and truffles, Iberico de Bellota ham is truly one of the world's great delicacies. This famous ham is produced from 100% Iberico pigs, all of which enjoy a free-range, happy life during the "Montanera" season (acorn season). During the last 3-4 months of their lives, they will eat as many as they want until they almost double their weight. During this period, each pig can eat between 6 and 10 kilos of acorns and between 3 and 4 kilos of natural pastures. The tiny, magnificent "bellota" (acorns) add a pungent buttery flavor, delicate texture, intense color and aroma that separates Iberico de Bellota from all pretenders. When you wake up in the morning and feel like you deserve something really special (you do), this is it.

name: Fermin Jamon Iberico, Grain Fed
tagline: Authentic, acorn finished Jamon Iberico
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Still family owned and operated in the medieval mountain town of La Alberca, they were also the first to bring authentic Spanish Iberico and Serrano ham to the US. Along with caviar, foie-gras and truffles, Iberico ham is truly one of the world's great delicacies. The Pata Negra, or black hoof, is made only from black Iberian hogs. Cured for up to 4 years, and prized for its exceptionally smooth texture and rich taste, the flavor of true Jamon Iberico is simply amazing. To fully appreciate it's quality, we recommend enjoying it on its own with little more than a good piece of bread and a glass of wine. tagline: The workhorse prosciutto you've been looking for...
description: This is your workhorse Parma. Wrapping and grilling shrimp or pork tenderloin? Using it in a pasta recipe? This is your go-to. If there was an index for quality & price, Galloni scores in the upper right corner. Fine enough for your charcuterie platter, economical enough to use in the kitchen!

name: Fermin Jamon Serrano
tagline: Authentic sliced Serrano ham
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Still family owned and operated in the medieval mountain town of La Alberca, they were also the first to bring authentic Spanish Iberico and Serrano ham to the US. The quality of their Jamon Serrano is unsurpassed. The hams are cured for almost two years in drying rooms with open screened windows, exposing them to the mountain air and the change of seasons. The result is a delicious, well marbled, full flavored Serrano with balanced salinity. It is delicate, sweet and nutty. Perfect enjoyed with young manchego, quince paste, marcona almonds and a glass of Rioja. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Incontro New York Strip Bresaola
tagline: Yes...this is slow cured NY Strip!
description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. Their Piedmontese NY Strip Bresaola is a bit of a departure, but not really. Yes, it's USDA certified beef, but it's made with the same attention to detail and tradition that define all Incontro Cured products. The flavor & texture of this highest quality cured beef is just incredible. Tender & delicate, it is instant beef carpaccio. Lay it out on plate and lace it with your best olive oil and an optional squeeze of lemon.

name: Bayonne Ham
tagline: Authentic cured ham from the Pays-Basque region in France
description: One of the legendary hams of Europe, Jambon de Bayonne has been made in southwest France and sold at the port of Bayonne for generations. Made in adherence to strict PGI rules, true Bayonne ham can only be made with pigs born and bred in and around the Aquitaine, Midi-Pyrenees, and Poitou-Charentes regions. Aged for at least 12 months, this ham is tender and sweet, with a nuanced nutty flavor and a melt-in-your-mouth texture. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Brooklyn Cured Bresaola
tagline: Cured beef tenderloin seasoned with porcini mushrooms & black pepper
description: This dry-cured beef round is elegant and lean, but unlike traditional bresaola, it is dusted with porcini mushrooms and black pepper, giving it an earthen, deep flavor. Sliced thin, it is perfect topped with fresh arugula, shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano, and finished with extra virgin olive oil. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Levoni Speck
tagline: Artisan smoked Italian prosciutto, speck, sliced
description: Speck is a delicately smoked, air-cured ham from South Tyrol, Italy's northernmost province. It is made from the pig's rear thigh, boned and seasoned with salt, pepper, juniper and a touch of sugar. Fantastic when enjoyed with hearty bread, a northern Italian cow's milk cheese, some fruit and a white wine from the Alto Adige. Use Speck the same way you would Prosciutto di Parma when you feel like a touch of smoke - pizza, pasta, antipasti or panini. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Leporati Prosciutto di Parma - Whole Leg
tagline: Size of legs vary, price is an estimate
description:
The Leporati family has been making prosciutto for more than 3 generations. The quality of their products is evident - only the most carefully raised and selected hogs are used to make their reserve prosciutto. Cured with just enough salt, this prosciutto is left to age in drying rooms on traditional wooden frames for at least 24 months. Bold, buttery, aromatic and a bit more concentrated than its 16 month counterpart. Trimmed and sliced paper thin with care when you order it. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

As you know, we slice this to perfection, but this is the WHOLE leg! Go big or go home! Size, availability & cost may vary. Expect us to reach out to you to talk about the details!

name: Pio Tosini Prosciutto di Parma - Whole Leg
tagline: Size of legs vary, price is an estimate
description:
The roots of the Pio Tosini company run deep and date back to the beginning of the last century (1905) in the heart of northern Italy, where Ferrante Tosini (Pio Tosini’s father) started his business slaughtering pigs and curing his own cuts of pork meat in the back room of the family’s grocery store. Today, Pio Tosini is still a family company, where Pio’s son-in-law and nephew carry on their family’s century old tradition and passion. Because they use less salt in the curing process, their hams must be of the highest quality and age for a longer time (up to 20 months) to achieve their signature sweetness. The result of this passion and experience is a Prosciutto di Parma that is unsurpassed in flavor, texture and quality. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

As you know, we slice this to perfection, but this is the WHOLE leg! Go big or go home! Size, availability & cost may vary. Expect us to reach out to you to talk about the details!

name: Tempesta Duck Prosciutto
tagline: Artisan cured duck breast
description: Tempesta Artisan Salumi is the culmination of more than 100 years of family expertise and is rooted in the rich Calabrian legacy of making unapologetically authentic and inspired products. By embracing local relationships, exceptional quality, and an uncompromising focus on artisanal craft, the Fiasche family commitment endures in producing a full range of traditional Italian salumi of the highest standard. Their Duck Prosciutto is made by curing Moulard duck breast with Fabbri amarena cherries, warming spices, and coriander. An excellent non-pork charcuterie option, the flavor is rich and buttery, with the classic, savory flavor of duck fat. Try it paired with Fabbri cherries, on a salad, or as a snack on its own. Each slice is small, but rich and flavorful, so a little bit goes a long way. If you’re looking for something new and fun on your next charcuterie board, this is a fantastic choice!

name: The Grand Salame
tagline: A hand picked assortment of salame from our meat case!
description:
You have to have a salame lover on your list. Perhaps it's you? Dad? Grandpa? Either way, just tell us how much you would like to spend, and we will pick out a great selection for that special someone on your list. name: Carnal Beef Sticks, 1oz stick
description: Carnal & Estelle by Carnal are two award winning restaurants in Bellingham, WA, founded by three chef partners who each spent years honing their craft in NY city's Michelin-starred kitchens. These beef sticks are the culmination of those experiences uniting exceptional ingredients like premium beef, fermented black garlic & black truffle with refined techniques. The result? Really good beef sticks people...like, really good.

name: Prelibato White Balsamic Vinegar, 200ml
description: For its Prelibato, (white balsamic condiment), Acetaia Malpighi uses the best part of the grape - the “Trebbiano Modenese." These grapes are crushed softly and slowly, resulting in a juice that is transparent. The juice is then filtered and placed in a centrifuge to make it dense without being cooked. Lastly, it is aged in ash wood for up to 5 years to obtain its delicate aroma and retain its clear color. What does this mean to you? It means that your get to enjoy an amazing, transparent balsamic vinegar on your pork, salads, fresh mozzarella, cured meats and fresh berries.

name: Incontro 'Nduja
tagline: This spread highlights the creamy, rich flavor of the Mangalitsa hogs
description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. They work with the one true premium breed of pig: The Noble Mangalitsa. Sourcing exclusively from a single farm, they craft small batches to guarantee unmatched quality. Pronounced - (in-DOOJ-ah), this is the undisputed salumi champion from Calabria, Italy. Made with 100% Mangalitsa derived from the belly and shoulder meat, it is a spreadable, spicy/smoky salame. Naturally smoked and robust in color, it has the perfect balance of spice & sweetness. 'Nduja is the perfect salame to highlight the wonderful complexities of 100% grown Peperoncino di Calabria. Spread it on crostini, dot on your pizza or incorporate it into anything you would like to taste better!

name: Lowry Hill Provisions Garlic Salami, 6oz
description: Located in Minneapolis, Lowry Hill Provisions is an old-world style salumeria specializing in cured and cooked meats made from regionally sourced, antibiotic- and hormone-free heritage pork. name: DeLaurenti Curly Pepperoni, 8oz
description: As seen on every piece of DeLaurenti classic pepperoni pizza! Use the pepp the pros use! Experience the crispy pepperoni edges and the cup-like shape it takes when baked in the comfort of your own lovely home!

name: Dodge City Salame
tagline: Artisan cured fennel and pink pepperorn salame
description: An all-time staff favorite! Indianapolis-based Smoking Goose makes this excellent pork salame seasoned with fennel pollen and pink peppercorn. The fennel adds a subtly herbaceous note, while the pink peppercorn is at once spicy and floral. The coarse-ground pork offers a rich, buttery mouthfeel, which balances the bright notes of the seasoning. Did we mention it tastes really good and will impress your friends and family? Now you know.

tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.
description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. Their uniquely crafted cured meats come from free-roaming Mangalitsa hogs. Inspired by the Norcini (master salumieri) of Umbria & Emilia Romagna, Italy. This ancient style of salame consists of the most traditional flavors and ingredients of all Italian salami - sea salt, black pepper, garlic & red wine. It's simplicity allows the natural pork flavor to shine.

name: Incontro Black Truffle Salame
tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.

There’s no hiding behind fake truffle imitations in this salame!

name: Incontro Calabria
tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.
description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. Their uniquely crafted cured meats come from free-roaming Mangalitsa hogs. Their Calabria Salame is an Incontro family heirloom. Traditional ingredients sourced from Reggio di Calabria, Italy, give it the unmistakable flavor and aroma of true, Soppressata di Calabria. Spiced with sea salt, Calabrian-grown pepperoncini & wild fennel seed.

name: Incontro Siciliano
tagline: All Natural, 100% Mangalitsa Hogs. Slow fermented and air dried 50-70 days.
description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. They work with the one true premium breed of pig: The Noble Mangalitsa. Sourcing exclusively from a single farm, they craft small batches to guarantee unmatched quality. In honor of Tony’s humble Sicilian lineage, Siciliano is made from the beloved and well-known local ingredients, growing wildly on the island of Sicily - natural Sea Salt, Sicilian-grown pepperoncini, orange Zest, oregano and red wine.

name: Smoking Goose Felino
description: All Smoking Goose recipes begin on the farm. They partner with small, family farms in Indiana and neighboring states raising animals as nature intended: no Gestation Pens, Antibiotic Free, 100% Vegetarian Feed, No Growth Promotants. Felino is part of their old school salumi series. Made in the tradition of central Italy, it is seasoned with red wine, garlic and black peppercorns and then aged in the most prized portion of natural casing. The result is a salumi that is rich, delicate & buttery.

name: Smoking Goose Soppressata
description: All Smoking Goose recipes begin on the farm. They partner with small, family farms in Indiana and neighboring states raising animals as nature intended: no Gestation Pens, Antibiotic Free, 100% Vegetarian Feed, No Growth Promotants. Authentic soppressata carries a rich history and deep-rooted tradition, with unique recipes and spellings varying between different Italian regions. Smoking Goose’s Soppressata honors these regional variations, while also introducing a unique, delectable twist with a mix of aromatic clove, warming nutmeg, fiery ginger, and robust black pepper. A classic sandwich addition, this Soppressata also works perfectly as a topping on a white pizza or paired with your favorite sheep’s milk cheese!

name: Bavarian Meats Landjaeger
tagline: You either like Landjaeger, or you're wrong...
description:
Bavarian Meats is a third-generation family business. Their story begins in 1933, when Grandpa Max at the age of 19, loaded up his suitcase with recipes, left his home in Germany and followed his dreams to America. He settled in Seattle and worked as a sausage-maker for many years, honing his craft. But Max believed that he could make a higher-quality German sausage. Bavarian Meats was founded in 1961, just in time for Max to make a name for himself at the 1962 Seattle World’s Fair.

Landjaeger translation: “Land Hunter.” Bavarian Meats famous salami snack stick! Pork and beef fermented, smoked, and dry cured. Perfect for hiking, biking, cutting into bite-size pieces for appetizers, easy protein for kids’ lunches, or throwing in the car on road trips. Shelf stable so you can take it anywhere a granola bar would go!

name: Fermin Coppa Serrano
tagline: Authentic, all natural Spanish coppa
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Their Coppa Serrana is made from the collar of authentic Spanish pigs, with an all natural diet. It is marinaded with Extra Virgin Olive Oil, pimenton, garlic and sea salt for 5 days and then air-cure for approximately 4 months.The texture is beautifully marbled and the flavor is well...really, really good. Perfect with a young manchego, some quince paste & a handful of marcona almonds!

name: Levoni Coppa Stagionata
tagline: dry-cured pork collar aged 12 months
description: This whole muscle, dry cured pork collar is aged a minimum of 12 months. It is rich & mildly seasoned with a balance of spice & black pepper. We'll slice it thin to give you a melt-in-your-mouth texture that will be perfect on your next antipasti platter, panini or pizza.

name: Levoni Schiacciata Piccante
tagline: Calabrian-style salami with diced pancetta!
description: The Levoni Company has only been making great charcuterie since 1911. Over 100 years and still going strong. Imported from Italy, their Schiacciata Piccante is a Calabria-style salami with a unique oval shape and a knife-cut texture. The flavor is bold and very spicy, with pieces of diced Italian pancetta (yes, that's diced pancetta) within the meat itself. The whole package is rounded out with fennel seeds, chili and paprika.

name: Olympia Provisions Salame Etna
description: Launched in 2009, Olympia Provisions was Oregon's first USDA-approved salumeria. A young company tied to old-world tradition, their products are handmade with passion and precision. Salami Etna is studded with pistachios and seasoned with lemon.A deli classic, it is perfect for slicing. Despite the fact that the only ingredients added to the pork and fat are sea salt, lemon zest, and pepper, it took the folks at Olympia Provisions 3 years to perfect the recipe!

name: Olympia Provisions Saucisson Sec, 4oz
tagline: Artisan cured French-style salame
description: Launched in 2009, Olympia Provisions was Oregon's first USDA-approved salumeria. A young company tied to old-world tradition, their products are handmade with passion and precision. Their best seller, Saucisson Sec is a traditional French-style salame, seasoned with garlic and black pepper. Perfect to pack along for your next picnic with some mustard, French cheese of any kind, a crusty baguette and a bottle of wine.

name: Fermin Chorizo Bellota
description: Everything that Fermin makes is incredible. This Chorizo Iberico de Bellota is no exception. Made from the famed acorn-fed Pata Negra (black hoof) pig, it is seasoned with garlic & smoked paprika. Incredibly rich and flavorful, it can be enjoyed on its own, with aged Spanish cheeses, or chopped and sauteed with your eggs.

name: Foustman All Natural Beef Salami, 8oz
tagline: All natural, nitrate free, uncured salami from SF
description:
Foustman’s Salami is a family-owned business specializing in creating unique styles and flavors of artisanal uncured dry salami. This all-beef dry-cured salami is made with quality lean beef and red wine. Smokey, peppery and delicious. A great alternative to pork salami.Great for snacking, in all the usual ways - with cheese, olives, crackers, bread, wine and beer. Also, great for spicing up eggs, pasta, salads and sauces

*This salami is shelf stable and does not need to be refrigerated until after opening. Perfect for camping, hiking, picnics or traveling!

Foustman’s Salami is a family-owned business specializing in creating unique styles and flavors of artisanal uncured dry salami. Named 5-alarm for a reason, this salami combines high quality pork with habanero peppers. Spicy? Yes. Is hot all you taste? No. Great for snacking, in all the usual ways - with cheese, olives, crackers, bread, wine and beer. Also, great for spicing up eggs, pasta, salads and sauces

*This salami is shelf stable and does not need to be refrigerated until after opening. Perfect for camping, hiking, picnics or traveling!

name: Foustman Turkey Salami, 8oz
tagline: All natural, nitrate free, uncured salami from SF

Foustman’s Salami is a family-owned business specializing in creating unique styles and flavors of artisanal uncured dry salami. Wait...turkey salami? Yes! This unique salami is a combination of dark meat turkey and an old-world family spice formula. Leaner tasting then traditional salami, turkey makes a great alternative to pork or beef.

name: Fermin Iberico Salchichon, 7oz
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. This unique cured sausage is made from a cross breed of Ibérico & Duroc pigs. Buttery & delicate, it is seasoned with warm nutmeg & black & white pepper. Great with aged Manchego & some Mitica Toketti chips!

name: Rosette de Campagne
description: Le Bec Fin has been making charcuterie in the European tradition since 1999. This course ground French country-style salami is seasoned with garlic and black pepper. It's buttery, garlicy flavor is perfect along side a spread of cornichons, grainy mustard, French cheese (pick it) & a crusty baguette!

name: A L'Olivier Passion Fruit Vinegar, 200ml
description: In 1822, Monsieur Popelin, a pharmacist, set up a shop devoted to olive oil in Paris and A L'Olivier was born. Today, the family owned company still makes amazing olive oil, along with high quality vinegars and nut oils. This vinegar is simultaneously fresh, sour and smooth. Use it instead of lemon juice to finish grilled fish, or toss with a variety of fresh fruits.

name: Alps Hot Soppresata
tagline: Hand-made spicy salame
description: Hand-made in Astoria, New York, Alps Provisions' Hot Sopressata is great for antipasti, pizza, and sandwiches. Seasoned with paprika and red pepper, it has a mild, warm spice. Peel back the casing and slice thick or thin. Buy it by the whole, the half or sliced - all sold by the pound. Each piece is approximately 3/4 lb. Like sliced, the actual price of the pieces will be determined when we put it on the scale.

name: Alps Sweet Soppresata
tagline: Hand-made salame
description: Hand-made in Astoria, New York, Alps Provisions' Hot Sopressata is great for antipasti, pizza, and sandwiches. Seasoned with paprika and red pepper, it has a mild, warm spice.
