name: Boar's Head Pepperoni Sticks
tagline: Classic old-fashioned pepperoni - 7oz
description: Boar's Head has been making traditional Italian specialties since 1905. DeLaurenti was one of the first stores on the West Coast to carry Boar's Head products, and they've been thriving in our case for decades. Made with pork and beef, these pepperoni sticks are a deli classic. Otherwise known as the "old fashioned," they are dry and chewy with a slight spice. Perfect for pizza, snacking while walking, and antipasti - also makes a great gift!

name: Columbus Genoa Salame
description: Columbus Craft Meats is an artisan deli and cured meat company that takes great pride in using only the best ingredients. Indulge in the timeless elegance of their Genoa Salame, a gourmet delight crafted to perfection. Made from extra-lean pork finely chopped and seasoned with a delicate blend of garlic, cracked black pepper, and wine, this salame offers a sweet, smooth flavor that lingers pleasingly on the palate. Slow-aged to develop aromatic mildness and achieve its signature soft texture, Genoa Salame is a showstopper on any charcuterie board.

name: Coro by Salumi Chipotle and Cocoa, 5oz
tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. Their Chipotle and Cocoa, inspired by Mexican Mole, is perhaps their most popular and most unique salame. Consisting of cocoa powder, cinnamon, chipotle and ancho peppers, it is sweet & savory with a warm finish. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

name: Coro by Salumi Classic, 5oz
tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. This is their original. With subtle notes of ginger & garlic, it is packed with flavor but approachable enough to please the crowd. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

name: Coro by Salumi Finnochiona, 5oz
tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. Salumi's version of finnochiona (fennel salame) is truly unique. Flavored with fennel, a copious amount of cracked black pepper and a touch of curry. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

name: Coro by Salumi Hot Sopressata, 5oz
tagline: Handcrafted uncured salame, made in Seattle since 1999
description: Founded by Armandino & Marilyn Batali in 1999, Salumi has grown from a small neighborhood deli to a well-known piece of Seattle's culinary fabric. We are proud to say that we were one of Salumi's first wholesale customers, and we are as proud to carry their products today as we were when we started. Laced with cayenne pepper that makes it striking red in color, Salumi's Hot Sopressata is an essential ingredient on your pizza, or on a sandwich with spicy Italian Provolone. Uncured, Salumi uses celery juice powder, a natural form of nitrate and nitrite.

name: Fra' Mani Salame Nostrano
tagline: Artisan uncured salame, sliced
description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. Seasoned with wine, garlic, and spices, Salame Nostrano is their house salame. Coarsely ground with a mild and sweet flavor, it is a decadent crowd-pleaser that pairs well with cheese and fruit. Sliced paper thin. Natural nitrates.

name: Fra'Mani Soppressata
tagline: Artisan uncured salame, sliced
description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. Seasoned with wine, garlic, and a blend of spices, Fra' Mani's Soppressata is one of our biggest sellers. It is ultra-rich and buttery, with an amazing warmly-spiced aroma - when it's in your fridge, you will know it. Sliced paper thin, natural nitrates.

name: Fra'Mani Spicy Capicolla
tagline: Artisinal uncured coppa
description: Founded by Chef Paul Bertolli in San Francisco, Fra'Mani has been making an array of handmade, delicious salumi products since 2006. His Spicy Capicolla is made from hand-trimmed, high quality, boneless pork shoulder. Lightly smoked over natural wood, it is seasoned with red pepper, garlic, vinegar, fennel seed and black pepper. Sliced paper thin, it has a smooth texture that is perfect for panini, charcuterie boards, breakfast sandwiches & pizza!

name: Levoni Smoked and Spicy Capocollo
description: The Levoni Company has only been making great charcuterie since 1911. Over 100 years and still going strong. Known for its spicy flavor featuring paprika, Levoni’s Capocollo is smoked delicately, using a natural method, and aged for at least 10 weeks. It has a reddish-brown color, characteristic of the spices used and smoking. When sliced, the meat is red with pearly white streaks and grain. It is sweet, fragrant and spicy to the nose. The flavor is sharp and well balanced between fleshy and fatty parts. Roundness and complexity in perfect balance! Pairs beautifully with sweet flavors like pumpkin, potatoes and onions. Excellent for preparing escalopes, saltinbocca, savory pies and pizzas. Feeling fancy? Try turning a slice into a delicious dumpling, stuffed with burrata or ricotta and tied with chive!

name: Molinari Finocchiona Salame
tagline: Classic dry cured fennel salame
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Finocchiona Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with fennel. Finely minced in texture, sweet and flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame
tagline: Classic dry cured salame with black pepper
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame - 12oz Piece
tagline: Classic dry cured salame, 12 oz whole
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! In its whole form, great to cut by hand a little bit, or a lot at a time!

name: Molinari Italian Dry Salame, 3.25lb stick
tagline: Classic dry cured salame, whole
description:
Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Italian Dry Salame is their straightforward classic. Dry-cured with a hint of black pepper, it's a salame that everyone can love. Finely minced in texture, mild but flavorful, it's been a DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! This is the whole 3+ pound stick!

*Final weight & price will be determined when we process your order.

name: Molinari Toscano Salame
tagline: Classic dry cured salame, sliced
description: Molinari & Sons has been making salame in San Francisco since 1896. Toscano Salame is a classic dry-cured salame with whole black peppercorns. Coarsely ground in texture, tangy and flavorful. A DeLaurenti deli favorite for years! Sliced thin and ready to enjoy!

name: Palacios Hot Spanish Chorizo, 8oz
tagline: Artisan Spanish cured spicy chorizo
description: Imported from Spain, Palacios Hot Chorizo is made using a 30 year-old traditional family recipe. It is also the first authentic dry Spanish chorizo to enter the US. Seasoned with hot pimenton, this chorizo is smoky and earthy with a warm delayed spice.  Enjoy it with firm Spanish cheeses and marcona almonds, sauteed with eggs, or in your paella. Natural nitrates.

name: Palacios Mild Spanish Chorizo, 6.5oz
tagline: Artisan Spanish cured chorizo
description: Imported from Spain, Palacios Mild Chorizo is made using a 30 year-old traditional family recipe. It is also the first authentic dry Spanish chorizo to enter the US. Seasoned with sweet pimenton, this chorizo is smoky, earthy, and rich.  Enjoy it with firm Spanish cheeses and marcona almonds, sauteed with eggs, or in your paella. Natural nitrates.

name: Parmigiano & Porcini Salame
description: In the late 1800s, Peter Seghesio’s grandparents emigrated from Italy and settled in Sonoma County. As lifelong farmers, they immediately recognized the promise of the land, and began two traditions that the family still honor today: winemaking and crafting artisanal salumi, sausage, and cured meats. After becoming a nationally acclaimed winemaker, Pete decided to embrace the other part of that family tradition. In pursuit of the industry’s greatest knowledge, Pete began traveling to Italy to study under world-famous butchers Dario Cecchini of Panzano and the Marini family of Florence. From these masters, Pete learned the art of Italian-style whole animal butchery. By combining traditions passed down through his family, techniques learned from the Italian greats, and seasonal ingredients harvested from local farms, Pete and the Journeyman Meat Company team strive to create the best products in one of the world’s most bountiful culinary regions: Sonoma County. Combining the savory flavor of porcini with the umami of Parmigiano Reggiano, Journeyman Meat Co.'s Parmigiano & Porcini Salame is rich and expressive. The salty cheese and earthy mushroom make it a perfect companion for red wines!

name: Saucisson a'Lail
description: Not so loosely translated, Saucisson a'Lail simply means Garlic Sausage. This tender, cooked salame is mild, garlicky and delicious. Perfect for a picnic paired with a crusty baguette, some grainy mustard, brie & cornichons.

name: Taylor Pork Roll, 1lb
tagline: The New Jersey Classic
description: Taylor Ham, AKA Taylor Pork Roll, was developed in 1856 by John Taylor of Trenton, New Jersey. Springsteen and Taylor Ham - easily the two best things to come out of New Jersey. Don't knock it until you try it! Here's what you do: slice it up, and make a few cuts around the outside edge to keep it flat during cooking. Pan fry until light brown and enjoy! Combine it with a fried egg and cheese on a soft kaiser roll for the ultimate Jersey breakfast sandwich!

name: Castelvetrano Olives
tagline: Hand-portioned by our deli!
description: These vibrant green beauties are the best-selling olive in our antipasti case, and with good reason. Plump, juicy, and bursting with bright, buttery flavor, they make a perfect accompaniment to antipasti, tapas, or your next charcuterie board. Packed in brine and with their pits intact, they will satisfy any salty cravings while still feeling fresh, bright, and light.

name: DeLaurenti House Mix Olives
tagline: Made in our kitchen - marinated in herbs, garlic & citrus
description: Our House Olive Mix! Made in our kitchen, this is a delicious blend of country olives, marinated in a blend of herbs, garlic and citrus. Great for snacking and antipasti! Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: Lucques
tagline: The best olive you've never had!
description: The best olive you've never had. If you are one of the ones who has, then you know. Firm & buttery with just the right amount of acidity, this is the perfect snacking olive. Enjoy them out of the brine or drain the brine and lace them with your favorite olive oil, lemon zest & a sprig of herbs.

name: Greek Mix Olives
tagline: Hand-portioned by our deli!
description: A handpicked blend of Kalamata, Mount Athos, and Mount Pelion olives. They are packed in brine with their pits intact, and seasoned with oregano and bay leaves. A very popular olive mix, this blend offers a fun variety of olives, and the seasoning is pleasant without being overbearing. These go great with feta, aged cheddar, hummus, or peppery salame.

name: Pitted Sicilian Olives
description: Kids can fit their little fingers in these babies and run around the house without the risk of poking themselves in the eye, you can use them in pasta, pizza, to make tapenade or drop in your Martini. Meaty, firm & mild, they are the skeleton key of olives.

name: Moroccan Oil Cured Olives
tagline: Hand-portioned by our deli!
description: These unique olives are packed with flavor! Ripe black olives from Morocco’s Atlas Mountains are first dry-cured in salt, which concentrates their flavor and reduces any bitter notes. Then, the salt is removed, and the olives are soaked in oil. The result is a deeply flavorful, briny olive. They are drier in texture than most olives, but they retain a decidedly buttery characteristic.

name: Picholines with Preserved Lemon
tagline: Hand portioned in our deli!
description: Not all picholines are created equal. Villa Jerada sources great foods from Morocco & these olives are no exception. they are firm but creamy, with a wonderful citrus kick from the preserved lemon.

name: DeLaurenti Artichoke Spread
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Enjoying a no frills artichoke spread and appreciating the finer things are not mutually exclusive. Correct, this is not the fanciest thing you will find at our store, but it is still one of the best. If you bring it to a friend's house for an appetizer, be prepared to have them ask you to bring it again and again. It is best enjoyed with grilled bread that has some crunch, or with Macrina's Apricot Nut Crostini. Want to know what's in it? Buy our cookbook! Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: DeLaurenti Bomba Spread
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: As seen on our classic Misto sandwich! This house spread is a blend of roasted onions, Mama Lil's Pickled Peppers & some DeLaurenti kitchen care. The sweetness of the onions mellows the bite of the peppers, making it good to put on almost anything! Great with all things cured meats...sandwiches, pizza, crostini & even in pasta!

name: DeLaurenti House Pate
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Our ultra smooth House Pate is back with a new recipe! A house favorite for years! Serve with cornichons and a crusty Macrina baguette. Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: DeLaurenti Hummus
description: Our housemade Hummus - better than any mass produced grocery store brand, and a lot easier than making it yourself! We use Rancho Gordo garbanzo beans, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil. Serve with raw or grilled vegetables, crostini, or with grilled chicken, tzatziki sauce, pita, cucumbers and tomatoes. Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: DeLaurenti Salmon Spread
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Our housemade salmon spread! Made with smoked coho salmon collars, crème fraiche, cream cheese, and chives. Great on a breakfast bagel or served with crackers for an appetizer. Portioned by hand when you order it!

name: DeLaurenti Toum
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti kitchen!
description: Our housemade Lebanese style whipped garlic spread. Toum is the perfect marriage between garlic and lemon juice. Traditionally served with grilled meats and kebabs, this spread also works well on any sandwich, roasted vegetables, and even fast & easy garlic bread!

name: Incontro 'Nduja
tagline: This spread highlights the creamy, rich flavor of the Mangalitsa hogs
description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. They work with the one true premium breed of pig: The Noble Mangalitsa. Sourcing exclusively from a single farm, they craft small batches to guarantee unmatched quality. Pronounced - (in-DOOJ-ah), this is the undisputed salumi champion from Calabria, Italy. Made with 100% Mangalitsa derived from the belly and shoulder meat, it is a spreadable, spicy/smoky salame. Naturally smoked and robust in color, it has the perfect balance of spice & sweetness. 'Nduja is the perfect salame to highlight the wonderful complexities of 100% grown Peperoncino di Calabria. Spread it on crostini, dot on your pizza or incorporate it into anything you would like to taste better!

name: Mamnoon Baba Ghanoush
tagline: Amazing spread from the Seattle institution!
description: Mamnoon on Capital Hill is one of the best spots in the city. The flavors and the atmosphere are totally unique in Seattle. So too is their Baba Ganoush. Made with smoked eggplant, tahini & garlic, it's intense smoky flavor makes for a great sauce for grilled meats of all kinds.

name: DeLaurenti Housemade Meatballs
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description:
Ok, these are the real deal - created and produced in the comfort of our kitchen upstairs at the store. Approximately 6 meatballs per pound, FULLY COOKED and ready to go! Your only job is choosing the number of meatballs & deciding whether you want them lightly covered in sauce or plain. Want more than twelve? Just choose the number, a quantity & multiply it! Ie: 12 meatballs, qty of 2 = 24 meatballs! Want them swimming in sauce instead of just covered? Order more DeLaurenti Marinara to go with it!

As an ode to Nate's Nonna, we love to serve 3 meatballs in a bowl with red sauce, Reggiano & a piece of grilled bread. This was the only thing that would keep him and his cousins from tearing the house apart. They lined up and were dispensed a sampler meatball in sauce and a piece of bread for dipping. Receiving it was committing to good behavior. They are great served as such, piled into a soft roll, or, of course combined with some marinara & tossed with spaghetti! If you would like, we include enough sauce to cover. You might want to order another container of marinara!

name: DeLaurenti Smoked Trout Spread
description: Take your fish spread game to the next level with this smoked trout spread! Start with delicately smoked Girard & Dominque trout, add a combination of Farmer's Cheese, sour cream, garlic, herbs & lemon. Just add crostini or crunchy crackers!

name: Grilled Artichokes with Stems
tagline: Edible stems free of charge!
description: Grown, picked, grilled and marinated in Italy and sent right to your doorstep. Enjoy them as an 'artichoke pop' or let them provide some dramatic presentation on your next antipasti spread! We know what you're thinking...those things look good, but they have to be fibery and tough like every other artichoke with a stem that I've ever eaten. Think again...they are super tender and they taste just like they look...really good!

name: Mamnoon Muhammara
tagline: Amazing spread from the Seattle institution!
description: Mamnoon on Capital Hill is one of the best spots in the city. The flavors and the atmosphere are totally unique in Seattle. Speaking of unique...Muhammara. If you aren't familiar, this is a spread made from walnuts, pepper paste, cumin, pomegranate molasses & bread crumbs. With all it has going on, it is best enjoyed simply with warm pita!

name: DeLaurenti Cherry Peppers with Cheese
description: The other peppers in the antipasti case! Red hot(ish) Calabrian chili peppers are stuffed with cheese, so you don't have to! Add vibrant color to your antipasti spread or your picnic. No need to think about how to use them, just eat them!

name: DeLaurenti Dolmas
tagline: The DeLaurenti Antipasti Case Classic
description: The DeLaurenti antipasti case classic! Perhaps the best deal in the Market for a quick snack or as an addition to your antipasti spread. What are they? Good question: Tender grape leaves stuffed with rice, sauteed onions & herbs. Bite size and made for walking & eating!

name: DeLaurenti Gigandes
tagline: Creamy, marinated white beans
description: These beans have been a deli favorite for years. Meaty, but creamy in texture, they are marinated in oil & vinegar and combined with ribbons of sweet peppers. Great as an addition to your antipasti platter, on a salad or right out of the container!

name: DeLaurenti Marinated Eggplant
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: As seen in our antipasti case! Fresh market eggplant is sliced thick, roasted & marinated in a combination of olive oil, wine vinegar, garlic & herbs. Great enjoyed as-is alongside the rest of your antipasti spread, on a salad, pizza or a sandwich!

name: DeLaurenti Peperonata
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: If you have these in your fridge, you have options. Made in our kitchen upstairs, these are handcut strips of whole sweet red & yellow peppers are marinated in oil/vinegar, garlic, herbs & spices. Not spicy, just delicious. They are great alongside cured meats, on a sausage or tuna sandwich or on pizza. Why do it yourself when we've already done it for you?

name: DeLaurenti Pepper Delights
description: These pepper shooters have been a DeLaurenti favorite for many years, attracting people from far and wide to come to our store to get their fix. They are crunchy, not too spicy green cherry peppers stuffed with prosciutto and provolone. Quarter or half them and add them to your antipasto tray, or eat them whole right from the container! There are approximately 10 to 12 peppers per pound.

name: DeLaurenti Pickled Red Onions
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Made upstairs in our kitchen, these sweet & sour onions are the perfect accompaniment to everything from pate to tuna carpaccio or tuna salad!

name: DeLaurenti Roasted Garlic
tagline: Made in the DeLaurenti Kitchen!
description: Roasting garlic is easy, but let's face it, it's a LOT better when someone does it for you! Well, we have so you can stop thinking to yourself that you already should have. Your just a few clicks away from having freshely roasted garlic on your next pizza, smeared on crostini & folded into your mayo for roasted garlic aoli!

name: DeLaurenti Roasted Tomatoes
description: Pound for pound one of the most flavorful items in our case! Bright red roasted & marinated tomatoes add a splash of color and flavor to your antipasti spread, or complete your pizza or panini vision. So many uses! One of the most versitile ingredients in the shop!

name: Seattle Caviar Paddlefish, 1oz
description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Paddlefish, species polydon spathula, is found in the Yellowstone River and throughout the Mississippi River system. This prehistoric species produces a natural caviar and is very similar in appearance to Caspian Sevruga. It has a mild flavor and a medium bead size.

name: Seattle Caviar Ikura, 2oz
description: Seattle natives, Dale and Betsy Sherrow developed a love and appreciation for caviar through European travel and opened the Seattle Caviar Company in 1990. We are lucky that they do all the hard work of finding the best caviar & hand delivering it to the shop...all we have to do is call & enjoy eating it! Chum Salmon are specifically prized for its roe and Salmon Caviar is often referred to as "Ikura" the Japanese term for caviar.

name: Bahia de la Concha White Boquerones
tagline: Marinated boquerones from Basque Country
description: Bahia de la Concha is renowned worldwide for the quality of their semi-preserved white anchovies. Also known as "Boquerones" Bahia de la Concha's extra large, plump, hand filtered white anchovies are preserved in white wine vinegar, sunflower oil, garlic and parsley. These umami-rich fish are freshly caught from the Cantabrian Sea in Northern Spain, then filleted and packed by hand. Unctuous, sweet, and bright, add them to your next charcuterie board or have as a mid-day snack over some crusty bread with nduja.

name: Bottarga, 100g to 130g
tagline: Sardinian Dried Mullet Roe
description: Bottarga is a delicious product derived from mullet roe. It is extracted, salted and air-dried naturally, using traditional Sardinian methods. Referred to as Italian Caviar, this fish roe is extracted with its membrane still intact, is lightly pressed, and cured and dried in the sun. Strictly from Sardinia region this Bottarga is semi-dried for a better consistency and is best enjoyed grated over pasta dishes, eggs or grilled bread.

name: Rougie Duck Foie Gras, 80g
description: Dedicated to sustainable family farming, Rougie produces some of the highest quality foie gras in the world by fostering a stress-free environment and closely supervising each step of the growing process. Fully cooked and ready to eat, this foie gras is buttery, smooth, and ultra-rich. To fully enjoy its full flavor, keep things simple. Warm up a knife in hot water and cut half-inch-thick slices. Place the slices on toasted baguette and add fleur de sel and black pepper to taste. Pour a glass of Sauternes and enjoy!

name: Rougie Mousse Royale
description: Rougie selects only the best foie gras of 100% corn-fed duck liver. This 100% whole duck foie gras parfait makes for a completely ready-to-eat delicacy. Rougie prepares this delicate, melting foie gras mousse through the processing of high-quality lobes of Duck Foie Gras with milk cream, egg foam, a drop of Port Wine, and spices. The stunningly delicate texture and unique flavor allows it to be used as an ideal ingredient for salads, sandwiches, and as a stand-alone dish.

name: Staff Pick - Meats, Cheeses & Antipasti
tagline: You choose how many people, we do the rest!
description:
We have fantastic, passionate staff members working in our deli. This is your opportunity to trust them to choose what they are excited about. Just tell us how many people, and we will do the rest. What arrives will be a thoughtfully chosen selection of meats, cheeses & antipasti for the number of people you specify. The items themselves may or may not be offered elsewhere on the site, this is your chance to get whatever our staff feels is the best right now! If you have a strong aversion to certain types of cheese or charcuterie, this might not be your best choice. If you love everything in our deli and trust us enough to choose, we're ready to put it together!

Their wide range of classic and uniquely flavored salts & seasonings will rush to your aid when flavoring everything from your perfectly grilled steak to your popcorn on movie night. This gift brings the flavor in a big way to whoever is lucky enough to receive it! We chose our Top 6 customer favorites - hard to exclude any of them! You get...Classic Sea Salt, Popcorn Seasoning, Lemon Pepper, Daily Grind (melange of salt/pepper/spice in a grinder), Burger & Steak Blend & French Fry Seasoning!

name: The Pasta Course
tagline: Serves 4 with leftovers once, or 2 twice!
description:
This is a no brainer gift for anyone...including you. Can't take them to dinner? Don't want to take them to dinner? Give them an easy dinner instead!

The description of this item is pretty self-explanatory - DeLaurenti Fresh Egg Linguine (or Tirrena linguine if shipping ground), DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa, a hunk of Parmiggiano-Reggiano & a bottle of Italian red wine. Serves 2 twice, or up to 4 with some left overs. Add another bottle of wine if just one won't do!

name: Delaurenti Sugo al Porcini & Garganelli
description: Our house brand tomato and porcini sauce is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. And yes, there are real porcini mushrooms in this sauce. Perfect paired with Rustichella's Garganelli - a penne rigate-like cut that is a touch more delicate. Finish your pasta with some Parmigiano-Reggiano and you are set!

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Alla Puttanesca & Calamarata
description: Our house brand Puttanesca sauce is made with Italian cherry tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add green olives, capers and pine nuts and you have a sweet, savory and mildly spicy version of a regional favorite. Perfect with Rustichella's Calamarata - a striking cut reminiscent of calamari rings! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo alla Vodka & Penne Rigate
description: Our house brand Sugo alla Vodka is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. The sauce is finished with a dash of vodka, fresh cream, garlic and basil. Classically paired with Rustichella's Penne Rigate! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa & Spaghetti
description: This is your spaghetti dinner for 4 without the fuss. Our sugo della casa (house sauce) is imported from Italy and made with ingredients you can pronounce. It is great as is with Rustichella Spaghetti, but also highly customizable. Add sausage, pancetta, meat balls, red pepper flakes or fresh herbs to take it up a notch or two! As always, finishing with freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano or Pecorino is a must! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Due Formaggi & Rigatocini
description: Our house brand Sugo Due Formaggi is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add sharp aged pecorino, creamy ricotta and fresh herbs and you have perfect sauce for Rustichella's Rigatocini! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Piccante & Bucatini
description: This combination is a classic - warmly spiced, fresh tomato sauce with toothsome bucatini. It is great as is, but easy to customize a quick version of Bucatini All'Amatriciana. To do so, saute some pancetta in the pan while your pasta is cooking. Add the sauce and simmer. Combine the cooked bucatini with the sauce and a half a cup of pasta water, and finish with some Pecorino Romano! Serves 4.

name: Pesto & Trofie
description: Most things are better when you make them yourself, but the best basil is not available 12 months a year. Made in the Ligurian city of Genoa, the birthplace of pesto, the ingredients in this sauce will seem hauntingly familiar: Ligurian basil, extra virgin olive oil, pine nuts & pecorino. Although it is perfect with any cut of pasta, try it the traditional way with Rustichella Trofie, thin blanched green beans & halved baby red potatoes.

name: Spedalotto Tonda Iblea Olio Novello 1025, 500ml
tagline: This oil was an olive a mere 3 weeks ago!
description: Made with the famous Tonda Iblea olives of the Monti Iblei region in Sicily. This amazing oil has green, ripe flavors that are in perfect balance. It is soft with a fresh, green tomato aroma and fruity flavor, like a perfectly ripe late summer heirloom tomato. A delightful complexity is extracted from this single varietal olive, a result of the craftsmanship that goes into the cultivation of rich soil. Spedalotto Tonda Iblea’s approachable flavor profile is easy to love!

name: DeLaurenti Red Wine
tagline: Washington - 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc
description: Our newest Washington red blend has arrived! This everyday red is made in the great state of Washington with Italian roots. Crafted in the same way as the great Super Tuscan Tignanello, it consists of 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot & 5% Cabernet Franc. The result is a lush, accessible wine with flavors of dark fruit, baking spice & subtle toasted oak. Great on its own, with grilled meats and pasta. Or, with its convenient screw top, its the perfect picnic wine!

name: DeLaurenti Rosato 750ml
tagline: Tuscany, IT - Sangiovese - 2024
description: A new batch of DeLaurenti Rosato has made it to our shelves! This rose is reminiscent of the roses of Provence, despite being entirely Tuscan Sangiovese. Refreshing, dry, and light with a slightly tart berry finish. This wine will transport you to a sunny afternoon on a breezy Mediterranean beach, no matter what time of year you pop the cork!

name: Delaurenti Pinot Noir
tagline: Eola-Amity, Oregon - 2022 - Pinot Noir
description: When we decided to bring in another PNW wine under our private label, we knew we wanted it to be Pinot Noir. An elegant, medium-bodied red that would be perfect for any season, and ready for your dinner table any night of the week. Single-vineyard fruit from the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon, aged in new and used French oak for 18 months, and really fun to drink!

This list was compiled by owners Nate & Matt - 10 each. The criteria: you have to love it and you have to choose in 15 minutes. The list checks all the boxes - savory, salty, sweet, crunchy & spicy. Here's what you get:

Ayoh Giardiniera, Villa Manodori Balsamic, Confectionally Yours Toffee, Lunardi Lemon Cantucci, Spinaker 70% Madagascar Sea Salt, Danieli Traditional Tarallini, Bachan’s Gluten Free Japanese BBQ Sauce, Nunez de Prado EVOO, Scalia Anchovies, Maldon Salt, Bret’s Chips (asst flavors), Uncle Jerry’s Extra Dark Pretzels, Mitika OnionToketti, Suhey Peppers, Stuzzi Hot Sauce, Graham’s Horseradish Sauce, Monte’s Tomato Sauce, Drifter’s Fish Smoked Salmon, Oro Liquido Marcona Almond Butter & Tirrena Spaghetti.

name: The DeLaurenti Wine Flight
description: The full flight people...Our new Red Wine, Oregon Pinot Noir, Chianti Classico, Organic Prosecco, Roero Arneis, and our Rosato. A wine for every occasion & a GREAT gift!

name: The Gift of Cheese
tagline: Hand picked cheeses from our deli case - includes crackers!
description:
Cheese is many things, among them, it's a fantastic gift! By selecting this option, you are putting yourself in the hands of our deli crew. If you have a special someone who loves everything cheese, then this is your option. Our expert staff will put together a selection that is not only delicious, but also interesting and complimentary. Let go of the wheel and allow us to make you look like the cheese hero that you are! Comes with the appropriate amount of crackers too!

*Since this is a gift, we will keep the prices off the items.

name: Bordeaux - Left Bank/Right Bank
description:
Let our staff take you on a micro-tour of Bordeaux. In this set, you'll find two luxurious examples of a Left Bank and Right Bank Bordeaux Rouge. Highlighting the unique soil types and varietal focus of the various sub-regions on either side of the Dordogne, this collection makes a perfect gift or someone just discovering the region, or any wine enjoyer that needs an easy set of perfect holiday reds.

*AVAILABLE FOR STORE PICK UP OR IN-STATE SHIPPING ONLY

name: Get Sauced!
tagline: Includes 5+ bottles of unique hot sauce!
description:
Heat is good, heat with flavor is better. This gift is for the person that has been known to carry their favorite hot sauce in their purse or pocket..just in case. Hot sauces aren't a one size fits all situation. You need a sauce for every occasion & a fully stocked hot sauce bar can add the finishing touch to the food you worked so hard to create. Or, it can salvage the food that you didn't work so hard on at all. Either way, the stuff is important.

Includes 4 to 6 bottles of hot sauce.

name: Pantry Provisions
tagline: A hand-picked selection of our favorite products on the shelves!
description:
Giving the gift of a pantry full of things that make life better is a good thing. Olive oil, vinegar, salt, mustard, tinned fish, cookies, chocolate, crackers, sauces, pasta...just envision the aisles at DeLaurenti and you get the idea. All you have to do is pick your price point and we become your personal shopper! Let's face it, you are reading this because you would rather have us just do it for you! Trust us to assemble a mix of great items for every budget. We will include savory & sweet - the number of items will depend on your budget. One thing that we know you can depend on is that it will be really good!

*This is a gift, so we will remove the prices!

name: The Four B's
tagline: Brunello, Barolo, Barbaresco & Barbera!
description:
All right, here's the deal... You've got an extra special person in your life who's just getting into wine, or maybe even just discovering Italian wine. This set is a snapshot of some of the most-storied and prestigious wine regions on the Italian penninsula.

In here, you'll find one distinguished example of a Barolo DOCG, Barbaresco DOCG, Brunello di Montalcino DOCG, and a Barbera d'Alba DOC or Barbera d'Asti DOCG.

This set not only makes a great introduction to some of the most reputable Italian red wines but also makes a great gift for someone who's already a fan!

*AVAILABLE FOR STORE PICK UP OR IN-STATE SHIPPING ONLY

name: The Grand Salame
tagline: A hand picked assortment of salame from our meat case!
description:
You have to have a salame lover on your list. Perhaps it's you? Dad? Grandpa? Either way, just tell us how much you would like to spend, and we will pick out a great selection for that special someone on your list. We are going to stick to small format sticks & chunks of delicious salame to ensure they keep well. The number of sticks in the assortment and the variety with vary with the budget you choose. If the meat case is this person's favorite section of the store, this gift is for them!

*Since this is a gift, we will keep the prices off the items.

name: Tis' the Seasoning
tagline: A handpicked selection of salts & spices!
description:
We know, horrible play on words - too easy. It doesn't change the fact that we all need salt & seasoning to survive. Think of this collection as a food survival kit. If the recipient is to take a beautiful piece of beef, pork, or fish, or that perfect grilled vegetable or pasta and transform it into something memorable, he/she is going to need some help. Break out a full arsenal of finishing salts, herbs, ground peppers & aromatics and they will be good to go. You choose the dollar amount, we go to the salt/spice nook and go to town!

*This is a gift, we will remove the prices!

name: DeLaurenti Gift Card
description: Don't know what your friends or family would choose to buy at DeLaurenti? Our gift card has a 100% gift giving success rate! We guarantee that each holder will end up choosing exactly what they want!

name: The Picnicker
tagline: A hand picked assortment of salame from our meat case!
description: Receiving all the wonderful things you eat on a picnic is always good, and it is not dependent on the month you recieve it. Picnicking is a year round sport. You can have a picnic in your living room or bundled up under a winter sky. If anything, the vision of a picnic keeps the dream of the warm and hopefully less turbulent months ahead alive. Here's what you can look forward to - cheese, meats, olives, antipasti, crackers, chocolate & a classic opinel picnic knife! All put together by one of our crew members! Serves 4, 2 twice and 1 lucky person as many times as it takes for them to finish it! Makes a great gift too!

name: Ayako 3 Pack
tagline: Three Jams - Dealer's Choice!
description: In the summer of 2010, Ayako Gordon founded Ayako & Family Jams. Partnering with Japanese Organic farmer Katsumi Taki, they sought to bring the rarest of European and Asiatic plum varieties to the pantries of preserves lovers around the globe. 100% of the fruit for this artisan jam is grown on Taki's organic Japanese farm near Yakima. This is what you choose when you can't make up your mind - we choose 3 of our favorite Ayako varieties, and your only job is to wait for them to arrive! Great as a gift, even if the recipient is you!

name: Burgundy & Bordeaux
tagline: Four Bottles - a red & a white from each of France's most famed wine regions
description:
Voulez-vous boire avec nous? In this set, you'll find two reds and whites from Burgundy and Bordeaux. Whether you're just getting into French wine or have already been converted, this set makes a great gift or is a convenient way to get stocked up on some perfect holiday wines.

*AVAILABLE FOR STORE PICK UP OR IN-STATE SHIPPING ONLY

name: Spice is Nice
tagline: 10 great grocery items - all with spice, all with flavor!
description: This line up is for the person who loves to add a little spice to just about anything. With 10 great spicy products to enjoy, they will have their pick! Sauces, jams, spreads, pantry, read to eat...you name it, it's in there, and the one thing they have in common is a little bit of heat. Here's what you get...Stuzzi Italian Hot Sauce, Tutto Calabria Crushed Chili Paste, Kari Kari Chili Crisp, Ayoh Giadinayo, New York Shuk Preserved Lemon Harissa, Xilli Mole, Graham's Horseradish Sauce, Inna Fresno Chili Jam & Fishwife Spicy Albacore Tuna.

name: The San Juan Sixer
tagline: 6 San Juan Sea Salt varieties to bring the flavor!
description: This is the six pack that isn't gone in an evening and won't keep you from driving home. The folks at San Juan quite literally flavor the lives of the customers & staff at DeLaurenti. Their wide range of classic and uniquely flavored salts & seasonings will rush to your aid when flavoring everything from your perfectly grilled steak to your popcorn on movie night. This gift brings the flavor in a big way to whoever is lucky enough to receive it! We chose our Top 6 customer favorites - hard to exclude any of them! You get...Classic Sea Salt, Popcorn Seasoning, Lemon Pepper, Daily Grind (melange of salt/pepper/spice in a grinder), Burger & Steak Blend & French Fry Seasoning!

name: The Pasta Course
tagline: Serves 4 with leftovers once, or 2 twice!
description:
This is a no brainer gift for anyone...including you. Can't take them to dinner? Don't want to take them to dinner? Give them an easy dinner instead!

The description of this item is pretty self-explanatory - DeLaurenti Fresh Egg Linguine (or Tirrena linguine if shipping ground), DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa, a hunk of Parmiggiano-Reggiano & a bottle of Italian red wine. Serves 2 twice, or up to 4 with some left overs. Add another bottle of wine if just one won't do!

name: CiCi's Cookies - 4 of a Kind
tagline: DeLaurenti Staff Favorite!
description: Cici's Cookies are among the best selling cookies in our store, and for good reason. They are delicious! If you are having a hard time choosing, well...you know have to! This is all 4 standard flavors: Classic Lemon, Butterhorn, Ginger Molasses & Chocolate Espresso!. Great for you, and GREAT as a gift!

name: Delaurenti Sugo al Porcini & Garganelli
description: Our house brand tomato and porcini sauce is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. And yes, there are real porcini mushrooms in this sauce. Perfect paired with Rustichella's Garganelli - a penne rigate-like cut that is a touch more delicate. Finish your pasta with some Parmigiano-Reggiano and you are set!

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Alla Puttanesca & Calamarata
description: Our house brand Puttanesca sauce is made with Italian cherry tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add green olives, capers and pine nuts and you have a sweet, savory and mildly spicy version of a regional favorite. Perfect with Rustichella's Calamarata - a striking cut reminiscent of calamari rings! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo alla Vodka & Penne Rigate
description: Our house brand Sugo alla Vodka is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. The sauce is finished with a dash of vodka, fresh cream, garlic and basil. Classically paired with Rustichella's Penne Rigate! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo della Casa & Spaghetti
description: This is your spaghetti dinner for 4 without the fuss. Our sugo della casa (house sauce) is imported from Italy and made with ingredients you can pronounce. It is great as is with Rustichella Spaghetti, but also highly customizable. Add sausage, pancetta, meat balls, red pepper flakes or fresh herbs to take it up a notch or two! As always, finishing with freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano or Pecorino is a must! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Due Formaggi & Rigatocini
description: Our house brand Sugo Due Formaggi is made with ripe Italian tomatoes grown and harvested on the farm where the sauce is made. Add sharp aged pecorino, creamy ricotta and fresh herbs and you have perfect sauce for Rustichella's Rigatocini! Serves 4

name: DeLaurenti Sugo Piccante & Bucatini
description: This combination is a classic - warmly spiced, fresh tomato sauce with toothsome bucatini. It is great as is, but easy to customize a quick version of Bucatini All'Amatriciana. To do so, saute some pancetta in the pan while your pasta is cooking. Add the sauce and simmer. Combine the cooked bucatini with the sauce and a half a cup of pasta water, and finish with some Pecorino Romano! Serves 4.

name: Pesto & Trofie
description: Most things are better when you make them yourself, but the best basil is not available 12 months a year. Made in the Ligurian city of Genoa, the birthplace of pesto, the ingredients in this sauce will seem hauntingly familiar: Ligurian basil, extra virgin olive oil, pine nuts & pecorino. Although it is perfect with any cut of pasta, try it the traditional way with Rustichella Trofie, thin blanched green beans & halved baby red potatoes.

name: Champagne Chavost Blanc de Noirs
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Meunier - NV
description: Nestled in Chavot village, Champagne Chavost thrives under Fabian Daviaux's daring leadership, breaking with tradition and embracing natural winemaking. This wine showcases the innovative spirit of the cooperative with its 100% Pinot Meunier blend, aged five years on lees. Bright, mineral-forward notes dance with subtle hints of violet and dark berries, yielding a truly delicious, food-friendly Champagne that pays homage to the region's unique terroir.

name: Jean Vesselle "Oeil de Perdrix" Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - 100% Pinot Noir
description: Oeil de Perdix translates as “Eye of the Partridge” and refers to the pale orange/pink color of this wine from the direct pressing of Pinot Noir. This delicious Champagne is aged 3 years before release and its savory qualities would be incredible with duck rillettes.

name: Jean Vesselle Brut Reserve
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - 80% Pinot Noir, 20% Chardonnay
description: This Champagne serves as the Traditional or “Opening Act” of the many styles that Jean Vesselle produces. Designated as a “Brut” style, this dry and deliciously fruity champagne (80% Pinot Noir 20% Chardonnay) will have you finding all the reasons to celebrate!

name: Lelarge-Pugeot Rose Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR
description: A delicate, low-dosage rosé Champagne from the evergreen and delightful folks at Lelarge Pugeot. Subtle red berry and floral notes on the nose, and a tangy, zip of acidity on the finish!

name: Champagne Chavost Blanc d'Assemblage
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: One of our favorite new discoveries. Champagne Chavost is a cooperative winery in the village of Chavot, led by visionary Fabian Daviaux who convinced the co-ops members to embark on a new journey: he would make a range of wines without additives or sulfites. This Champagne marries Chardonnay and Meunier grapes and bursts forth with vibrant freshness. Expect a thrilling tapestry of green apple, quince, and subtle brioche. A testament to the cooperative's bold leap into the future while honoring its past. Cheers to evolution!

name: Champagne Fresne-Ducret 'Le Chemin du Chemin' 1er Cru
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, Chardonnay - NV
description: Uncork elegance with this Premier Cru Champagne, a sumptuous blend enriched by reserve wines and five years of lees aging. This wine captivates with a harmonious dance of apricot, white peach, and brioche notes, underpinned by a chalky minerality. Delightfully food-friendly, it adds a touch of sophistication to any meal, from delicate seafood to hearty fare. Savor the sublime and toast to life's special moments.

name: Champagne Gatinois Aÿ Grand Cru Brut 2014
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Chardonnay - 2014
description: Only produced in exceptional years, the Champagne Gatinois 2014 Brut is a gorgeous expression of what Aÿ Grand Cru fruit can be. The wine is 90% Pinot Noir, providing a sturdy backbone, with the remaining 10% Chardonnay helping to develop more layers of stone fruit and honey. Flavors have matured to a slightly richer profile than the Non-Vintage labels from the house, showing what good time and care can do for the highest quality fruit. A wine to open for your next special occassion, an ideal pairing for scallops, caviar & bellini, and pâté.

name: Champagne Gatinois Aÿ Grand Cru Brut Rosé
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Chardonnay - NV
description: The Grand Cru village of Aÿ in the northern Montagne de Reims is home to some of the most saught-after Pinot Noir in all of Champagne, and the Gatinois family has been tending vines there since the 1600s. This rosé, though technically from the Vallée de la Marne, shows a lot more in line with Montagne de Reims wines due to the soil type and exposition of the vineyard. Primarily Pinot Noir with a splash of Chardonnay, It punches way above its weight class, showing beautiful notes of cherry, tobacco, and a saline-crisp finish. Sure to correct any rosé-skeptics in your life!

name: Champagne Guillaume Sergent "Bossa Nova" Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: A Blanc de Noirs composed of Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier from the Premier Cru village of Vrigny in the Montaigne de Reims is bright, pronounced, elegant, and delicious! Sometimes we need prose or poetry to go about a wine, sometimes its named incredibly accurately and you can let the music do the talking. Loads of floral, red fruit, and a tangy, textural finish. A delicious bottle to enjoy with your dance partner on and off the dance floor.

name: Champagne Les Freres Mignon "L'Aventure" Blanc de Blancs
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay - NV
description: "L'Aventure" was the first cuvée produced by the Mignon brothers, the name inspired by their first foray into production. We should be on to their fourth iteration of this wine by now- a delightful bottling entirely composed of Chardonnay from the villages of Avize, Cramant, and Cuis. The reserve wines go back to 2016, but the bulk of this wine is from this decade. Now that the wine has settled post-discorgement for over a year now, we're seeing some typical Blanc de Blancs notes come through a little more prominently. A comforting, richer Champagne, with plenty of pop and a dry, cider-like finish.

name: Champagne Liebart-Regnier "Excelia" Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - 2016 - 80% Pinot Noir, 20% Chardonnay
description: A family-run Champagne house that has been converting to fully Organic since 2020. This a Vintage Champagne made from 80% Pinot Noir and 20% Chardonnay. It is Brut, indicating that it is dry, making it a fantastic pairing for caviar, oysters, duck confit or really anything rich and salty!

name: Champagne Liebart-Regnier 'Les Sols Brun' Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - Pinot Meunier, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay
description: Elevate your celebrations with the delightful Champagne Liebart-Regnier 'Les Sols Brun' Brut, an affordable luxury that is astronomically better than many of its pricier counterparts (think Veuve Cliquot). Hailing from a family-owned winery with generations of expertise, this wine exudes finesse, marrying bright citrus, crisp apple, and delicate brioche notes. Stock up for weddings or parties and savor its effervescence alongside fresh oysters or creamy brie for a memorable ode to joy.

name: Champagne Marguet 'Shaman' Rosé
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay, Pinot Noir - NV (technically speaking, of course)
description: Champagne Marguet has long been a favorite of those in the know, but it's time to let the secret out. Due to the farming and vinification practices, Marguet creates wines that have become legendary in circles that tend to focus on natural wines exclusively. But don't let any personal bias you may have get in the way of enjoying some truly exceptional wine. After all, nothing is so cut and dry in this arena, and most wines are far more than whatever box they might fall into. Their 'Shaman' cuvées are all Grand Cru fruit and from a single vintage, though the wines are not aged long enough to be labeled as vintage Champagne. Lots of red fruit and briosche, easily one of the most gastronomic Champagnes on hand!

name: Champagne Wafflart-Antoniolli Brut Rosé de Raisin Noir
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Meunier, Pinot Noir - NV
description: Wafflart-Antoniolli is based in Sacy, a small village southwest of Reims. The winemaker has spent a good amount of time making the wine for the Sacy village cooperative, and has used that time to hone his craft, leading to a career of expressive, exact wines. Such as this rosé! Less bright and fruit-forward than their rosé de saigné, this wine shows more restrained fruit and pronounced mineral notes. A gorgeous apertif wine, especially with fresh fruit and Bayonne ham.

name: Champagne Wafflart-Antoniolli Brut Rosé Saignée de Raisins Noirs
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: This wine might be the darkest, most-intensely fruit-forward rosé Champagne to ever grace our shelves. Wafflart-Antoniolli is based in Sacy, a small village southwest of Reims. They make expressive, exact wines, and this rosé in particular is a staff favorite. Lots of baked strawberry, warm spices, and confectionary notes on the nose, with this refreshing, slightly savory finish. Do people look for Champagne to have with prime rib or braised lamb? Start here!

name: Domaine André Robert "Les Jardins du Mesnil" Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - Chardonnay - NV
description: Domaine André Robert can trace its origins back five generations in the chalky, Grand Cru soils of Le Mesnil sur Oger. Current winemakers Claire Robert and her husband, Jean-Baptiste Denizart, have excelled maintaining the winery's historically contemplative nature, crafting great wines of depth and texture. As expected, this Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs is entirely Chardonnay, aged in bottle for four years, and sees no dosage. Truly a fine and decadent wine that rivals any of the most prestigeous houses in Champagne- a delectible treat with caviar.

name: Domaine André Robert "Les Vignes de Montigny" Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier - NV
description: A fifty-fifty split of Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier, this wine showcases some gorgeous, clay-rich soils and well-established vines of the Marne Valley, near the village of Montigny. Domaine André Robert owns and tends to 65 individual parcels in the area, and the overwhelming majority are Premier and Grand Cru sites. The bottle explodes with fruit and tension and acidity!

name: Jean Vesselle Rosé de Saignée Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - NV - Pinot Noir
description: The Jean Vesselle Champagnes have so long been a staple on our shelves that we would forgive you if you haven't noticed them here. The excitement of whatever's new can be overwhelming, but it's so important not to forget the greats that have been around and reliable for so long. And not just around and reliable, but incredibly delicious, complex, and aromatic- especially their rosé de saignée. Rich, red berry fruit, cranberry-like acidity, and a subtle, wild meadow sort of savory quality.

name: Jose Michel Brut Pinot Meunier
tagline: Champagne, France - Pinot Meunier
description: Someday we'll finally meet up with the folks at Jose Michel et Fils and thank them in person for championing Pinot Meunier so prominently! This wine is all bright bubbles and tropical fruit, with an incredible clean and dry finish. It has the perfect balance between fruit and richness which is very likely why this is one of our most popular Champagnes year-round.

name: Lelarge-Pugeot Premier Cru Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne, FR - 65% Pinot Meunier/25% Pinot Noir/15% Chardonnay
description: Lelarge Pugeot's 'Tradition' cuvee is textbook grower Champagne. The Lelarge family has been at it in Vrigny since 1789 and practices Biodynamic farming too. The wine is made up of the big three in the region- Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, and Pinot Meunier- and is just as good at the dinner table as it is as a toast to start off your apero hour.

name: Pierre Gerbais Grains de Celles Rose Extra Brut
tagline: Champagne - 2017 - Pinot Noir/Pinot Blanc/Chardonnay
description: One of the exciting aspects from the wines by Pierre Gerbais is the inclusion of Pinot Blanc in their wines. While all types of of Pinot grapes (noir, gris, blanc, meunier) are permitted in the region, Blanc doesn't get too much attention! The grape brings a unique Alpine wine-like crispness to the wine, which has prominent notes of fresh berries and spring flowers on the nose.

name: Sparkling Wine
description: We have a strong focus on small Champagne producers here. You may have heard the terms "Grower Champagne" or "Farmer Fizz" before. While we don't have a strict policy on whether the Champagne producer only makes wine from fruit they grow, it is where we tend to gravitate. That said, if you want a bottle of Dom, just let us know in the comment section!

name: French Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: When we think about full-bodied French wines, the mind obviously goes towards Bordeaux and Rhone wines. Esteemed bottles from those regions are not uncommon on wine lists around the world and so popular for good reasons. We would also recommend paying special attention to the lesser known reds of southern France: for example, Mourvedre from Bandol, or Carignan from around the Sud-Ouest. We focus our selection on wines that are in 'ready-to-drink' condition, however, many wines under this umbrella could stand be decanted prior to consuming.

name: Italian Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: Trying to organize a wine region defined by nuance and individuality is difficult and foolish, but not necessarily undoable. If you came into the shop and asked for a big Italian wine, we would probably guide you towards Barolo, Barbaresco, Brunello, Taurasi, Amarone, Aglianico del Vulture. If not those wines, wines that drink like that. While not really like one another at all, these wines do share that commonality of more time in oak, stronger tannins, and deeper fruit, whether it be on the earthier or jammier side.

name: Oregon Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: It's no secret that Pinot Noir is the favorite child in Oregon. A few heavier contenders do show up on our shelves every now and then. Bordeaux, Italian, and even some Spanish varietals are grown towards the southern end of the state and in the Columbia Gorge. Might be time to try something new!

name: Washington Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!
description: Washington is definitely known for strong, powerful wines, typically made with Bordeaux or Rhone varietals. While extraction and use of oak may be liberal among many producers, we aim to offer a selection of balanced wines that provide familiar aromas and flavors that a fan of our local wines enjoy. Big, juicy Cabs and peppery, smoky Syrahs will be in your future if you choose this option.

name: California Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!

name: Miscellaneous countries and their fantastic wines!
Spanish Wine
description: We've all become intimately familiar with the great Rioja's in the market, but many of us are starting to discover beautiful, bold, and hearty wines from Priorat or Montsant. Delicious, spicy, tannic reds that go great with grilled meats in the summer or beefy stews in winter.

name: Specialty Wine
description: Whether you're making cocktails or just want something to sip on over ice with an orange slice, we've got all your vermouth needs covered!

name: The DeLaurenti Wine Flight
description: The full flight people...Our new Red Wine, Oregon Pinot Noir, Chianti Classico, Organic Prosecco, Roero Arneis, and our Rosato. A wine for every occasion & a GREAT gift!

name: DeLaurenti Prosecco
description: Our very own prosecco from just outside Trieste. Crisp, dry and delicious. There is no prosecco season - this wine is good 12 months a year!

name: DeLaurenti Roero Arneis DOCG
description:
Arneis is Piedmont’s native white, grown for centuries on the same hills that yield Barolo and Barbaresco. By the 1980s it had almost vanished, but a small band of growers nursed it back, and in the ’90s it re-emerged as Roero’s calling card - sometimes dubbed "Barolo bianco," though it needs no comparison to justify its place at the table.

This bottling comes from the sandy slopes of Santo Stefano Roero. It pours a bright straw yellow. The nose suggests fresh fruit and white flowers. On the palate it’s crisp and poised, with stone-fruit flavors giving way to a clean, mineral finish, typical of the Roero landscape.

Think of Arneis as a lively alternative to Sancerre or a Pinot Grigio with more nerve. Chill it lightly and pair with shellfish, grilled trout, or a simple roast chicken. It’s the sort of everyday white that makes summer meals feel complete.

name: DeLaurenti Red Wine
tagline: Washington - 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc
description: Our newest Washington red blend has arrived! This everyday red is made in the great state of Washington with Italian roots. Crafted in the same way as the great Super Tuscan Tignanello, it consists of 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot & 5% Cabernet Franc. The result is a lush, accessible wine with flavors of dark fruit, baking spice & subtle toasted oak. Great on its own, with grilled meats and pasta. Or, with its convenient screw top, its the perfect picnic wine!

name: DeLaurenti Rosato 750ml
tagline: Tuscany, IT - Sangiovese - 2024
description: A new batch of DeLaurenti Rosato has made it to our shelves! This rose is reminiscent of the roses of Provence, despite being entirely Tuscan Sangiovese. Refreshing, dry, and light with a slightly tart berry finish. This wine will transport you to a sunny afternoon on a breezy Mediterranean beach, no matter what time of year you pop the cork!

name: Delaurenti Pinot Noir
tagline: Eola-Amity, Oregon - 2022 - Pinot Noir
description: When we decided to bring in another PNW wine under our private label, we knew we wanted it to be Pinot Noir. An elegant, medium-bodied red that would be perfect for any season, and ready for your dinner table any night of the week. Single-vineyard fruit from the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon, aged in new and used French oak for 18 months, and really fun to drink!

name: DeLaurenti Chianti Colli Senesi DOCG
description: Our very own Chianti! Hailing from organic vineyards in the town of Montepulciano, this wine is your go-to for any and all pizza, pasta with red sauce, or anything on the grill. Mellow tannins and gorgeous, earthy, red berry notes on the nose. Our Chianti was sourced with our own dinner tables in mind- bring it home to yours today!

name: El Maestro Oloroso, 375ml
tagline: Sherry Country, Andalucia
description: El Maestro Sierra began production in 1832. Jose Antonio Sierra was a carpenter by trade, and established himself as a master barrel-maker, supplying the major sherry houses of the region. He dreamed of producing sherry himself, but such pursuits were largely reserved for nobles. Despite facing prejudice and hardships, Sierra managed to open his own winery, and through talent and perseverance, he made a place for himself in the sherry industry. Solera aged for 15 years, Oloroso as incredibly complex aromas of hazelnuts and exotic spices. This richly textured wine is complex with nuances of nuts and spice.

name: El Maestro Sierra Amontillado 12 yr, 375ml
tagline: Sherry Country, Andalucia

name: El Maestro Sierra Fino, 375ml
tagline: Sherry Country, Andalucia
description: El Maestro Sierra began production in 1832. Jose Antonio Sierra was a carpenter by trade, and established himself as a master barrel-maker, supplying the major sherry houses of the region. He dreamed of producing sherry himself, but such pursuits were largely reserved for nobles. Despite facing prejudice and hardships, Sierra managed to open his own winery, and through talent and perseverance, he made a place for himself in the sherry industry. This fino is bone dry, with notes of saline, marcona almonds and pastry dough with a spicy finish.

name: Niepoort LBV Port
tagline: Duoro Valley, PT - 2017 - Touriga Nacional & more
description: Niepoort has been a family-owned winery and Port house since the mid-1800s. They produce many dry table wines, but the star of their show is their Port. Their Late Bottled Vintage is essentially a financial short-cut to getting your hands on aged, vintage port, without the hefty price tag. Whereas most vintage Port is aged two to three years before bottling, LBV sees four to six years in cask. This extra time in cask allows the wine to develop faster than it would in bottle, creating that classic, aged-Port richness and nuttiness you want with your dessert menu.

name: Ostinato Marsala Dolce, 500ml
description: Delicious, balanced and refined, Ostinato Fine Ambra Dolce is a sweet Marsala that is produced according to traditional methods.Enjoy with classic blue-veined cheeses including Gorgonzola, with cookies, or with coffee cake. Explore in cocktails or use to make exceptional desserts, including Italian classics like Tiramisu, Zabaglione, Cassata Cake or Cannoli, in which there is no substitute for Ostinato Dolce. Once opened, this wine will keep for up to six months.

name: Ostinato Marsala Secco, 500ml
description: Delicious, balanced and refined, Ostinato Fine Ambra Secco is a dry Marsala that is produced according to traditional methods. Explore in cocktails or use to make classics like Chicken Marsala. Once opened, this wine will keep for up to six months.

name: Quinta do Infantado Tawny Port
tagline: Gontelho, PT - NV - Tinta Roriz/Touriga Nacional/Touriga Franca/Tinta Barroca
description: Quinta do Infantado might as well be our house Port by now, as it's what we reach for most. Their Tawny is aged in barrels known as 'pipa', which are tall, 550L casks ideal for Tawny production as the barrel promotes oxidation due to its vertical orientation, smaller capacity, and thinner staves. The wine spends four to five years in bottle before release and finishes with around eighty-four grams per liter of residual sugar, making it noticeably drier and more vinous than most Tawny.

name: Rare Wine Co. Baltimore Rainwater Madeira
tagline: Madeira, PT - Verdelho, Tinta Negra - NV
description: Madeira is a fortified wine from the eponymous archipelago in the Atlantic, which is a territory belonging to Portugal. Stylistically similar to Port, it utilizes different grapes and comes from a distictly different terroir. Rare Wine Co. makes a series of Madeira based on what was typically offered in the corresponding city during the United States' colonial era. This Rainwater-style is known for being slightly lighter and drier than other Madeira.

name: DeLaurenti Red Wine
tagline: Washington - 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc
description: Our newest Washington red blend has arrived! This everyday red is made in the great state of Washington with Italian roots. Crafted in the same way as the great Super Tuscan Tignanello, it consists of 80% Sangiovese, 15% Merlot & 5% Cabernet Franc. The result is a lush, accessible wine with flavors of dark fruit, baking spice & subtle toasted oak. Great on its own, with grilled meats and pasta. Or, with its convenient screw top, its the perfect picnic wine!

name: Delaurenti Pinot Noir
tagline: Eola-Amity, Oregon - 2022 - Pinot Noir
description: When we decided to bring in another PNW wine under our private label, we knew we wanted it to be Pinot Noir. An elegant, medium-bodied red that would be perfect for any season, and ready for your dinner table any night of the week. Single-vineyard fruit from the Eola-Amity Hills in Oregon, aged in new and used French oak for 18 months, and really fun to drink!

name: DeLaurenti Chianti Colli Senesi DOCG
description: Our very own Chianti! Hailing from organic vineyards in the town of Montepulciano, this wine is your go-to for any and all pizza, pasta with red sauce, or anything on the grill. Mellow tannins and gorgeous, earthy, red berry notes on the nose. Our Chianti was sourced with our own dinner tables in mind- bring it home to yours today!

name: Bartolo Mascarello Barolo DOCG
tagline: Piedmont, IT - Nebbiolo - 2017
description: Look, there's a reason the Barolo from Bartolo Mascarello are as legendary as they are. A time will come when you need to impress the table, and this wine will leave the party in absolute awe. A lighter-bodied expression of Nebbiolo that displays plenty of cherry, licorice, and a distinct earthy menthol quality, this wine is ready to go now but will reward the patient buyer willing to wait another half-decade or so.

name: Bedrock Wine Co. 'The Whole Shebang'
tagline: Sonoma, CA - Multi-Vintage - Zinfandel, Carignan, more...
description: The undeniable allure of Bedrock Wine Co.'s 'The Whole Shebang,' lies in some combination of stunning-value-without-compromise and nexus of California Zinfandel and Côtes du Rhône. Bedrock Wine Co. celebrates old-school winemaking. You’ll enjoy the fusion of ripe blackberries, dark cherries, and peppery spice as it unfolds on your palate. This versatile blend is perfectly suited for a smoked brisket or a hearty mushroom risotto.

name: Cadence Coda
tagline: Red Mountain, WA - 2017 - 37% Cab Franc/29% Merlot/23% Cabernet/11% Petit Verdot
description: A Cabernet Franc focused red blend with fruit from around Yakima, WA, this wine is the ideal midpoint between a classic PNW red blend and a Parisian bistro wine. The prominently featured Cabernet Franc lends spice and green notes and the entirety of the wine itself is quite broad and silky. If you're looking to impress the in-laws at the next family meal but don't want to break the bank, this is definitely the way to go.

name: California Wine
tagline: Choose your color, style & price...we'll do the rest!

name: Chateau Le Puy 'Emilien' Bordeaux Rouge
tagline: Bordeaux, FR - 2019 - Merlot
description: The only Bordeaux I really care about, honestly, says Tom Drake, our wine buyer. Chateau Le Puy has been making wine for almost 500 years and the process hasn't really changed since the beginning. The Emilien is a medium-bodied wine with ripe, velvety tannins, and cassis and blueberry aromatics with a bright finish. Roast duck breast, charcuterie, or a juicy lamb shank all make fine partners for this beauty.

name: Cirelli Montepulciano d'Abruzzo DOC
tagline: Abruzzo, IT - 2024 - Montepulciano
description: Montepulciano d'Abruzzo is a great alternative to Chianti or Barbera d'Alba. A wine that is categorically undervalued; this bottle from Cirelli is sure to over-deliver. A light, gentle pressing of organic grapes has created a medium-bodied, elegant red perfect for casual Italian-American cuisine, charcuterie, or an evening on the couch after a long day with your favorite Indian take out spot.

name: Cirelli Vino da Tavola Rosso
tagline: Abruzzo, IT - NV - Montepulciano
description: The table red is an essential tool for the home cook, and the bottle should never say 'for cooking' anywhere on the label. The wine needs to be as delicious as whatever you're cooking aims to be. And, for doing all the work, the cook should be rewarding with a shift drink for their labor. This red-fruited, juicy Montepulciano is perfect for the red sauce, the cook, and whomever is joining the cook at the dinner table.

name: Cor Cellars Momentum Red
tagline: Lyle, WA - 2018 - 38% Malbec/34% Merlot/28% Cab Franc
description: COR Cellars makes absolutely compelling wine from both the Columbia Gorge (for their whites) and Horse Heaven Hills (for their reds). This wine has no right to taste as amazing as it does! The Momentum punches way above its weight class and is a great apero wine with some snacks. It's also the right choice for pairing with classic red sauce-based pasta dishes and anything pork-centric.

name: Domaine Billard Pere & Fils Bourgonge Rouge
tagline: Bourgogne, FR - 2021 - 100% Pinot Noir
description: Jerome Billiard brings a very holistic approach to the vineyard, eschewing the use of chemical fertilizers and plowing his rows with a horse. He allows the fruit to hang on the vine a little longer than most of his neighbors and allows his wines to ferment spontaneously, too, creating a delicate Pinot Noir, pure and expressive of its alluvial soils. This is a great wine for classic bistro fare - think roast chicken, hand-made sausages, and pates.

name: Domaine Chante-Alouette-Cormeil Sain Emilion Grand Gru
tagline: Bordeaux, FR - Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon - 2012
description: An organically farmed, Merlot-led blend from the unique soils of Saint-Émilion. Now at peak maturity, the 2011 opens with aromas of dried plum, fig, cedar, and graphite. Medium-plus body and silky, resolved tannins carry a long, savory finish with cocoa and tobacco nuances. A graceful, classically styled Right-Bank Bordeaux.

name: Domaine Magdalena Red Mountain Cabernet Sauvignon
tagline: Yakima Valley, WA - 2018 - Cabernet Sauvignon
description: Savor the Old World charm of this rustic, Red Mountain masterpiece. Domaine Magdelena, a family-owned estate, embraces organic viticulture and dry farming, crafting award-winning wines for over three decades. This Cabernet Sauvignon offers robust blackberry and cassis flavors, elegantly woven with earthy undertones, sans oaky interference. A bold yet refined choice, it pairs impeccably with a savory beef bourguignon.

name: Envinate Albahra
tagline: Extremadura, SP - 2018 - 70% Garnacha Tintorera/30% Moravia Agria
description: Envinate (en-vin-AH-tay) translates to "wine yourself", a directive most all of us would like to happily oblige to. The group of four winemakers who founded the winery are known for producing wines from the Levant, Ribeira Sacra, and even the Canary Islands! This wine comes from the Levant and packs a lot dark fruit, violets, and spice while remaining light enough for seafood or grilled meats.

name: Eyrie Estate Pinot Noir
tagline: Willamette Valley, OR - 2021 - Pinot Noir
description: This legendary, elegant wine is a benchmark Pinot from a region renowned for its Pinots and a testament to David Lett's bold vision for Oregon's Willamette Valley. Eyrie’s vineyards are planted in Jory soil at the optimal climatic zone: high enough to access the volcanic soils of the slopes, yet low enough for heat to ripen the grapes. The estate’s dry-farmed vines yield a finely balanced, sharply defined Pinot Noir that carries the unique imprint of the terroir. Savor it alongside a succulent roast duck dish or a flavorful mushroom risotto.

name: Felsina 'Berardenga' Chianti Classico DOCG
tagline: Tuscany, IT - 2019 - Sangiovese
description: Unraveling the black rooster's enigmatic charm, this wine struts its textbook Chianti Classico finesse. Proud of its Tuscan pedigree, this crowd pleaser dances on your palate. Each sip reveals layers of sumptuous earth, red cherry, and juicy plum. Raise a glass to tradition, sophistication and the pleasure of good company.

name: Graci Etna Rosso
tagline: Sicily, IT - 2022 - Nerello Mascalese
description: If you typically enjoy Bourgogne Rouge or Willamette Valley Pinot Noir, but want to venture into Italian wine, an Etna Rosso would be a great place to start. Here on Mt. Etna, the star of the show is a grape called Nerello Mascalese, often deployed in the vineyard with slight spatterings of Nerello Cappuccio. Graci's take on this style of wine is entirely Nerello Mascalese, grown on beautiful, volcanic soils on Mt. Etna's north slope. Tantalizingly herbaceous and plentiful with tart red fruit, this is an approachable and delicious entry point to the wines from this corner of Sicily.

name: Grape Ink 'Days Until Harvest' Pinot Noir
tagline: Willamette Valley, OR - 2021 - 100% Pinot Noir
description: This captivating Pinot Noir offers rich dark fruit, earthy undertones, and silky tannins. Derived from higher-elevation plantings, the 2021 vintage feels like a slightly more Alpine-influenced expression of the grape. In a decade, Grape Ink will be a legendary name in the region. Savor this wine today and remember the moment you discovered a rising star.

name: Il Monte Caro 'Ca'Rosso' Valpolicella DOC
tagline: Veneto, IT - 2023 - Corvina, Rondinella, Corvinone
description: Il Monte Caro's Valpolicella DOC showcases the true potential of the region, proving that elegance and enjoyment can coexist. This captivating wine enchants with its harmonious blend of ripe red cherries, blackberries, and a touch of spice. It is slightly more expensive, but its grace and playfulness make it well worth the splurge. Pair with prosciutto-wrapped figs or a hearty osso buco for a delightful dining experience.

name: Il Monte Caro Amarone della Valpolicella DOCG
tagline: Veneto, IT - 2019 - Corvina, Corvinone, Rondinella
description: It's hard to say anything novel about Amarone in this day and age. What we can all agree on is that it's quite easy to tell when a wine is a fine, hand-crafted expression of terroir, or a paint-by-numbers manufactured drink, and ever is that distinction so notable than in the category of Amarone della Valpolicella. Il Monte Caro reigns in the punchy, boozy notes sometimes found in this style, without limiting any of the wine's power. This is an intense wine, absolutely, but it's executed with precision and finesse. This wine is built to last, but should you decide to open it, it's absolutely dreamy with lamb shanks, braised beef, and the PNW's own Rogue River Blue cheese.

name: Il Monte Caro Valpolicella Superiore DOC
tagline: Veneto, IT - 2020 - Corvina, Corvinone, Rondinella
description: Valpolicella is one of those red wines that's such a classic and worthwhile staple because it's just so versatile. As with all the wines in this appellation, it leans heavy on Corvina, a grape almost exclusively found in Italy's Veneto region. With support from Corvinone and Rondinella grapes, the resulting wine shows bright cherry notes and just enough tannin structure to make you want to enjoy this wine with some red meat. That said, it's not too heavy, and does feel light and juicy enough that you could enjoy this wine with lighter proteins like poultry or bean dishes, or you could even enjoy it as an apertif.

name: Illahe 'Bon Sauvage' Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
tagline: Willamette Valley, OR - 2019 - Pinot Noir
description: This Willamette Valley Pinot Noir marries elegance with robust character. Illahe is a family-owned estate committed to sustainability.
